plugins.description: 把本地 GeoGebra 嵌进 DSH 右侧栏，让 agent 能直接在上面作图、改图、读状态
plugins.readme_text:
# geogebra-dsh

**把 GeoGebra 嵌进 DSH 的右侧栏，让 AI 和你共用同一块画板。**

在对话里丢一道几何题或函数题，AI 直接在 GeoGebra 里作图 —— 不是贴一张图片。
画完你还能用手拖、用输入栏接着改，AI 也看得到你改了什么。

完全离线，不连 CDN，不依赖你机器上的任何路径。

## 特性

- **面板在右侧栏** —— 原生标签页，不是浮层。从侧边栏图标行那个 GeoGebra 图标点开
- **AI 直接操作真画板** —— 作图、改图、读状态、切视角、导出，7 个工具
- **一次把整张图画完** —— 先读懂题目、把条件翻译成几何关系，整批指令一次提交，出错只重发那几条
- **分得清谁改的** —— 你拖动了一个点，它知道，且只报告你的改动
- **指令发出去之前先校验** —— 内置官方 549 条指令表；拼错的名字当场拦住并给出最接近的那个
- **关掉再打开图还在** —— 图存在宿主侧、按会话分开；切会话不会串到别的画板
- **完全离线** —— GeoGebra 构建随插件分发

## 界面

![DSH 右侧栏里的 GeoGebra 面板](assets/screenshot.png)

右侧栏里的 GeoGebra 面板。面板顶部是视图与文件按钮（**2D / 3D / 函数 · 打开文件 · 删除所有元素 · 下载 .ggb**），
下面是 GeoGebra 本体。图中这道题：AB 是直径，C 在圆上，∠CAB = 30° —— `A`、`B`、`O`、`c`、`C`、`tri`、`ang`
全部由 `geogebra_do` 一次调用建立，`ang` 由 GeoGebra 算出 30°。

> 打开方式：侧边栏图标行里的 GeoGebra 图标。也可以不点它 —— 直接问题目，AI 需要时会自己把面板调出来。

## 安装

需要 DSH 桌面端。把插件装进 profile：

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
DSH_PREFER_BUNDLED_PNPM=1 ~/.local/bin/pnpm add "file:/path/to/geogebra-dsh"
```

再把它加进 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`：

```json
"bundles": [ ..., "geogebra-dsh" ]
```

然后重启 DSH。

> **宿主半边改了要重启 DSH，客户端半边改了刷新页面即可。**

## 使用

开一个会话直接把题目丢给它就行 —— **不需要先打开面板**，AI 需要时会自己把它调出来。

```
这题怎么做：AB 是⊙O 的直径，C 在圆上，∠CAB = 30°，求证 BC = AB/2
```

也可以明确要求：

```
用 GeoGebra 画一下 y = sin(x) 和 y = x/2 的交点
```

## AI 工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `geogebra_do` | 执行 GeoGebra 命令，作图或改图（**最常用的一个**） |
| `geogebra_state` | 读当前作图内容：每个对象的定义与当前值，附带诊断 |
| `geogebra_changes` | 读**你手动**做的改动（拖动、输入命令、增删对象） |
| `geogebra_view` | 切换视角：2D / 3D / 函数 / 几何 / 表格 / CAS / 概率 |
| `geogebra_export` | 导出成 `.ggb`（双击即开）或 XML，写到磁盘 |
| `geogebra_check` | 离线校验指令名，对照 549 条官方指令表 |
| `geogebra_params` | 查 GeoGebra App 参数与视角语法（官方取值表） |

## 面板上的按钮

**2D / 3D / 函数** 视图切换 · **打开文件**（载入本地 `.ggb`）· **删除所有元素** · **下载 .ggb**

## 配置

默认用包内的 GeoGebra 构建。想换成别的（更新的版本、或带 `web3d` 的完整树），
在 profile 配置里指定，不用改代码：

```yaml
- id: geogebra-dsh
  config:
    geogebraDir: /path/to/another/GeoGebra
```

## 关于内嵌的 GeoGebra

`vendor/GeoGebra/` 里是 **GeoGebra 5.2.888.1** 的官方构建，约 45 MB，随插件分发。
装了什么、裁掉了什么、为什么裁、怎么加回来，见 [`vendor/README.md`](./vendor/README.md)。

⚠️ **这份代码是 GeoGebra 的，不是本项目的**（© GeoGebra GmbH）。它按 GeoGebra 自己的
条款授权 —— **仅限非商业用途**，并要求署名。完整条款见 [`LICENSE`](./LICENSE)。

因此**本仓库整体只能用于非商业目的**，并且它不是 OSI 意义上的「开源」。
想避开这一点，可以不提交 `vendor/`，改用 `geogebraDir` 指向你本地的构建。

## 开发

```bash
node test/run.mjs      # 零依赖，50 项
```

源码分两半：`src/host/` 是宿主侧（工具、持久化、系统提示词），`lib/client.js` 是浏览器侧
（面板、路由、桥）。改动方式与各项取舍见 `docs/implementation.md`。

## 文档

| 文件 | 看什么 |
| --- | --- |
| [`vendor/README.md`](./vendor/README.md) | 内嵌的 GeoGebra 是哪一版、装了哪些、许可 |
| `docs/implementation.md` | 实现细节：路由、桥、持久化、提示词注入 |
| `docs/dsh-plugin-dev.md` | 在 DSH 里写插件的经验与踩坑 |
| `docs/geogebra.md` | GeoGebra 自身的事实：嵌入、API、哪里静默失败 |

## 许可

- **`vendor/GeoGebra/`** —— GeoGebra 的代码，© GeoGebra GmbH，**仅限非商业用途**，需署名。
  条款原文见 [`LICENSE`](./LICENSE)（取自 <https://www.geogebra.org/license>）。
- **本项目自身的代码**（`src/`、`lib/`、`test/`）—— 许可未指定，可由作者选定。

由于内嵌了 GeoGebra，**本仓库整体只能用于非商业目的**，且不属于 OSI 定义的开源项目。

plugins.description: Project knowledge base for DSH agents: capture pitfalls and reusable methods into paged volumes and surface them while you work.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-knowledge —— 项目知识库 > **English summary** — A per-project knowledge base for DSH (DeepSeek Harness): the agent records the pitfalls it hits under `避错/` and the reusable practices under `方法/`, with monotonic entry IDs and auto-maintained indexes. > **Install:** `dsh plugin add @moyu-cn/dsh-knowledge` (recommended, from npm). The tarball and from-source alternatives are in the 安装 / Install section below. Then restart DSH for the host half and reload the page for the client half. > **Highlights:** 8 agent tools (`kb_search` / `kb_add` / `kb_list` / `kb_get` / `kb_guide` / `kb_remove` / `kb_prune` / `kb_init`), a same-origin HTTP API, a right-pane browser and a settings row. > **Language:** the settings UI follows the host language setting — Chinese and English dictionaries are both built in. **Model-facing prompts stay in Chinese** by design. > **License:** MIT. 让智能体把**踩过的坑**与**可复用的做法**沉淀进项目知识库，并在后续会话里自动受益。 一句话原理：可复用的做法写进 `方法/`，踩过的坑写进 `避错/`；**编号只增不改**（引用才靠得住），分册与索引由工具自动维护。 ## 安装 / Install **✅ 推荐 / Recommended —— 从 npm 安装（用包名，不要手抄 tarball 地址）：** ```bash dsh plugin add @moyu-cn/dsh-knowledge ``` *装完按提示重启 DSH；客户端那一半刷新页面即可生效。* *Restart DSH when prompted; reload the page for the client half.* ### 备选方式 / Alternatives **① tarball —— 直接装打包文件 / install the packed tarball** ```bash dsh plugin add https://registry.npmjs.org/@moyu-cn/dsh-knowledge/-/dsh-knowledge-0.1.0.tgz ``` **② 源码 —— clone 后把本地目录链接进 profile / from source: clone and link the folder** ```bash git clone https://github.com/MoYu-CN/dsh-knowledge.git dsh plugin add "link:<你的目录>/dsh-knowledge" ``` `link:` 不拷贝、直接软链，改代码立刻生效 —— 适合要改插件本身的场景。 `link:` symlinks instead of copying, so local edits take effect immediately — use it when you want to modify the plugin itself. ## 界面 ### 设置 →「启用知识库沉淀」 ![知识库设置](docs/settings-page.png) *设置页：沉淀状态、存储位置（留空 = 每个项目在自己根目录下建「知识库」）、每册容量与总量上限。* *The settings page: distill status, storage location (leave it empty to keep a `知识库/` folder in each project root), per-volume capacity and total limit.* ### 会话头部的「查看 / 沉淀」 *两个按钮：`查看` 打开右栏知识库面板；`沉淀` 把本次对话交给智能体提炼后写库（类别与领域由它判断）。* *Two buttons: `查看` opens the knowledge browser in the right pane; `沉淀` hands the current conversation to the agent to distill and write into the library.* > 截图取自开发机上的实测界面，其中的示例路径与对话内容都是**演示数据**，不是插件的一部分。 > The screenshots come from a real development machine: the sample path and conversation text in them > are **demo data**, not part of the plugin. --- ## 1. 它是什么 一个 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件，分两半： | 半 | 文件 | 干什么 | |---|---|---| | Host | `lib/index.js` | 注册 8 个工具 + 10 条 HTTP 路由；把知识库的使用约定注入系统提示 | | Client | `lib/client.js` | 设置页那一行（容量 / 上限 / 注入开关）+ 右栏「知识库」面板（浏览、搜索、沉淀） | | 存储 | `lib/kb-store.js` · `lib/kb-config.js` | 读写 `<项目根>/知识库/` 那套分册结构；插件自身的配置读写 | ### 给智能体的 8 个工具 | 工具 | 作用 | |---|---| | `kb_guide` | 按**正在做的事**（工序）返回该照做的条目 —— 动手前先查 | | `kb_search` | 关键词检索（回答「库里提过这个词吗」） | | `kb_add` | 写一条避错或方法（避错四段必填：触发条件 / 先做 / 为什么 / 违规症状） | | `kb_list` | 列全部条目摘要（编号 / 标题 / 领域） | | `kb_get` | 按编号读一条全文 | | `kb_remove` | 删一条（不可撤销，动手前先问用户） | | `kb_prune` | 清理到不超过 N 条（**只删最旧的**） | | `kb_init` | 建出知识库骨架（总纲 + 方法/避错两个主体索引），也能建一个全新项目 | ### HTTP 路由（全部同源校验） `/__kb/client.js` · `/__kb/list` · `/__kb/get` · `/__kb/search` · `/__kb/pick-dir` · `/__kb/config` · `/__kb/remove` · `/__kb/distill` · `/__kb/projects` · `/__kb/init` · `/__kb/add` ## 2. 怎么装（源码方式的细节） 推荐直接用开头的 `dsh plugin add @moyu-cn/dsh-knowledge`。本节是**源码 / `link:` 方式**的细节： 1. 把本目录放到一个稳定位置（例：`<你的目录>/dsh-knowledge`）。 2. 装进 profile：`dsh plugin add "link:<你的目录>/dsh-knowledge"`。 - 用 `link:` 而不是 `file:`：不拷贝、直接软链，改代码立刻生效。 - 若是手工改 profile 配置，依赖键要用插件 `package.json` 里的 `name`，即 `"@moyu-cn/dsh-knowledge": "link:<你的目录>/dsh-knowledge"`。 3. Host 半需要**重启 DSH**；客户端半需要**刷新页面**。 4. 装好后「设置 → 通用」会多出知识库那一行，右栏多一个知识库面板。 ### 两个安装期的坑 - **别声明 `peerDependencies`。** 桌面端启动时会做 generations 迁移与 peer 校验，宿主的 `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 在 staging closure 里解析不到 → 整批迁移失败、`profile maintenance` 被冻结。cordis 是宿主提供的运行时，插件不该声明它。 - **别 `import @deepseek-ai/schemastery`。** `link:` 形态下插件从源码目录解析依赖，那里没有 `node_modules` → `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` 会拖垮整批启动。 ## 3. 库长什么样 ``` <项目根>/知识库/ ├── 00-开始这里-总纲.md ← 结构说明 + 怎么读 ├── 方法/ │ ├── 00-方法主体.md ← 分册索引 │ └── 方法-01-【领域】.md ← 装 M-001 ~ M-010 └── 避错/ ├── 00-避错主体.md └── 避错-01-【领域】.md ← 装 P-001 ~ P-010 ``` - 编号 `M-0XX` / `P-0XX`，三位数从 001 起，**只增不改**。 - 按**领域**分册，不按时间分册（按时间分，「找某个坑」要翻遍所有册）；每册装 10 条，装满即开新册。 - 插入新条目时索引由工具自动同步，不用手改索引里的行。 ### 存储位置与覆盖 - 插件自身的数据目录：`/.dsh-knowledge-data/`（放 `config.json`）。 解析顺序：`DSH_KNOWLEDGE_DATA` → 由 `process.argv[1]` / `process.execPath` 反推安装根 → `DSH_INSTALL_DIR` → 兜底插件源码目录往上两级。 - 库本体默认**跟着项目走**（`<项目根>/知识库`）；在设置里填「知识库父目录」后所有项目集中到该目录下的同名子文件夹。**改这一项不会搬运已有条目**，原库仍在老位置。 ## 4. 已知边界 - **不自动建库。** 项目没有库时工具会**如实报错**并给出可照抄的 `kb_init(...)` 调用，不会静默挑个地方写。这是有意的：擅自建库会掩盖「这个项目其实没在用知识库」这个事实。 - **总量上限到了会拒绝写入**，不会替你删条目；删哪条是人的决定。 - **`kb_remove` / `kb_prune` 不可撤销。** - **`kb_guide` 与 `kb_search` 结果可以不一样**：前者按触发条件做工序匹配并排序，后者是关键词包含匹配。这是有意设计，不是 bug。 - **注入是可关的。** 关掉「注入使用约定」后智能体不再主动知道怎么用（能省约 1.4k 字符）；「本项目必读」是另一个开关，两项都关 = 完全不注入。 - **本目录自带测试，见 §5「怎么跑测试」。** 覆盖：8 个工具都注册（**集合断言**，不写死数字）、无库时报错文案含可执行建议、`kb_prune(project=…)` 只动目标项目、改名遇到非空目标时拒绝覆盖且不留半成品、`kb_init` 撞改名时**一个文件都不建**（不会留下一份空骨架把后续「搬过去」堵死）。 ## 5. 怎么跑测试 测试都在 `test/` 下，**从干净检出就能跑**：插件路径由 `import.meta.url` 反推，没有一处写死的安装路径；数据目录只走 `DSH_KNOWLEDGE_DATA`，**没设就自建临时目录并在进程退出时删除**。 ```bash node test/kb-3fixes.test.mjs # 三项改动：无库建议 / kb_prune(project=) / 改名 node test/r5-guide.test.mjs # kb_guide 工序匹配 + 必读注入 node test/kb-init-project.test.mjs # kb_init 建指定项目 / 全新项目 node test/kb-client-rename.test.mjs # 改名在客户端那一半（端到端打到真路由） node test/kb-client-i18n.test.mjs # 右栏面板的渲染级中英双语（含 DSH_KB_I18N_SABOTAGE 对照组） node test/kb-settings-save-hint.test.mjs # 设置页的保存提示（真渲染，中英双语） node test/verify-applyconfig.mjs # 改「知识库父目录」后目录真的重算 node test/parse-check.mjs # 真解析校验（含故意写坏的对照组） ``` （上面 8 条就是全部测试；没有测试运行器依赖，逐条 `node` 即可。`test/r5-fixture.mjs` 是夹具、不是用例。） ### 环境变量 | 变量 | 要不要设 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `DSH_KNOWLEDGE_DATA` | 可选 | 插件的数据目录（`config.json` / `projects.json`）。**不设就自建临时目录并自动清理**；设了就用你给的，测试结束也会删掉它。 | | `DSH_APP_DIR` | 可选 | DSH 安装目录里的 `resources/app`。用来借官方 `dsh-tools` 的 JSON Schema 校验器。不设时会依次试 `DSH_INSTALL_DIR` → 由 `process.execPath` 反推 → 常见默认安装位置；**全都拿不到时会打印一句说明**，并把「schema 校验」那一栏标成**不算证据**（不是静默跳过）。 | | `DSH_TEST_OUT_DIR` | 可选 | 把原始 stdout 落盘到哪。不设就写系统临时目录 —— **测试绝不往仓库里写文件**（否则跑一次 `git status` 就脏了）。 | | `DSH_KNOWLEDGE_REAL_BASE` | 可选 | 只在 `verify-applyconfig.mjs` 里用：设了就在 `<该目录>/<当前目录名>` 上做一次**只读**加载复核。不设就打印 `SKIP`。 | | `DSH_KNOWLEDGE_SRC` | 可选 | 把「被测源码」整个换成另一份 `lib` 目录。**这是对照组开关**：指向 `test/_before-3fixes`（改动前快照）时，必备工具集合断言必须变红。 | ### 对照组（判据能不能失败） 「跑绿了」本身不是证据 —— 得能证明判据**会**失败： ```bash node test/parse-check.mjs # test/_broken-control.js 必须 FAIL $env:DSH_KNOWLEDGE_SRC="$PWD/test/_before-3fixes"; node test/kb-3fixes.test.mjs # 必须 FAIL：缺 kb_guide $env:DSH_KNOWLEDGE_SAVE_HINT_SABOTAGE="1"; node test/kb-settings-save-hint.test.mjs # 必须 FAIL ``` - `test/_broken-control.js` —— 故意写坏的语法错误样本，`parse-check.mjs` 对它必须报 FAIL。 - `test/_before-3fixes/` —— 三项改动**之前**的源码快照；`kb-3fixes.test.mjs` 靠它做「返回值逐字不变」的比对，同时它也是「工具集合断言会失败」的对照组。 - `DSH_KNOWLEDGE_SAVE_HINT_SABOTAGE=1` —— 只在内存里把设置页渲染处的两个文案键改成不存在的键（**磁盘上的源码不动**），用来证明「保存提示真的渲染出来了」这两条断言不是空转。改不到时脚本直接退出 2，不会静默算过。 ### 跑不了普通 Node 怎么办 这些测试只用 Node 内置模块，普通 Node 就能跑。若机器上只有 Electron（DSH Desktop 自带的那份），用 Electron-as-node： ```powershell $env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = "1" $env:NODE_OPTIONS = "--experimental-vm-modules" # 只有 parse-check 的 ESM 形态需要 & "<安装根>\DSH Desktop.exe" test/kb-3fixes.test.mjs ``` ⚠ 用 `&` 直接调 `.exe` 时 PowerShell **不会等它**，退出码是空的 —— 那种「没输出」不是证据。要拿退出码请用 `Start-Process -Wait -PassThru`。 ## 6. 兼容性 - DSH Desktop **2.0.17**（官方包 `@deepseek-ai/*` `0.2.0-rc.2`）实测可用。 - 需要宿主提供 `webServer`，以及官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale`、`dsh-client-ui-conversation`、`dsh-client-ui-renderer`、`dsh-client-ui-slots`（见 `package.json` 的 `dsh.client.inject`）。 - 运行时为 Electron 自带的 Node（实测 v24.18.1）；`engines.node` 标为 `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`。 ## 7. 目录结构 ``` dsh-knowledge/ ├── lib/ │ ├── index.js # host 半：8 个工具 + 10 条

plugins.description: Control running DeepSeek Harness sessions from desktop and mobile browsers using the stock DSH Web UI and a self-hosted relay.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Web Control

[English](README.en.md) · [安装](docs/installation.md) · [部署 Relay](docs/deployment.md) · [版本与限制](docs/compatibility.md) · [Releases](https://github.com/liangkw16/dsh-web-control/releases)

通过链接或二维码，在电脑、平板和手机浏览器中接管正在运行的 DeepSeek Harness 会话。

**尽可能复用 DSH 原版 Web UI，Web Control 只负责认证、连接与有限能力桥接。** 无需开放电脑的入站端口，无需远程桌面。

这是独立社区插件，与 DeepSeek 没有隶属或官方背书关系。当前版本 **v0.1.0**，验证目标为 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2**；其他 DSH 版本未声明兼容。Relay 需自行部署，本项目不提供公共托管服务。

## 能做什么

- 原版会话列表、消息、执行进度、工具记录、队列操作和审批交互。
- 在电脑与移动浏览器间切换，新页面可接替旧控制页面。
- 原版文件卡片、历史 diff、侧栏标签和完整文件预览；支持浏览器下载与上传。
- 插件在 DSH Host 中保持连接，关闭设置页面或仅锁屏后仍可使用；休眠、断网和退出 DSH 会影响连接。
- 通过版本协商和明确的命令接口适配，保留 DSH 原版业务资源，避免维护另一套聊天界面。

## 工作方式

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Browser[PC / 移动浏览器] <-->|HTTPS / WSS| Relay[自托管 Relay]
    Host[DSH Host + 插件] <-->|主动建立 WSS| Relay
    Host --> Session[原版会话与工作区服务]
```

Relay 负责认证、路由和静态 UI 分发。浏览器与 Host 均通过 TLS 连接到 Relay，**不是端到端加密**：部署者必须信任自己的 Relay。控制链接是访问凭据，不要公开分享。

## 快速开始

1. 从 [v0.1.0 Release](https://github.com/liangkw16/dsh-web-control/releases/tag/v0.1.0) 下载插件 `dsh-web-control-0.1.0.tgz`、部署包及 `SHA256SUMS`，按[部署指南](docs/deployment.md)启动 HTTPS Relay。
2. 在 DSH 桌面 App 的「插件 → 添加插件」中安装下载的 `.tgz`，启用插件。CLI 用户可运行：

   ```sh
   npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 plugin --profile web add ./dsh-web-control-0.1.0.tgz
   ```

3. 首次使用时，由 Relay 管理者生成一次私有连接配置，在 DSH「设置 → 网页远控」导入；日常使用只需打开生成的链接或扫码。
4. 保持 DSH 运行，在另一台设备的浏览器打开链接即可。停止远控、刷新链接与接管规则见[安装指南](docs/installation.md)。

预构建 tarball 不需要在安装时执行构建脚本。源码仓库是 monorepo；不要把仓库根目录当成可直接安装的插件包。

## 文档

| 文档 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| [安装与配对](docs/installation.md) | 桌面 / CLI、首次配置、控制链接、升级卸载 |
| [Relay 部署](docs/deployment.md) | Docker Compose、HTTPS、IP:port、备份回退 |
| [架构](docs/architecture.md) | 原版 UI 复用、状态同步和权限边界 |
| [兼容性](docs/compatibility.md) | 支持范围、文件限制、浏览器验收边界 |
| [排障](docs/troubleshooting.md) | 连接、证书、文件读取与锁屏 |
| [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md) | 构建、测试、PR 要求 |
| [发布流程](docs/releasing.md) | 制品、校验、验证与官方发现入口 |
| [安全政策](SECURITY.md) | 威胁模型、漏洞报告、凭据保护 |

## 本地开发

需要 Node.js 24.x、pnpm 11.25.0。运行测试只使用隔离 fixture，不连接你的生产 DSH。

```sh
corepack enable
corepack prepare pnpm@11.25.0 --activate
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
```

Relay 镜像还需要固定的原版 UI 资源；不能只运行 `docker build`。使用完整部署包，或按[发布流程](docs/releasing.md)组装 `release-input/web`。

## 许可证与来源

本项目使用 [MIT](LICENSE)。DeepSeek Harness 和其他依赖保留各自许可证，见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。原版 UI 资源的许可证随部署包分发。

DeepSeek [官网](https://deepseek.com/harness/)的“社区插件”指向 GitHub [`dsh-plugin` topic](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)，这是本项目采用的官方发现路径；不是“官方审核通过”的标志。

If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it. ## What is dsh-permission-rules? Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness. Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**

plugins.description: Bottom-right native Windows cards for DeepSeek Harness: approve a permission request, know a question is waiting, and get a summary when a turn finishes.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-desk-card

Bottom-right native desktop cards for **DSH (DeepSeek Harness)** approvals, questions, turn
completion and errors.

Each card is a small always-on-top window drawn by PowerShell/WPF — not a system toast — so it
can carry a button that answers the request. An approval can be allowed straight from the card,
and the moment a card would interrupt something else (a fullscreen app, a game, Do-Not-Disturb)
it is skipped and the decision goes back to the normal DSH UI.

Windows only. No dependencies, no network, no build step.

## Why not just a toast

| | system toast | this card |
|---|---|---|
| carries a button that returns an answer | depends on the shell / extra runtime | yes, the card's own button |
| can allow an approval in place | no (toasts only focus the app) | yes — `确认允许` / `Allow` |
| respects fullscreen games and Do-Not-Disturb | only if the OS suppresses it | explicit gate, checked before the window is drawn |
| UI language | whatever the OS shows | follows the DSH locale, or forced with `language` |

## Screenshots

![approval card](assets/approval-zh.png)

![completion card](assets/done-zh.png)

![error card](assets/error-en.png)

![two cards stacked](assets/stacked-zh.png)

## Requirements

- Windows 10/11 (cards are drawn with `powershell.exe` + WPF, which ship with Windows).
- DSH desktop profile (the cards are injected by the **host** process, no browser side needed).
- Node.js 20+ (whatever DSH ships is fine).

## Install

From this repository:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:nanshang328/dsh-desk-card
```

Or from a local clone / download:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-desk-card
```

Then restart DSH. The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so the CLI records it in
`dsh.profile.bundles` and mounts it as a normal profile layer — no hand-written paths.

Windows developer helper: `powershell.exe -File tools/deploy-local.ps1` copies the working tree
into `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\plugins\dsh-desk-card` and registers it the same way.

## What shows up

| card | when | auto-close | buttons |
|---|---|---|---|
| Approval | a tool call needs permission | never (waits for you) | `确认允许` / `Allow` approves once · clicking the card opens DSH for the full dialog |
| Question | the agent asks you something | never, closes when the question is answered | `知道了` / `Got it` |
| Completion | a turn ends normally | `doneTimeoutSeconds` (default 5s) | `知晓` / `OK` |
| Error | a turn fails | never | `知道了` / `Got it` |

The completion card also carries a short summary of your last message, the elapsed time, the
remaining todo count and the turn/session token usage.

Cards never overlap: a new card stacks above the ones already on screen. If the DSH window is
closed while a card is open, the card closes itself too.

## Configuration

Everything has a built-in default, so this section is optional. To change something, add a row
with the same id from your profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` (`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-desk-card
      name: dsh-desk-card
      config:
        doneTimeoutSeconds: 10
        scale: 1.0
        language: en
```

Only the keys you list are changed — a `config` object replaces the whole object, and every key
you leave out falls back to the defaults below.

| key | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `timeoutSeconds` | `0` | auto-close seconds for cards that wait for **you** (approval / question). `0` = stay until answered |
| `doneTimeoutSeconds` | `5` | auto-close seconds for the completion card. `0` = keep it until clicked |
| `scale` | `1.2` | card scale factor |
| `skipWhenFullscreen` | `true` | skip cards while a fullscreen app is in the foreground, or while Windows says Do-Not-Disturb |
| `notifyQuestions` | `true` | show the question card |
| `notifyErrors` | `true` | show the error card |
| `notifyDone` | `true` | show the completion card |
| `language` | `auto` | `auto` (follow the DSH locale), `zh` or `en` |
| `hostProcess` | `DeepSeek Harness` | the process whose window is brought to front when you click a card |

The three `notify*` switches only control the cards — approvals and questions always keep
working, the card just does not appear.

### The fullscreen gate

A card is not drawn when either of these is true:

- `SHQueryUserNotificationState` reports a fullscreen app, presentation mode or Do-Not-Disturb; or
- the foreground window covers its whole monitor and is not the desktop (this keeps games that
  hide the real state from being interrupted).

When a card is skipped the approval is handed back to the normal DSH UI (with `prepend: true`
this plugin speaks first, and a skipped card always delegates to the next answerer), so nothing
gets stuck. Two test tools reproduce the condition without a game:

```powershell
powershell.exe -File test/gate-probe.ps1 -MaxSeconds 20          # watch the gate flip blocked -> free
powershell.exe -File test/fake-fullscreen.ps1 -HoldSeconds 8     # paint a fullscreen window for 8s
```

## How it works

```
lib/index.js      host half: listens to approval/request, user-questions/request,
                  agent/error, agent/status; spawns one card per event and maps the
                  card's exit code back to an approval outcome.
scripts/card.ps1  render half: one PowerShell process per card. Runs the gate, draws the
                  WPF window, stacks it above sibling cards, runs timers, then exits with
                  a code that the host half reads.
```

Exit-code protocol between the two halves:

| code | meaning |
|---|---|
| `10` | the card's primary button was pressed |
| `12` | the card body was clicked — bring the DSH window to the front, let the UI decide |
| `0` | gate skipped the card (fullscreen / Do-Not-Disturb) |
| `3` | rendering failed |

Being one process per card keeps the render half stateless: a card can never wedge the host,
and a card that is killed by the OS just delegates the decision.

## Logs and troubleshooting

`%TEMP%\dsh-desk-card.log` records card placement, exit codes, config and gate decisions:

```
apply() started config={"skipWhenFullscreen":true,...}
showCard[approval]: exit 10
approval resolved: allowed-once
done card (41234ms, autoClose=5s)
```

Cards are spawned without a console window. If no card ever appears, check in order: a
fullscreen app is holding the gate (`-SkipWhenFullscreen false` for a manual test), PowerShell
is blocked by policy for the DSH process, and finally the log file.

Manual card render (bypasses the host half entirely):

```powershell
$payload = [Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes('{"badge":"test","head":"hello","body":"line","okLabel":"OK","okCode":10}'))
powershell.exe -File scripts/card.ps1 -Payload $payload -TimeoutSeconds 5 -Scale 1.2 -SkipWhenFullscreen false -DebugLog "$env:TEMP\card-test.log"
```

## Limitations

- Windows only. The render half is PowerShell + WPF; there is no macOS/Linux path.
- Cards are ordinary top-level windows, so they appear above other windows but not above a
  fullscreen exclusive game — which is why the gate exists.
- One PowerShell process per card (about 100 ms of warm-up). A card is not a notification
  center entry: once it is closed it is gone.
- This plugin deliberately does **not** restart or shut down DSH. If you want power controls,
  [dsh-power-button](https://github.com/keyiadiannao/dsh-power-button) and
  [dsh-restart](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-restart) do that well.

## Privacy

The host half never opens a socket and never reads a file. It spawns one local PowerShell
process per card and appends a line to `%TEMP%\dsh-desk-card.log`. Card payloads contain short
excerpts of your session (task title, tool name, approval reason, error message) and are passed
to that child process as a command-line argument.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness A2A (Agent2Agent) plugin: expose DSH agents as standard A2A servers (agent card, message/send, message/stream SSE, tasks) + a2a_* tools to call remote A2A agents
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-a2a

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的 **A2A（Agent2Agent）协议**插件。

DSH 内置的互操作走 ACP + MCP，不包含 A2A；本插件补上这块拼图，**双向**打通 A2A 生态（Google ADK、a2ajava / a2a-python SDK、各类 agent 网关）：

- **服务器方向（入站）**：把 DSH agent 暴露为标准 A2A 服务器
  - Agent Card：`/.well-known/agent-card.json`（0.3.x）与 `/.well-known/agent.json`（0.2.x 兼容）
  - JSON-RPC 2.0：`message/send`（同步）、`message/stream`（SSE 流式）、`tasks/get`、`tasks/cancel`、`tasks/resubscribe`（断线续订）、`agent/authenticatedExtendedCard`
  - 任务生命周期 `submitted → working → completed/failed/canceled`，支持 `input-required` 暂停与 taskId 多轮续答
  - 版本协商（`A2A-Version` / `X-A2A-Version` 头）、可选 Bearer 鉴权、CORS、单轮超时、任务 TTL 回收
- **客户端方向（出站）**：注册 `a2a_*` 模型工具，让任意 DSH agent 直接呼叫远端 A2A agent
  - `a2a_discover` / `a2a_send` / `a2a_task_status` / `a2a_cancel`
  - 地址白名单（`clientAllowPatterns`）控制 agent 可呼叫的目标
- **可视化运维面板**（Web client 半，v0.2.0）：Plugins → @zyfgood/dsh-a2a 的配置卡与设置 Plugins 分区的 A2A 标签页
  - 服务器状态：运行中/模式/地址/协议版本/鉴权 + curl 验证命令一键复制
  - 实时任务板：最近任务的状态徽标/上下文/产物数，非终态任务一键取消（5s 自动刷新）
  - 远端 agent 目录：保存常用远端地址，浏览器直连拉取其 Agent Card（名称/版本/技能）
  - 数据来自 A2A 服务器自带的 `/admin/status`、`/admin/tasks` 端点（Bearer 门禁同 JSON-RPC）

零运行时依赖（纯 Node ≥20 stdlib + 全局 fetch），与 [dsh-feishu-bot](https://github.com/zyfgood/dsh-feishu-bot) 同一插件体系。

## 一、安装

```bash
# 官方 CLI 一键安装（npm 渠道，推荐；bundle patch 自动挂载）
dsh plugin --profile <name> add @zyfgood/dsh-a2a

# 或 GitHub
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:zyfgood/dsh-a2a

# 或本地路径
dsh plugin --profile <name> add file:D:/DSHProjects/dsh-a2a
```

> npm 裸名 `dsh-a2a` 是另一个无关项目（TtTRz/dsh-a2a），本插件发布在 `@zyfgood` scope 下，安装时请带 scope。

重启 profile 后生效。默认监听 `127.0.0.1:7310`。

> `lib/` 预构建产物随仓库发布，安装即用，无需构建脚本（无 pnpm ≥10 的 `allowBuilds` 步骤）。

## 二、快速验证

```bash
# 1) Agent Card（0.3 路径）
curl http://127.0.0.1:7310/.well-known/agent-card.json

# 2) 发一条消息（同步）
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:7310/ -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "message/send",
  "params": {
    "message": {
      "kind": "message",
      "role": "user",
      "parts": [{"kind": "text", "text": "你好，介绍一下你自己"}],
      "messageId": "m-1",
      "contextId": "ctx-demo"
    }
  }
}'
```

返回的 `result` 是 A2A Task：`status.state === "completed"`，回复文本在 `artifacts[0].parts[0].text`。同一 `contextId` 再次调用会复用同一个 DSH agent 会话（多轮记忆）。

流式：

```bash
curl -N -X POST http://127.0.0.1:7310/ \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 2, "method": "message/stream",
  "params": {"message": {"kind": "message", "role": "user",
    "parts": [{"kind": "text", "text": "流式演示"}], "messageId": "m-2", "contextId": "ctx-demo"}}
}'
```

SSE 依次推送 `status-update(working)` → `artifact-update` → `status-update(completed, final=true)` 后自然收流。

## 三、配置项

profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（或本包 `cordis.patch.yml` 默认层）：

```yaml
- id: a2a
  name: '@zyfgood/dsh-a2a'
  config:
    port: 7310
    mode: agent
```

| 配置 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `host` | `127.0.0.1` | 监听地址；公网暴露改 `0.0.0.0` 并配合鉴权 |
| `port` | `7310` | 监听端口（`0` = 系统分配） |
| `publicUrl` | 按监听地址推导 | 写入 Agent Card 的 `url`；反代/TLS 部署时必须配置为外部可达地址 |
| `bearerToken` | 无 | Bearer 鉴权令牌，支持 `env:VAR`；配置后卡片宣告 `bearerAuth` |
| `agentName` / `agentDescription` / `agentVersion` | `DSH Agent` / … | Agent Card 元信息 |
| `skills` | 内置一条 dsh-agent 技能 | Agent Card 技能清单 |
| `mode` | `agent` | 入站处理模式：`agent` / `llm` / `echo`（见下） |
| `provider` / `model` | — | 模型来源：`llm` 模式直答，`agent` 模式创建会话时写入；未配置时回退宿主默认模型（GUI 的默认模型，即 profile 的 `agent-default-model` 分节） |
| `systemPrompt` / `maxHistory` | — | `llm` 模式参数（`ctx.llm` 直答，短期记忆按 `maxHistory`） |
| `agentId` | 自动 | `agent` 模式：固定复用 `ctx.agents` 中某会话；不配置则按 contextId 自动创建 |
| `agentPreset` | GUI 默认预设 | 自动创建会话的 preset（决定 agent 可用的工具集） |
| `workspace` | `process.cwd()` | 自动创建会话的工作目录 |
| `persistSessions` | `true` | contextId → 会话映射落盘（`$DSH_HOME/a2a/`），重启后自动恢复上下文 |
| `turnTimeoutMs` | `600000` | 单轮执行上限，超时任务置 `failed` |
| `taskTtlMs` | `3600000` | 已完结任务内存保留时长（之后 TTL 回收） |
| `tools` | `true` | 是否注册 `a2a_*` 出站工具 |
| `clientAllowPatterns` | `['*']` | 出站白名单：`'*'`、`https://a2a.example.com/`、`https://*.example.com/`、`'*:7310'` |
| `clientTimeoutMs` | `120000` | 出站调用超时 |

### 三种入站模式

- **`agent`（默认）**：每个 A2A `contextId` 对应一个持久 DSH agent 会话（完整工具/技能/工作目录），跨任务续答；映射可落盘跨重启恢复。会话忙时新消息走 `steer`（下一 step 边界消费）。
- **`llm`**：`ctx.llm` 直答（自包含轻量模式，不建 agent 会话，短期记忆按 `maxHistory`）。
- **`echo`**：回显原文，验证链路。

## 四、出站：agent 调用远端 A2A

插件默认注册 4 个模型工具（`tools: false` 关闭）：

| 工具 | 对应协议方法 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| `a2a_discover` | `GET /.well-known/agent-card.json` | 拉取远端 Agent Card（能力/技能/鉴权） |
| `a2a_send` | `message/stream`（自动降级 `message/send` + 轮询） | 发消息并等待远端最终回复 |
| `a2a_task_status` | `tasks/get` | 查询远端任务状态 |
| `a2a_cancel` | `tasks/cancel` | 取消远端任务 |

对话示例：「用 a2a_send 呼叫 http://其它机器:7310/ 的 agent，问它有哪些技能，把结果汇总给我」。

## 五、开发

```bash
pnpm verify   # 本地 typecheck（shims/ 提供 @deepseek-ai 结构类型）
pnpm test     # 构建 DSH 无关核心 + 35 项端到端冒烟测试
pnpm build:local  # 本地全量构建 lib/（shims 类型校验，产物与宿主构建一致）
pnpm build    # 完整构建（需要宿主环境提供 @deepseek-ai/* peer 依赖）
```

代码结构：

```
src/
├── index.ts       插件入口：Config schema + apply()
├── protocol.ts    A2A 类型 / JSON-RPC / Agent Card（纯函数，零依赖）
├── store.ts       任务存储 + SSE 事件中枢（事件缓冲、订阅、TTL）
├── server.ts      HTTP 服务器：card / message/send / message/stream(SSE) / tasks/* / admin/*
├── bridge.ts      DSH 桥接：echo / llm / agent 三种 TaskRunner
├── client.ts      出站 A2A 客户端（fetch + SSE 解析）
├── tools.ts       a2a_* 模型工具注册
└── persistence.ts contextId → 会话映射落盘
client/
└── client.js      浏览器半：A2A 运维面板（免构建 ModuleLoader 工厂，react 为宿主 external）
```

设计说明：

- `protocol` / `store` / `server` / `client` 不依赖任何 DSH 包，可独立构建与测试；DSH 桥接收敛在 `bridge.ts` / `tools.ts` / `index.ts`。
- **agent 模式必须有模型**：agent-loop 不自动兜底 provider/model，缺失时提示词组装里的 `{{model}}` 无值，每轮立即报错（表现为「无文本输出」）。插件因此按「配置 provider/model → 回退 `ctx.agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()`」解析，两者都拿不到时直接返回明确的失败说明；本轮若以 `turn/end reason=error` 结束，错误原因会被回给客户端而不是笼统占位符。改 profile 的默认模型后，新建的 A2A 会话即生效（已存在的会话沿用原模型，删 `$DSH_HOME/a2a/context-sessions.json` 条目可重建）。
- 任务 id 参数：规范写法 `params.id` 与本插件旧约定 `params.taskId` 都接受（`tasks/get` / `tasks/cancel` / `tasks/resubscribe`）。
- `input-required` 事件带 `final=true` 关闭当轮 SSE，但任务保持非终态，客户端可凭 `taskId` 续答（续答复用同一任务与 history）。
- `tasks/cancel` 立即广播 `canceled(final=true)`；agent 模式下正在运行的一轮会在 500ms 轮询粒度感知退出并尽力 `interrupt`，不会阻塞后续轮次。
- 与 A2A 0.2.x 客户端的兼容：旧 card 路径照常服务；0.2 客户端不发送版本头时按同版本处理。
- 不支持的协议面按规范返回明确错误码：push notification `-32003`、批量 JSON-RPC `-32600`。

## 六、与 DSH 内置能力的关系

| 需求 | 用什么 |
|---|---|
| 程序化驱动 DSH agent（进程外） | 内置 ACP（`dsh-acp`，`pnpm dsh --profile acp`） |
| 挂载外部工具/资源 | 内置 MCP 客户端 |
| 跨 agent 生态互操作（Google ADK / A2A SDK） | **本插件** |

## License

MIT

# dsh-sidechat

[English](README_EN.md) · 中文

DSH 侧边聊天插件：从主会话 fork 独立侧聊，划选引用并添加注释，将结论回流到主会话。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:kkisok0123/dsh-sidechat
```

本仓库包含源码和预编译的 `lib/`，GitHub 安装无需在用户机器上编译。安装后重启 `dsh web` 并刷新窗口。

如果已经安装 `dsh-sidenote`，请先移除旧插件，再安装本插件，避免重复入口：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-sidenote
```

进入已有回复的会话，点击顶栏「侧边」，或在输入框使用 `/side`，打开右侧栏中的插件面板。

## 功能

- 独立侧聊继承主会话完整历史，主线与侧聊分别运行。
- 侧聊语义与 Codex `/side` 对齐：首条消息注入边界协议块（继承历史仅作参照、侧聊是独立助手：默认非改写、不碰子代理、不主动请求越权），面板以「侧边会话边界」卡呈现。
- DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 上复用宿主原生 Conversation Factory，包括消息、工具、模型、权限及输入框；旧宿主使用插件自绘面板。
- 模型菜单刷新并显示提供方，切换模型后恢复输入焦点。
- 划选 assistant 正文：「添加到对话」保留可选注解编辑器；「在侧边聊天中提问」直接打开/聚焦侧聊、加入选中文字引用并聚焦输入框，不弹注解框、不覆盖草稿、不自动发送。打开失败时保留选中文字，可重试或取消。
- 临时侧聊在当前浏览器的会话列表中隐藏，可重开；保存为正式会话时创建可见副本。
- 侧聊结论可作为引用回流到主会话。

下面是右侧栏布局示例。实际消息与输入框样式随宿主版本、主题和原生渲染模式变化；它不是宿主自带的浮动侧边对话窗口。

![右侧栏布局示例](docs/assets/04-side-chat-panel.png)

## 兼容性

当前包保留原插件的引擎声明，使用 Node.js 20 及以上。原生会话渲染针对 DSH **0.2.0-rc.2** 实现；引擎范围不代表所有组合都已验证。

## 开发

```bash
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm check:arch
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build
pnpm check:package
```

修改源码后，将对应 `lib/` 一并提交。CI 重建并检查构建产物与已提交版本一致，以保持 GitHub 直接安装可用。

## 来源与许可

本插件基于 [gyixuan 的 dsh-sidenote](https://github.com/g-yixuan/dsh-sidenote) 改进。感谢原作者提供侧边聊天、划选注释及回流能力的基础实现。本项目不是从零原创，也不是上游官方发行版。

本分支主要改进了宿主原生会话渲染、侧聊边界协议、划选后直接在侧聊提问、模型切换与输入焦点恢复，以及 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.4 兼容性。具体功能和限制见上文。

保留原作者 `Copyright (c) 2026 gyixuan` 与完整 [MIT 许可](LICENSE)。本仓库从独立源码快照建立，未继承原 Git 提交历史；后续改进由本仓库维护者负责。

# Hackathon -- Plug-In

本仓库是 **DSH 黑客松的插件方向**工作区（远程仓库
[kirahvi03/Hackathon--Plug-In](https://github.com/kirahvi03/Hackathon--Plug-In)）。
内容分两部分：

1. **本机开发环境**的配置与自检脚本（第 1–3 节）
2. **DSH 插件**：骨架 `plugins/hackathon-starter/` 与参赛作品
   `plugins/dsh-intent-translator/`（第 4 节）

游戏方向的仓库在另一处：[Hackathon--Game](https://github.com/kirahvi03/Hackathon--Game)
（本地路径 `..\hackathon-game`）。

插件体系的完整研究报告见 [`docs/dsh-plugin-development-report.md`](docs/dsh-plugin-development-report.md)
（58KB，含官方 API 导出名、slot key 目录、模板出处与未能确定事项清单）。

---

## 1. 环境总览

| 组件 | 版本 | 位置 / 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Node.js | v24.21.0 | `C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe`（系统安装，已在 PATH 中） |
| npm | 11.19.0 | 随 Node 提供 |
| pnpm | 11.7.0 | 由 `~\.dsh\bin\pnpm.cmd` 转发到 DSH 内置 pnpm 11.7.0 |
| Python | 3.12.14 | DSH 内置解释器，已通过 PATH 前置覆盖失效的商店别名 |
| pip | 26.2.1 | `~\.dsh\bin\pip.cmd` → `python -m pip` |
| Git | 2.55.0 | `C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe` |
| GitHub 凭据 | 已就绪 | Git Credential Manager 2.9.1，账号 `kirahvi03` |
| VS Code | 1.140.0 | 命令行入口 `code` 可用 |
| ffmpeg | 7.1.1 | 已在 PATH 中 |

未安装（按需再补）：`gh`（GitHub CLI）、`docker`、PowerShell 7（`pwsh`）。

Python 预装库：`numpy` 2.3.5、`pandas` 3.0.1、`openpyxl` 3.1.5、`XlsxWriter` 3.2.9、
`python-docx` 1.2.0、`python-pptx` 1.0.2、`Pillow` 12.3.0、`lxml` 6.1.3。

---

## 2. 本次为环境做的改动

1. **修复 Python**：PATH 上原本只有 Microsoft Store 的 `python.exe` 占位符（执行即失败）。
   现已把可用的 DSH 内置解释器目录前置到用户 PATH。
2. **补上 pnpm**：`pnpm` 之前不在 PATH 上。新增 `~\.dsh\bin\pnpm.cmd`、`pnpx.cmd` shim，
   指向 DSH 内置 pnpm，并把 `~\.dsh\bin` 加到用户 PATH 最前面。
3. **补上 pip 入口**：内置 Python 的 `Scripts` 目录没有可执行文件，新增 `pip.cmd` shim。
4. **PowerShell 执行策略**：当前用户范围设为 `RemoteSigned`，本地脚本可直接运行。
5. **初始化本仓库**：`main` 分支、`.gitignore`、`.gitattributes`。
6. **GitHub 凭据**：全局 `credential.helper = manager`，`git push` 无需再次登录。

> 以上 PATH 改动写入的是**用户级**环境变量。已打开的终端需要重开一次才能生效。

---

## 3. 快速开始

### 3.1 环境自检

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\env-check.ps1
```

全部通过时退出码为 0，并逐项打印各工具的实际版本与路径。缺少可选项（`gh`/`docker`）只告警。

### 3.2 Web / Node 项目

```powershell
pnpm init                 # 或 pnpm create vite my-app
pnpm add -D typescript    # 依赖安装
pnpm dev                  # 跑开发服务器
```

> 用 `npm` 也可以，但本工作区统一用 `pnpm` 以节省磁盘并避免依赖提升问题。

### 3.3 Python 项目

全局解释器可直接用；做正式项目建议建虚拟环境，避免污染内置环境：

```powershell
python -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

> 若激活脚本被执行策略拦截，先运行
> `Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Force`。

### 3.4 推送到 GitHub

远程仓库已接好并完成首次推送：

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| 仓库 | <https://github.com/kirahvi03/Hackathon--Plug-In>（public） |
| remote | `origin` |
| 分支 | `main`，已设置上游跟踪 `origin/main` |

日常提交：

```powershell
git add -A
git commit -m "feat: ..."
git push
```

认证由 Git Credential Manager 自动完成（本机已存 `kirahvi03` 的 token，含 `repo` + `workflow` 权限），
正常情况不会再弹出登录。

---

## 4. DSH 插件：骨架与参赛作品

### 4.1 插件骨架（`plugins/hackathon-starter/`）

本机 DSH 是 **0.2.1-rc.2**，插件框架为 **Cordis 4**。一个插件包 = 一个 bundle，
由 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`，后者把插件行 insert 进 profile 的插件树。

骨架同时演示两个扩展点：

| 半边 | 文件 | 内容 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host | `index.js` | 具名导出 `{ Config, apply, inject, name }`，用 `ctx.tools.register(defineTool({...}))` 注册工具 `plugin_ping` |
| Client | `client.js` | `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` + `ctx.slots.register` 往 `conversation.composer.dock` 插一个徽标 |

每个 API 字段都对照官方实现 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo` 抄写（不是猜测）：
`name` / `description` / `parameters` / `output.{schema,render}` / `execute(args, exec)` / `presentCall(args)`。

**语法自检**（无需安装任何依赖）：

```powershell
node --check .\plugins\hackathon-starter\index.js
node --check .\plugins\hackathon-starter\client.js
```

**安装到 profile**（转发给内置 pnpm，必须用绝对路径）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "C:\Users\19371\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\plugins\hackathon-starter"
```

> ⚠️ 尚未替你执行安装：`desktop` 是当前运行中的这个应用独占管理的 profile，
> 安装后需重启才生效，可能打断正在进行的会话。要装的话说一声。

> ℹ️ 官方包（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 等）**不在 npm 上**，它们打包在 `app.asar` 内。
> 插件通过 `peerDependencies` 声明版本要求，由宿主提供实现，因此**不要自己 `pnpm add` 这些包**。

### 4.2 参赛作品：`plugins/dsh-intent-translator/`

面向 vibecoding 的**意图翻译器**：用亮蓝色 `#66ccff` 标出输入里的 1–3 处模糊描述，
每一处独立分叉成 2–3 个「人话方向」卡片；点选一张只替换它所属的模糊片段，
「背景有图片」这类确定信息原样保留。支持撤回和「换一组」。

![意图翻译器多片段候选卡片](plugins/dsh-intent-translator/docs/preview.png)

| 项 | 位置 / 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 工具行按钮 | `conversation.input.left`，与 `dsh-prompt-optimizer` 的 ✨ 同槽位 |
| 候选卡片 | `conversation.input.dock`，输入框上方 |
| Host | `lib/host.js`：`ctx.webServer` 路由 + `ctx.llm.stream()`，15s 超时 |
| 纯逻辑 | `lib/engine.js`：多片段校验、人话标签守卫、方向去重、span 定位与替换 |
| Client | `client.src.js` → `client.js`：按钮、卡片、`#66ccff` 高亮、逐段替换、撤回、换一组 |
| 完整说明 | [`plugins/dsh-intent-translator/README.md`](plugins/dsh-intent-translator/README.md) |
| 实现计划 | [`docs/dsh-intent-translator-plan.md`](docs/dsh-intent-translator-plan.md) |

安装到 `desktop` profile（需要重启一次让 Host 新行生效）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "C:\path\to\Hackathon--Plug-In\plugins\dsh-intent-translator"
```

验证：

```powershell
cd plugins\dsh-intent-translator
npm test        # 构建 client.js，再跑 34 个 Node 测试
```

V2 只预留接口：点选方向后可通过 `ctx` 调用 `dsh-prompt-optimizer` 精修，
V1 不自动调用，也不复制其代码。详见插件 README。

---

## 5. 注意事项

- **不要在 DSH 会话里直接 `.\script.ps1`**：DSH 托管的 shell 对脚本加载有额外限制，
  会报 “未对文件进行数字签名”。加上 `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass` 用子进程运行即可：
  `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\env-check.ps1`。
  你自己开的普通终端不受此限制。
- **不要 `pip install` 到内置 Python 之外**：`python` 已指向 DSH 内置解释器，
  装包会写进 DSH 的 `site-packages`。长期项目用 `.venv` 隔离。
- **密钥不入库**：`.gitignore` 已覆盖 `.env`、`*.pem`、`credentials.json` 等；
  需要提交样例时用 `.env.example`。
- **行尾符**：`.gitattributes` 统一仓库内为 LF，Windows 下工作区仍可用 CRLF。

---

## 6. 目录结构

```
.
├─ README.md                              本文件
├─ .gitignore                             忽略规则（Node / Python / 密钥 / 编辑器）
├─ .gitattributes                         行尾符与二进制文件规则
├─ docs/
│  ├─ dsh-plugin-development-report.md    DSH 插件开发研究报告（58KB）
│  └─ dsh-intent-translator-plan.md       意图翻译器实现计划
├─ plugins/
│  ├─ hackathon-starter/                  ← 插件骨架
│  │  ├─ package.json                     bundle 清单（dsh.bundle.patch / dsh.client）
│  │  ├─ cordis.patch.yml                 把插件行 insert 进 profile
│  │  ├─ index.js                         Host 半边：注册 plugin_ping 工具
│  │  ├─ client.js                        Client 半边：输入框下方徽标
│  │  ├─ icon.svg                         插件卡片图标
│  │  ├─ locale/{zh,en}.json              显示名称与描述
│  │  └─ README.md                        骨架的改造指引
│  └─ dsh-intent-translator/              ← 参赛作品：意图翻译器
│     ├─ package.json                     bundle + dsh.client + peerDependencies
│     ├─ cordis.patch.yml                 Host 行 insert
│     ├─ index.js                         Host 入口
│     ├─ lib/{engine,host}.js             纯逻辑 + 路由/LLM/超时
│     ├─ client.src.js → client.js        Client 源码与构建产物
│     ├─ scripts/build-client.mjs         零依赖构建（内联 engine.js）
│     ├─ test/*.test.mjs                  34 个 Node 测试
│     ├─ docs/preview.png                 验收截图（居中悬浮面板）
│     └─ README.md                        安装/配置/数据契约/V2 边界
└─ scripts/
   └─ env-check.ps1                       环境自检脚本
```

plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-agent-scope

**Agent 权限边界** —— 查 agent 的工具/文件/网络权限有没有声明、是不是过宽。

## 不装它会怎样

你的 MCP 配置长这样：

```json
"filesystem": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "/"] },
"everything": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "mcp-everything"], "allowedTools": ["*"] }
```

**看起来是「配置齐全」，实际上：**

```
① 文件访问路径是 /       → agent 能读写你所有文件（含 ~/.ssh、~/.aws）
② allowedTools: ["*"]    → agent 能调用所有工具（读文件、执行命令、发请求）
③ allowedDomains: "*"    → 被注入后能把数据发到任意地址
```

**Agent 的权限就是它的爆炸半径。** 一旦被提示注入控制，
它能做的事 = **你给它的全部权限**。

OWASP 把这归为 **LLM06 Excessive Agency**。

## 关键词
**关键词**：Agent 权限 · 工具权限 · 权限边界 · 最小权限 · MCP 权限 · 沙箱 · 白名单 · 爆炸半径
**Keywords**: agent scope · tool permissions · least privilege · MCP security · excessive agency · sandbox

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 | 依据 |
|---|---|---|
| 🔴 高 | 工具权限用通配符 `*` | 最小权限（NIST SP 800-53 AC-6）|
| 🔴 高 | 文件访问是 `/` / `~` / 整个用户目录 | MCP 文档 · 目录限制建议 |
| 🟡 中 | 网络访问无限制 | OWASP **LLM06 Excessive Agency** |
| 🟡 中 | 配置里**找不到任何权限声明** | 最小权限 · 权限应显式声明 |

## 「没有声明」为什么危险

**没有声明通常等于默认全开** —— 而用户看到的只是一个「很干净」的配置文件，
不会意识到 agent 能做所有事。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-agent-scope
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-agent-scope
```

![dsh-agent-scope 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-agent-scope/report.png)

![dsh-agent-scope 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-agent-scope/demo.png)

![dsh-agent-scope 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-agent-scope/rules.png)

## 用法

```bash
dsh-agent-scope --demo
dsh-agent-scope --list-rules
dsh-agent-scope --html r.html
```

## 边界

- **只审配置，不审 agent 实现** —— agent 代码里怎么用这些权限，本工具看不到。
- **不判断「给得够不够」** —— 只查「有没有声明、有没有明显过宽」。
  权限偏大但没用通配符的情况需要人工评审。
- **配置位置各客户端不同** —— 按常见路径找（mcp.json / .mcp.json / settings.json / claude_desktop_config.json）。
- **沙箱是否真生效** 需要运行时验证，不在范围内。
- 与 [dsh-mcp-audit](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) 分工：
  那个查 MCP **服务来源**（未锁版本/明文端点），这个查 MCP **权限边界**。
- 与 [dsh-least-privilege](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-least-privilege) 分工：
  那个查**容器/云/Web** 权限，这个查 **agent** 权限。

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**

---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 38 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规**（12）｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin for Sub2api account quotas and usage monitoring
plugins.readme_text:
# sub2api Account Usage Monitor

English | [中文](<docs/zh.md>)

`dsh-sub2api-monitor` is a DSH desktop plugin compatible with DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`. It provides only a usage entry in the conversation title bar, with no sidebar entry, full page, or centered dialog. The title-bar popover has a maximum width of 700px and adapts to the viewport, balancing two-column cards with readability. Clicking outside, pressing Esc, or clicking Close dismisses it; clicking inside does not. It does not modify DSH core or start additional processes or HTTP services.

## Data and refresh

The Host reads the paginated account list, each account's `/usage`, and `/today-stats` through the management API. It refreshes every 60 seconds by default, processing at most 3 accounts concurrently. The Client reads the local cache every 10 seconds; manual refresh has a minimum interval of 10 seconds. All timers and requests are disposed of on plugin unload. Operations are read-only: the plugin does not call account start/stop, credential refresh, or quota-reset endpoints.

- Quota windows: 5-hour, 7-day, and upstream Sonnet/Opus windows, showing usage percentages and relative reset times, with full timestamps on hover. Anthropic explicitly uses `source=passive`, matching the site's passive sampling; the default active endpoint may omit weekly quotas.
- Compact, responsive cards retain today's statistics and abbreviate large numbers. The top explanation area and search box are removed; synchronization status appears as a title-bar dot.
- Subscription type: only allowlisted scalar values from `credentials.plan_type` are extracted, displayed separately from authentication methods such as OAuth. `promax` is shown as the site's corresponding `Pro 500`; missing values display “Unknown subscription”. The credentials object is never passed through.
- Today's requests, tokens, and cost use the Shanghai time zone. Costs use sub2api's accounting basis and are not equivalent to the provider's actual bill.
- Highlights at 80%/95%; the conversation summary counts accounts needing attention. System notifications are not currently sent.
- Unknown fields remain unknown. Partial failures are marked separately; list failures retain old data with a stale indicator. Upstream snapshots may predate collection; source timestamps are shown when supplied by the API.

## Account details

Click a card (or press Enter/Space) to open details within the same popover; Back returns to the list. Details load `/admin/accounts/:id/stats?days=30&timezone=Asia%2FShanghai` only on demand, cache for 60 seconds, and coalesce concurrent requests. Only known collected account IDs are accepted, redirects are rejected, and the Host projects allowlisted fields. No historical database or background history polling is added.

The view shows period totals, reported window length and recorded date range, daily request/Token/account-cost bars, model ranking by Token with expandable input/output/cache composition, active-day averages, peak days, and mean request duration. Missing dates are not filled with zeros. This covers only calls through sub2api; costs are not subscription bills, and mean duration is not time to first token. Account costs use `actual_cost` for daily records and `account_cost` for models; missing fields stay unknown. Errors offer retry; leaving details aborts the UI request, while shared Host work is bounded by timeout and unload cancellation.

## Installation and plugin configuration

Install the npm package `dsh-sub2api-monitor` in DSH's Plugins page. Open the configuration form in the plugin details, fill in the following fields, and save. Configuration is embedded directly in the plugin information page rather than registering a host settings page; the Configuration button at the top of the usage popover also opens it. DSH's settings service writes configuration to the profile; no plugin source edits are needed. The read endpoint returns only non-sensitive fields, the credential reference name, and whether a key is set. Leaving the key input blank preserves the existing value; the first save requires a key. Saves use revisions to detect concurrent conflicts and do not automatically overwrite changes from another window.

Disable the old `sub2api-monitor` and earlier `myspace-sub2api-monitor` packages before enabling the new package to avoid duplicate collection. After moving parameters into plugin configuration, uninstall the old package. Both the component ID and configuration namespace are `dsh-sub2api-monitor`; connection configuration is managed only by the DSH profile. When upgrading to 0.1.0, also replace the old component ID in the profile with the new ID while preserving its config fields; do not just swap packages and lose configuration.

- `baseUrl`: the site's API address, including `/api/v1`.
- `adminApiKeyEnv`: credential reference (environment-variable-style name) for the administrator API key; default `SUB2API_ADMIN_API_KEY`. The profile stores only this name. A key entered in the form is written to the DSH credentials service (`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` with the local provider), not to plugin configuration. The process environment or a `.env` file can also supply it; an inherited environment value is read-only and disables the key input.
- `allowInsecureHttp`: off by default; enable only after explicitly accepting plaintext risks.
- `intervalSeconds`: 30–3600 seconds; default 60 seconds.
- `primaryAccounts`: select multiple accounts from a checkbox list loaded automatically from the unfiltered Host cache. Refresh Accounts fetches upstream data using the saved connection (10-second cooldown). Missing selected accounts are retained; failures never clear selections. Internally stored as exact names, empty by default. Primary cards show a badge.
- `primaryFirst`: defaults to true; places primary accounts before the selected secondary ordering.
- `displayFilter`: `all`, `primary`, `available`, or `attention`. Attention includes unavailable accounts, failed usage/statistics requests, and usage at or above 80%.
- `sortBy`: `available` (default), `name`, `usage-desc`, or `usage-asc`. Usage sorting compares the highest known usage percentage across windows; unknown values sort last. Filtering does not change upstream collection. Settings persist in the profile and are applied to subsequent cache reads. The title-bar count reflects the filtered set; the web dashboard remains independent.

Only the Host resolves the key, once per request, so rotation takes effect on the next refresh without a restart. It is never injected into the Client module, usage endpoint, or profile. The credentials file is plaintext with owner-only permissions; it is not disk encryption.

```json
{
  "baseUrl": "https://your-sub2api.example/api/v1",
  "adminApiKeyEnv": "SUB2API_ADMIN_API_KEY",
  "allowInsecureHttp": false,
  "intervalSeconds": 60
}
```

Set `allowInsecureHttp` to `true` only after explicitly accepting plaintext transport risks. To rotate the key, enter a new one in the form, or update the credential through the DSH credentials service; no reinstallation is needed.

Upgrading from 0.1.x: the plaintext `adminApiKey` field has been removed. Move its value into the credentials service under `SUB2API_ADMIN_API_KEY` (or re-enter it in the form), then delete `adminApiKey` from the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.

The old standalone JSON configuration and `SUB2API_MONITOR_CONFIG` environment variable are no longer read. Delete the old configuration file after migration, keeping plugin configuration as the single authority.

Upstream redirects are rejected to prevent key leakage. The frontend receives only allowlisted display fields, excluding credentials, extra, notes, and raw errors.

The local `/sub2api-monitor/api` accepts only loopback requests, a valid local Host, a same-origin Origin when present, and the custom header `X-Sub2api-Monitor: 1`. CORS is not enabled. Remote browsers and cross-machine connections are not currently supported.

## Installation and verification

The only dependency is the official `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` configuration schema package; there is no generation step

plugins.description: The machine's non-pwsh execution surfaces as one DSH tool: a WSL Linux userland, nushell's structured pipelines, the MSYS2 userland (bash/zsh/fish/brush), and a real console for interactive programs.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-shell-surfaces

[![test](https://github.com/Nesarf/dsh-shell-surfaces/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Nesarf/dsh-shell-surfaces/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![licence: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/licence-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

`https://github.com/Nesarf/dsh-shell-surfaces` -- a DSH plugin, installed with
`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Nesarf/dsh-shell-surfaces`.

The badge is the whole test workflow: the pure self-test, and the two-runner
probe that asks every shell on Windows and on Linux what it is. A green badge
therefore means "the table and the argv shape still hold, and both platforms
still answered", not just "the linter passed".

One DSH tool for the execution surfaces this machine has: a WSL Linux userland,
nushell's structured pipelines, the MSYS2 userland (bash / zsh / fish / brush),
PowerShell itself, and a real console for interactive programs.

It exists because a rule that is only written down is not a capability. The
selection rules for these surfaces have been recorded for a while, but a session
could only act on them by composing a command string for pwsh and hoping the
quoting survived the trip. Here they are callable.

```
shell_surfaces(action="surfaces")                    what exists here, and where each was looked for
shell_surfaces(action="run", surface="wsl",  command="grep -P '(?<=Linux )[0-9.]+' /proc/version")
shell_surfaces(action="run", surface="nu",   command="open data.json | where n > 3 | to json")
shell_surfaces(action="run", surface="msys", command="pacman -Q | wc -l")
shell_surfaces(action="run", surface="pwsh", command="Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object Caption")
shell_surfaces(action="run", surface="pty",  command="powershell -File install.ps1", send=["y\n"])
```

## PowerShell is a surface here

"Fall back to pwsh" used to mean "leave this tool and use the other one". The
`pwsh` surface closes that gap: a PowerShell command is an ordinary call here,
the same shape as every other surface, so a session that hits an awkward
surface does not have to change its tool to get a PowerShell job done.

What this surface deliberately does **not** carry, and the built-in `pwsh` tool
does, is approval and sandbox escalation, and a persistent session. Those are
reasons to use that tool and not this surface -- but "the command is PowerShell"
is not one of them.

A surface-level failure is also not a reason to change tools. When a surface is
absent, cannot spawn, or times out, the tool says so and names the next call
(`action="surfaces"`) that stays inside this plugin; the failure is about the
surface, not about the tool.

## Background work stays here too

`run_in_background: true` starts the command as a job and returns its id: the
output ring streams it, `job_output` reads it, `job_kill` stops it. No timeout
applies. `promote_on_timeout: true` turns a timeout into that same job instead of
killing the process -- the output collected before the budget expired is handed
over exactly once, and the rest keeps streaming.

That is why the built-in `pwsh` tool now covers only approval/sandbox escalation
and the persistent session: the job machinery no longer sends a session back to
it. A composition without the `jobs` service gets a refusal sentence for a
background request rather than a job nobody can collect, and the `pty` surface
has no background mode at all, because a console transcript is read while the
program is alive.

## The same sandbox as the built-in shell tools

A confined deployment confines this tool too. Each call resolves the session's
policy through `ctx.sandboxPolicy`, wraps the exact argv it is about to spawn
through `ctx.sandbox.confine`, and reports the mode, enforcement and denial facts
in the same vocabulary the built-in shell tools use. `danger-full-access` never
consults the provider, and a composition without the sandbox services runs
exactly as before.

A file effect the mode denies is a policy answer, not a command failure.
`sandbox_permissions` plus `justification` asks `ctx.approval` for exactly one
wider call -- the grant is consumed by that call and never persisted -- and an
escalation that is refused, cancelled or has no approval channel stops before
anything runs. The same-turn denial hint rides the tool result, so the sanctioned
retry does not depend on recalling the description.

## Persistent sessions

Pass `session: <name>` to run a command inside one long-lived shell per (agent,
surface, name): the current directory, variables and modules persist across
calls, and `session_reset: true` starts a fresh one. The session is a process
with a pipe, not a terminal -- a random nonce line marks where one command's
output ends, which is the only signal every supported shell (`pwsh`, `msys`)
prints without a prompt. A session runs one command at a time, so the job flags
are refused with it, and `pty` has no session at all: a console transcript is
read while the program is alive.

## Finding this machine's shells

The table is a set of defaults, and the scan is what makes them true on a
machine that moved its installs. The model is borrowed from
mega-index-map's `library_detect`: a built-in candidate table (shell names, the
usual install roots, the WSL launcher) resolved against PATH and this machine's
own locations, with every hit carrying where it was found. A scan costs one
PATH listing per directory plus a few `stat` calls and one `wsl -l -q` -- it is
not a walk of the drive.

What the scan adds to the table:

| Found | Becomes |
|---|---|
| a WSL distribution other than the default | its own `wsl-<distro>` surface |
| a Git-for-Windows or Cygwin bash | a `git-bash` surface (the MSYS2 one keeps `msys`) |
| `cmd.exe` | a `cmd` surface (`cmd /c`) |
| a terminal program (`wt`, `mintty`, `wezterm`, ...) | reported in `action="surfaces"` under `discovered`, not a surface: a terminal draws text, it does not interpret commands |

`action="surfaces"` answers with both halves: the surfaces this tool can run
now, and the `discovered` report (kind, name, path, source) the scan produced.
A discovered path also replaces a guessed default, so a machine whose
PowerShell lives outside `Program Files` still answers.

## Why one tool and not seven

Every registered tool spends part of the context on its description. Seven tools
would say the same thing seven times. The selection rules -- which surface for a
structured pipe, which for a Linux-only tool, which for a program that waits for
input -- live in this one description, and a session reads them exactly when it
is choosing.

This tool is the **first choice** for running a command, not a fallback for
"exceptional" cases: a job that needs a Linux tool, a POSIX pipeline, another
shell language, a structured pipe, a real console -- or PowerShell itself --
belongs on its surface. One prompt section says that, placed ahead of the pwsh
rule, because a tool description only speaks once the catalogue is already open.
Wrapping another shell inside a `pwsh` command line stays the thing to avoid: the
extra quoting layer is where paths get mangled.

## The row a call renders as

A `shell_surfaces` call used to render as the wire tool name --
"工具调用 · shell_surfaces · wsl" -- which names the catalogue entry rather than
the machine surface or the command. The plugin now ships a client half
(`lib/client.js`) that registers a `tool.call.toolview` row for this tool, so a
call reads as the sentence it is:

```
WSL · grep -P '(?<=Linux )[0-9.]+' /proc/version      完成 · 120ms
zsh · ls                                            1 · 12ms
conPTY · cmd /c ver                                  运行中
shells · 列出可用 surface                             完成
```

The surface name is at the head, the activity beside it, the exit status at the
end, and the captured output one click away. That is a client concern rather
than a host result: the pending row must already name its surface before any
output exists. Nothing patches a first-party package -- `tool.call.toolview` is
the supported keyed seam, and the stock row remains the fallback for every other
tool.

## What it is not

* **No message hooks.** It registers a t

# DSH Plugin Scout

[English](README.md) | [中文](docs/zh.md)

[![ci](https://github.com/fegnze/dsh-plugin-scout/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/fegnze/dsh-plugin-scout/actions/workflows/ci.yml) · MIT

Discover and verify DeepSeek Harness plugins published under the GitHub topic `dsh-plugin`, from inside DSH. Plugins are grouped by purpose, ranked by trust score, and checked against the official peer-compatibility rule. Supports DSH **0.2.x** (`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`); tested on desktop 0.2.0-rc.2.

> The in-app UI is currently Chinese only. The plugin's title and description in the official Plugins page are localized (`locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json`).

## Install

Open the official **Plugins** page → **Add plugin**, and enter one of:

| Spec | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh-plugin-scout` | Recommended. Prebuilt npm package with provenance; no install scripts, no build approval needed |
| Absolute path of a prebuilt `dsh-plugin-scout-<version>.tgz`, if supplied with a release | Bypasses the npm registry; the current tag workflow creates release notes only and does not attach a tarball |

From the CLI: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-plugin-scout`. Enable it on the Plugins page, then open **Plugins → Scout**. The tab is labeled **Scout** in both languages; no sidebar entry is added. The official **Discover** tab is unchanged.

Do not install from `github:fegnze/dsh-plugin-scout`: a git install fetches source without `lib/`, and this repository deliberately ships no `prepare` script.

## Native Discover index

Add this URL in the official **Plugins → Discover → Index sources** dialog:

```text
https://fegnze.github.io/dsh-plugin-scout/index.json
```

This is a format-1 catalog, not an embedded Scout page. You do not need to install Scout to browse it. GitHub Actions rebuilds it daily at 03:23 UTC and on generator changes, then deploys only after the official DSH validator accepts the document. Failed generation leaves the previous deployment intact.

The public catalog contains deduplicated npm bundles compatible with the target DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, with a matching repository, no install hooks, and advertised provenance. Archived, risky, version-drifted, stale or incomplete entries are excluded. Forks retain a source label. Provenance presence is not cryptographic verification or a security guarantee. Each entry pins the npm version and uses npm's real release time; the official installer remains the final authority. The target runtime is a publishing policy, not a compatibility claim for every DSH release.

Generate from public GitHub/npm data with `GH_TOKEN=<read-only-token> node scripts/generate-market.mjs`. `MARKET_OUTPUT`, `SCOUT_CACHE`, and `DSH_TARGET` override the output, disposable crawl cache, and target runtime. No local profile or user cache is published. The generated `site/index.json` and crawl cache are ignored by Git; CI uploads only the public catalog as the Pages artifact. Adding the source remains your explicit action; Scout does not alter configured index sources.

## One-click install, through the official installer

The **Install** button in the details drawer takes the same path as the official **Add plugin**: `inspect` first, then `installBundle(spec, {enabled: false, requestId, registry})`. Installed plugins start **disabled**; **Enable** is a separate click (`setBundleEnabled`).

- Plugins with install hooks, or whose DSH peers do not cover the running version, need a second click to install.
- When the official installer blocks dependency build scripts (`pendingBuilds`), they are listed by name; a double click on **Allow and reinstall** retries with `approvedBuilds`.
- **Cancel install** calls `cancelInstall` with the same `requestId`; a lost reply is recovered with `waitForInstall`. On failure the official installer restores `package.json` and the lockfile.
- **Uninstalling and version exemptions stay on the official Plugins page.** Scout never calls `removeBundle`; the tests fail if it does. Without the official `pluginManager`, the Install button is hidden and the drawer falls back to "copy pinned spec + open the Plugins page".

## Data sources (first-party only)

| Source | Used for |
| --- | --- |
| GitHub GraphQL `search(topic:dsh-plugin)` | Repository metadata, root `package.json`, `cordis.patch.yml` text (never evaluated) |
| `registry.npmjs.org/<name>/latest` | The manifest that would actually be installed: peers, install hooks, `repository`, provenance |
| Official `pluginManager.listBundles` / `inspect` | Installed state; the official pre-install check (resolves only, runs no code) |
| Official `pluginManager.installBundle` / `waitForInstall` / `cancelInstall` / `setBundleEnabled` | One-click install (disabled by default), cancel, separate enable; progress from `plugin-manager/install-state` and `install-log` events |

No third-party marketplace or aggregator is used. Topic searches explicitly use `fork:true` to include both original repositories and forks; forks retain their source notice and undergo the same checks. After upgrading from 0.1.5 or earlier, use **Rebuild full index** once to discover older forks omitted by the previous search scope.

**Crawling, measured (2026-10):** the topic holds about 19,000 repositories, 12,700 of them created in August, many of them same-name copies. GitHub search returns at most 1,000 results per query, so Scout bisects time windows adaptively (≤900 results per window, 60 s minimum window). Pages are 50 items: 100-item pages return 502 in dense windows, so on 502 the page size steps down to 25, then 10, resuming from the same cursor. Later runs crawl incrementally by `pushed`.

**Refresh is streaming and pays only for what changed:**
- **Newest first.** Windows are seeded geometrically (last 6 h / 1 d / 3 d / 1 w / 1 mo / 3 mo / older) and paged from the newest. Window counting and paging overlap (3 workers).
- **Publish while crawling.** Each page is merged into the record set immediately and published every 1.5 s; the UI reloads the list when `status.rev` changes. The previous index stays usable throughout. A checkpoint is written every 30 s.
- **Pay for change.** With an existing index, a light query fetches metadata only (100 per page, no blobs). Repositories whose `pushedAt` is unchanged keep their facts and only refresh stars and similar metadata; changed ones fetch `package.json` and the patch by node id in batches of 50.
- **npm in parallel.** npm lookups run alongside the GitHub crawl (8 workers), only for repositories with new pushes, missing entries, or entries older than one day. Entries older than one day are refreshed oldest first, at most 800 per run, even when the repository was not seen in that incremental crawl.
- **Canonical source recovery.** A refresh also follows same-name npm packages' GitHub `repository` links with bounded, exact read-only queries. A source is added only when GitHub's actual root manifest declares the same package name; missing topics never justify treating an unrelated namesake as the publisher. Failed lookups do not fabricate source facts.
- **Activation does not wait for the index.** The ~30 MB index loads in the background; the UI first sees `loaded: false` and polls.

Measured on 2026-10-14 over a real network:

| Scenario | First results | Total | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Incremental, 1,082 repos pushed | 4.5 s | 38 s | 125 refetched blobs, 963 metadata-only, 70 npm lookups |
| Cold full crawl | 6.7 s | — | ~1,000 plugins browsable within 60 s; the rest fill in the background |

## Checks and trust score

| Check | Rule | Points |
| --- | --- | --- |
| V1 | Root `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle` / `dsh.client` (otherwise not a plugin) | 20 |
| V2 | Official peer rule: only `@deepseek-ai/dsh` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*`, `semver.satisfies(runtime, range, {includePrerelease})`, `workspace:*` means the running version. Inside the App, Scout calls `dsh-app-boot.evaluatePluginCompatibility` directly | covered 30 · no peers 10 · not covered 5 |
| V3 | Install hooks: preinstall / install / postinstall / prepare | none +15 · present −15 |
| V4 | Source chain: the same-name npm package's `repositor
