plugins.description: Cell-aware Jupyter notebook tools for DSH agents
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-notebook-tools

Cell-aware Jupyter notebook tools for DSH agents. A zero-dependency Node ESM
plugin that ports the OpenClaw `notebook-tools` plugin (9 tools) onto the DSH
host.

The core `read` / `write` / `edit` tools treat `.ipynb` files as opaque JSON,
which is error-prone, token-hungry, and easy to corrupt. This plugin provides a
structured, cell-aware API instead: stable cell ids, output-aware truncation,
stale-edit guards, and format-preserving atomic writes.

## Install

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add --config.minimumReleaseAge=0 F:\path\to\dsh-plugin-notebook-tools
```

`dsh plugin` forwards to the pnpm bundled with DSH, and `--profile` is
required. The `--config.minimumReleaseAge=0` override is needed while the
target profile's *existing* lockfile entries are newer than pnpm's default
`minimumReleaseAge` cutoff (pnpm 11.7.0 enforces that default even when the
profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` lists the same offenders under
`minimumReleaseAgeExclude`). Without it you get
`ERR_PNPM_MINIMUM_RELEASE_AGE_VIOLATION` naming packages you did not touch.

On success the package is appended to **both** `dependencies` and
`dsh.profile.bundles` in `<DSH_HOME>\profiles\<profile>\package.json` — no
manual edit needed. A failed run can still leave a link in `node_modules`, so
treat the `package.json` entry, not `node_modules`, as proof.

The plugin ships a `cordis.patch.yml` that inserts it under the id
`notebook-tools`. DSH composes that row at boot, so **restart the DSH app** for
the tools to appear in an already-running session.

No dependencies are installed: `pnpm install` is unnecessary, and the package
imports only `node:` builtins.

## Companion skill

`skill/notebook-tools/SKILL.md` is the matching DSH skill: it tells the agent
when to reach for these tools, which of them can mutate a notebook, and how
stable a cell id really is. Copy it into the skills directory:

```powershell
Copy-Item -Recurse skill\notebook-tools "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\notebook-tools" -Force
```

DSH hot-reloads the skills directory, so the skill shows up without a restart —
unlike the plugin itself, which is composed at boot.

## Tools

| Tool | Writes | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `notebook_create` | yes | Create a notebook from structured cells |
| `notebook_read` | no | Structured read, optionally with outputs |
| `notebook_list_cells` | no | Cheap index: id, type, preview, counts |
| `notebook_search` | no | Find cells by text or regex |
| `notebook_validate` | no | Validate structure and report facts |
| `notebook_edit_cell` | yes | Replace a cell's source / type |
| `notebook_insert_cell` | yes | Insert a new cell at a position |
| `notebook_delete_cell` | yes | Delete a cell by id or index |
| `notebook_clear_outputs` | yes | Clear outputs (all or one cell) |

## Guarantees

- **Writes preserve the file's own formatting.** The plugin probes the layout a
  notebook already uses — JSON indent (0/1/2/4), CRLF vs LF, trailing newline —
  and writes it back unchanged, so a notebook produced by JupyterLab,
  `nbformat.writes`, or a text editor is not reformatted. A cell whose `source`
  is a plain string stays a string, and keys that were absent (`outputs`,
  `execution_count`, `metadata`) are not invented. Read-then-write with no edit
  is byte-identical. Not preserved: tab indentation, `\uXXXX`-escaped non-ASCII
  (Python's `ensure_ascii=True`), and more than one trailing newline.
- **Atomic saves.** Mutations serialize to a sibling temp file
  (`.‹basename›.tmp-‹pid›-‹counter›-‹random›`) in the same directory, `fsync` it,
  then `rename` over the target. A killed process can never leave a half-written
  notebook, and no temp file ever lands in the system temp directory.
- **Validation before every write.** A notebook that fails the deep audit — cell
  ids outside `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$` or duplicated, non-object `metadata`,
  non-array `outputs`, non-string `source` elements — is refused by the writers
  and reported by `notebook_validate`, instead of being silently rewritten.
- **Cell ids over indexes.** `notebook_read`, `notebook_list_cells`, and
  `notebook_search` always return an `id`. A notebook too old to store ids
  (nbformat < 4.5) gets ids derived from `sha256("v1|<ordinal>|<source>")`, so
  the same cell keeps the same id across loads and processes; the derived id is
  persisted only once the file's format supports ids. `nbformat_minor` is never
  bumped. Indexes shift after every insert/delete — prefer ids.
- **Editing a code cell clears `outputs` and `execution_count`,** and the
  response text says so.
- **Three stale-edit guards on every mutating tool.** `expected_file_sha256`
  catches any change to the bytes on disk — including a rewrite inside the same
  millisecond, which `expected_file_mtime_ms` cannot see; `expected_source_sha256`
  catches a change to the one cell an operation depends on (the anchor cell for
  an insert, the target cell for an edit, delete, or clear); the mtime check is
  the cheap one and tolerates sub-millisecond jitter. All of them fail *before*
  any write. `notebook_read` and `notebook_list_cells` return both `mtime_ms`
  and `file_sha256`; only `notebook_read` returns per-cell `source_sha256`.
- **nbformat 4 only.** v3 and earlier are rejected.
- **No kernel execution, ever.**
- **Failures throw** a `NotebookError` subclass carrying a stable `code`
  (`NOTEBOOK_NOT_FOUND`, `STALE_NOTEBOOK`, `CELL_NOT_FOUND`, …). There is no
  `isError` field on the DSH tool result contract.

## Usage

```
notebook_list_cells  { path: "~/analysis.ipynb" }
notebook_read        { path: "~/analysis.ipynb", cell_ids: ["a1b2c3d4"] }
notebook_search      { path: "~/analysis.ipynb", query: "train_test_split" }
notebook_edit_cell   { path: "~/analysis.ipynb", cell_id: "a1b2c3d4",
                       new_source: "model.fit(X, y)\n",
                       expected_source_sha256: "…",
                       expected_file_sha256: "…" }
notebook_validate    { path: "~/analysis.ipynb" }
```

Pass the guards straight back from the read that produced them — `file_sha256`
comes from `notebook_read` or `notebook_list_cells`, `source_sha256` only from
`notebook_read`.

## Development

```powershell
node --test          # from this directory
```

Tests use `node:test` + `node:assert/strict` and require Node >= 22 (verified
on Node 24).

## Releasing

Releases are one command, run from a clean `main` that already contains the
version bump:

```powershell
npm run release -- --title "v0.2.1 - short one-line summary"
```

It refuses to run unless `CHANGELOG.md` carries a non-empty `## [<version>]`
section and a `[<version>]:` link reference for the version in `package.json`,
the working tree is clean, and HEAD is the commit that carries the bump. Then it
runs `node --test`, pushes the release branch, creates the annotated tag
`v<version>`, pushes it, and
creates the GitHub Release: the tag annotation is the release title and the
CHANGELOG section is its body. Credentials come from `GITHUB_TOKEN` / `GH_TOKEN`,
falling back to the stored `git credential` for `github.com` (nothing is ever
printed); the GitHub CLI is not required.

Other flags: `--dry-run` (print the plan, change nothing), `--skip-tests`,
`--branch <name>` (default `main`), `--remote <name>` (default `origin`).

## Layout

```
lib/index.js              composition only — registers the 9 tools on ctx.tools
lib/nb/*.js               pure domain; node: builtins only, no host SDK imports
lib/tools/*.js            adapters: JSON Schema params, error mapping, response text
scripts/release.mjs       the release command behind "npm run release"
test/*.test.js            node:test suites
cordis.patch.yml          the composition row DSH merges at boot
skill/notebook-tools/     the companion skill (SKILL.md)
```

The domain layer (`lib/nb/`) knows nothing about DSH — it only knows about
notebooks, so it stays unit-testable in isolation.

## Credits and license

MIT. This is a **port**, not a fork: the domain layer and all nine tool
adapters were re-implemented for the DSH plugin host from the original plugin's
documented behavior.

plugins.description: 用于dsh上使用的操控Alist的插件
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-alist

让 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）通过对话浏览、检索、上传与管理 [AList](https://github.com/AlistGo/alist) v3 的插件。

一句话：把「AList 上有什么、放到哪、谁能看」这件事变成一句话就能办完的事，写操作一律弹原生审批，密码与 Token 只写不读。

> **当前状态**：代码已完成，自检全绿（`npm run verify` → check + 20/20 单测）；
> 目标实例 `http://172.16.2.186:5244` 连通，版本 **v3.64.0**（与插件端点基线一致，已通过 `/api/public/settings` 核实）；
> 插件已 `link:` 装入本机 `web` profile，等重启 DSH 后做端到端验证。
> 首次使用建议先用只读工具试：`alist_me` → `alist_fs_list` → `alist_fs_search`。

## 为什么用它

- 列目录、取文件信息、只列子目录、关键词搜索、看压缩包内部结构、取直链——都在对话里完成。
- 建目录、重命名（单个/批量/正则）、移动、复制、删除、上传、离线下载、解压——写操作触发强制审批。
- 管理端能力：存储挂载/启停/删除、驱动与配置字段查询、用户、角色、元数据、站点设置、搜索索引、会话、分享、标签。
- 凭据保存在本地 DSH 凭证库，**永不回显**给浏览器和模型；敏感字段在返回前递归脱敏。
- AList 返回的一切都当作**不可信数据**，绝不作为指令执行。

## 环境基线

| 组件 | 基线 |
| --- | --- |
| AList | **v3.64.0**（端点以 `server/router.go` 为准，向下兼容到 3.2x 的大部分端点） |
| Node.js | ≥ 20.11 |
| DeepSeek Harness | 0.1.2-rc.1 |

## 安装

装好后 agent 自动获得 75 个 `alist_*` 工具（73 个走端点表 + 2 个上传工具）。

### 本地安装（推荐先用这个）

命令行里没有 `dsh`？正常——CLI 内置在 DSH Desktop 安装目录里，而且默认 `DSH_HOME` 指向 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`，跟桌面端实际用的 `harness` 目录不是一回事，直接敲会失败或改错 profile。

仓库里带了脚本把这些都处理好：

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install-local.ps1            # 安装（link: 方式，改代码即时生效）
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install-local.ps1 -Uninstall # 卸载
```

等价的手工步骤（想自己敲的话）：

```powershell
$env:DSH_HOME = "$env:APPDATA\dsh-desktop\harness"
$env:PATH    += ";$env:APPDATA\dsh-desktop\harness\.desktop-bin"   # 内置 pnpm / node shim
# 打包后磁盘上只有 app.asar，CLI 与 node 必须走 app.asar.unpacked；
# asar 内部路径只有 Electron 能读，PowerShell / 系统 node 访问不到。
$node = "C:\Program Files\DSH Desktop\resources\app.asar.unpacked\node_modules\node\bin\node.exe"
$dsh  = "C:\Program Files\DSH Desktop\resources\app.asar.unpacked\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js"
& $node $dsh plugin --profile web list                             # 先确认 CLI 通
& $node $dsh plugin --profile web add link:C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\dsh-alist
```

装完**重启 DSH Desktop**（或重启 profile），插件才加载。

### 从 GitHub 安装

```powershell
& $node $dsh plugin --profile web add github:R-roker315/dsh-Alist-#v0.1.0
```

> 把 `<your-github-user>` 换成你的 GitHub 用户名。
> `plugin add` 底层转发给 `pnpm add`，`link:<dir>`、`github:<user>/<repo>#<tag>` 都支持。
> 免打包调试可直挂 overlay：`dsh --profile web --patch ./cordis.patch.yml`

## 配置

### 在哪里配（重要：新版 DSH 没有插件设置卡片了）

DSH 宿主（0.1.7+）**移除了插件设置卡片机制**（`settings.plugin.item` slot 已不存在，dsh-pve / dsh-grafana 等第三方插件同样受影响）。
配置统一走 **profile 配置文件**：

> DSH Web → 设置 → 内置插件 → 右上角 **「打开配置文件」**
> （即 `harness\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml`）

在其中给插件条目加 `config`（`id` 必须与 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 insert id 一致，即 `alist`）：

```yaml
- id: alist
  config:
    baseUrl: http://172.16.2.186:5244
    authMode: password      # password = 账号密码换 JWT；token = 长期 token
    username: admin
    password: "你的密码"     # token 模式改用 token: "..."
    clientId: dsh-alist
    allowInsecureTls: false
    maxUploadBytes: 1073741824
```

保存后 DSH 会自动热重载该插件，无需重启。

> **明文提示**：配置文件里的 `password` / `token` 是明文存储（本机单人环境）；
> 插件侧对输出、审批文案、系统提示一律脱敏，不会回显到对话。
> 想更安全就用 AList 管理后台签发的长期 token 配合 `authMode: token`。

### 字段说明

| 字段 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Base URL | 例如 `http://127.0.0.1:5244`，不能带凭证、查询串或片段 |
| 用户名 | 例如 `admin`（密码模式使用） |
| 鉴权方式 | `账号密码`（登录换 JWT，默认 48 小时，自动续签）或 `长期 Token`（管理员后台签发） |
| Client-Id | 固定值即可保持同一设备会话，默认 `dsh-alist` |
| 跳过 TLS 校验 | 自签名内网证书时勾选 |
| 单文件上传上限（MB） | 默认 1024，超限时插件直接拒绝 |
| 密码 / Token | 存凭证库，**只写不读**，永不显示 |

管理端工具（`alist_admin_*`、`alist_fs_link`）需要**管理员**凭据，普通用户会得到 403；先用 `alist_me` 确认角色。

## 工具

75 个工具：**31 只读 / 44 写（含 2 个上传）**，其中 43 个是管理端（admin）工具。全部写操作强制原生审批，无法绕过。

| 域 | 工具 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 连接与身份 | 3 | `alist_me`、`alist_public_settings`、`alist_public_offline_tools` |
| 文件浏览 | 7 | list / get / dirs / search / archive meta / archive list / link |
| 文件写操作 | 11 | mkdir、rename、batch_rename、regex_rename、move、recursive_move、copy、remove、remove_empty_directory、add_offline_download、archive_decompress |
| 上传 | 2 | `alist_fs_put`（流式，推荐）、`alist_fs_form`（multipart） |
| 任务 | 2 | `alist_task_list`、`alist_task_action`（6 类任务 × 9 种动作） |
| 存储管理 | 8 | list / get / create / update / delete / enable / disable / load_all |
| 驱动 | 3 | list / names / info（建存储前先查字段） |
| 用户 | 7 | list / get / create / update / delete / cancel_2fa / del_cache |
| 角色 | 5 | list / get / create / update / delete |
| 元数据 | 5 | 路径密码、隐藏、readme 规则 |
| 站点设置 | 5 | list / get / save / delete / reset_token |
| 搜索索引 | 5 | progress / build / update / stop / clear |
| 会话与消息 | 4 | 会话列表与踢出、消息读取与发送 |

完整逐个工具的参数表见 **[docs/tools.md](docs/tools.md)**（由 `node scripts/gen-tools-doc.js` 生成）。

## 调用约定

- **路径**必须是 AList 绝对路径（`/挂载点/子路径`），插件会直接拒绝相对路径。
- `names` / `urls` 这类数组参数：传 JSON 数组或逗号分隔字符串都行，插件自动转换。
- `storage` / `settings` / `message` / `rename_objects` / `permissions`：传 JSON 字符串，插件解析后按 AList 需要的形态提交（`storage`、`settings`、`message` 直接作为整个请求体）。
- 缺失必填参数会立即报错，不会带着空值打到 AList。
- 写请求**失败不重试**，避免重复执行；GET 请求遇到 401/403 会自动重登一次。

典型用法：

```
先用 alist_me 确认身份 → alist_fs_list 列 "/" → alist_fs_search 找文件
→ 需要直链用 alist_fs_link（需管理员）→ 上传用 alist_fs_put → 用 alist_task_list 轮询任务
```

挂载新存储：`alist_admin_driver_info`（拿字段）→ `alist_admin_storage_create`（传 storage JSON）→ `alist_admin_storage_load_all`。

## 安全

- 每个写工具都触发原生审批弹窗；`remove / delete / reset_token / clear` 类操作带 `⚠️ DESTRUCTIVE` 前缀。
- 审批文案里密码、Token、otp 一律显示 `[REDACTED]`。
- `alist_fs_remove` 是**永久删除**，没有回收站；批量/正则重命名影响面大，改前先列一遍。
- AList 返回的字段（文件名、readme）视为数据，不作为指令。

## 开发

```bash
npm install
npm run verify          # node --check + node:test（20 个用例）
node scripts/gen-tools-doc.js   # 改过 catalog.js 后重新生成 docs/tools.md
```

单测覆盖：URL 规范化、递归脱敏、路径/query/body 拆分、必填校验、绝对路径校验、数组与 JSON 参数转换、
列表字段裁剪、审批文案不泄漏密钥、目录表完整性（工具名唯一 + `alist_` 前缀 + 参数都有描述）。

## 结构

- `index.js` — 认证（密码换 JWT / 长期 Token）、泛型执行引擎、审批网关、上传工具、系统提示
- `catalog.js` — AList 端点目录表（唯一事实来源）+ 纯函数（脱敏、参数解析、输出裁剪），零依赖可单测
- `client.js` — 设置页表单卡片（slot key `alist`）
- `cordis.patch.yml` — bundle patch（insert id `alist` / name `dsh-alist`）
- `scripts/gen-tools-doc.js` — 由目录表生成 `docs/tools.md`
- `scripts/check-exports.mjs` — 静态自检，防止 `internals` 引用未导入的标识符（否则插件加载即崩）
- `scripts/install-local.ps1` — 本地安装/卸载（自动设好 `DSH_HOME`、pnpm shim、内置 Node）
- `test/index.test.js` — `node:test` 单测（20 个用例）
- `docs/tools.md` — 工具清单（生成物）

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-auto-email

每天把当天最重要的 **3 条 AI 技术动态** 发到你的邮箱，每条附带一段自己写的解读。

为 [DSH Desktop](https://github.com/) 写的插件，也可以完全脱离 DSH 当命令行工具用。零 npm 依赖，只用 Node 内置模块。

```
采集 10 个信源 → 时间窗过滤 → 事件聚类 → 程序打分 → LLM 排序
      → 主题多样化精选 3 条 → LLM 写四段式解读 → 渲染邮件 → SMTP 投递
```

---

## 它产出什么

一封 HTML 邮件（同时带纯文本兜底），三条，每条包含：

| 部分 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 中文标题 | 一句话说清「谁 + 做了什么 + 关键数字」，不用英文原标题 |
| 原文标题 | 保留原文，便于你自己去搜 |
| 来源与时间 | 如实标注信源层级（T1/T2/T3）、发布时间、主题簇 |
| 可信度徽章 | 🟢 交叉验证 / 🟡 单一来源 / ⚪ 信息不足，**由程序客观计算，不交给模型编造** |
| 📌 事实 | 只复述原文，不添加原文没有的事实 |
| 🔍 为什么重要 | 机制与因果，不写「AI 将改变一切」式的空话 |
| 🎯 对你的影响 | 一句可操作判断（要不要跟进、等什么信号） |
| ⚖️ 存疑点 | 原文没给全的地方如实说出来 |

解读字数按 **重要性 × 技术新颖度** 自动伸缩：越难越新的写得越长（120–400 字），单纯的融资稿重要性可能高但新颖度低，解读就短。

---

## 安装

### 方式 A：`dsh plugin`（推荐，声明式）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:X-Xyy/dsh-auto-email
```

包里的 `cordis.patch.yml` 声明了 host 半边的挂载，`package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle` 让 loader 自动应用它 ——
不用手工拷文件、不用改 profile 的 patch 文件。重启（或刷新浏览器页面）后侧边栏面板出现；
卸载是 `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-auto-email`。

> 两种安装方式不要同时用：bundle 挂载的 id 是 `dsh-auto-email`，下面本地挂载用的是
> `dsh-auto-email-1`（带缓存破坏后缀），同时存在会让同一个插件被挂两次。

### 方式 B：本地挂载（开发 / 改代码时用）

一条命令（拷贝 + 挂载，幂等，可回滚）：

```powershell
node scripts/install.mjs --mount      # 先加 --dry-run 看它会写哪里
node scripts/install.mjs --unmount    # 卸载：patch 文件恢复到字节级一致
```

它做两件事：把 `package.json` 与 `lib/` 拷到 `%APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\plugins\dsh-auto-email`，
再在 `%APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\harness\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml` 里维护一个带围栏标记的挂载块
（写之前先备份成 `cordis.patch.yml.bak-<时间戳>`）。

手工等价操作是：

```powershell
$dest = "$env:APPDATA\dsh-desktop\plugins\dsh-auto-email"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $dest | Out-Null
Copy-Item package.json $dest -Force
Copy-Item lib $dest -Recurse -Force
```

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-auto-email-1
      name: "file:///C:/Users/<你>/AppData/Roaming/dsh-desktop/plugins/dsh-auto-email/lib/index.js"
```

> `-N` 后缀与 `?rev=` 后缀都是给 dsh-hmr 的缓存破坏标记，不是版本号。改了代码又不想重启，就把 `dsh-auto-email-1` 改成 `dsh-auto-email-2` —— `node scripts/install.mjs --mount --rev 2` 会同时改 id 和模块 URL，两者都新才会被重新导入。

然后写凭据文件（见下一节）。挂载后它会出现在插件列表里，
**在插件管理面板里直接开关就是启用/禁用**。host 半边由 dsh-hmr 热加载（`logs/harness.log` 里出现 `auto-email: ready` 即为加载成功）；
browser 半边的侧边栏面板需要刷新一次浏览器页面才会出现。

> ⚠️ 如果你已经在用另一个版本（比如 Python 版 + Windows 任务计划程序）发同一封日报，
> 先把那个停掉再启用这个。两套调度都在跑 = 每天收到两封。

### 从 Python 版接管历史（可选）

如果之前用过本仓库的 Python 版，它的 `seen.json` 记录了已推送过的标题哈希。本插件的哈希算法与它**逐位一致**
（都是「标题归一化后取 sha1 的前 20 位十六进制」），所以可以整库搬过来，不会因为搬家而重发旧新闻：

```powershell
node bin/dsh-auto-email.mjs --migrate <Python 版的 seen.json 路径>
```

合并是**并集**，且刻意保守：已存在的哈希保留更新的日期，`last_sent_date` 只在旧文件更新时才覆盖 ——
取旧了会重发，取新了会漏发，两个方向都不能错。导入**幂等**，第二次运行报告 0 条新增；
导入前把现有 `state.json` 备份成 `state.json.bak-<时间戳>`；只写状态文件，不发信、不动归档。

### 方式 C：命令行 / 任务计划程序

```powershell
node bin/dsh-auto-email.mjs --dry-run -v     # 先干跑看看会选哪三条
node bin/dsh-auto-email.mjs                  # 真发
node bin/dsh-auto-email.mjs --if-due         # 幂等模式，给定时器调用
node bin/dsh-auto-email.mjs --migrate <file> # 并入 Python 版 seen.json
```

Windows 任务计划程序里注册一个每天 08:00 的任务，动作填 `node <仓库路径>\bin\dsh-auto-email.mjs --if-due`。`--if-due` 保证：没到点不发、今天发过就不再发，所以你可以放心把登录、解锁、每 30 分钟轮询都挂上同一个命令，**永远不会重复投递**。

---

## 配置

### 凭据

凭据**不写进配置文件**，单独放一个文件：

`%APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\dsh-auto-email.secret.json`

```json
{
  "deepseek_api_key": "sk-...",
  "smtp_username": "you@qq.com",
  "smtp_auth_code": "你的SMTP授权码",
  "recipients": ["you@qq.com"]
}
```

- `deepseek_api_key` 用 [DeepSeek 开放平台](https://platform.deepseek.com/) 的 Key，也可以用环境变量 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`。
- `smtp_auth_code` 是邮箱的 **SMTP 授权码**，不是登录密码。QQ 邮箱在「设置 → 账号 → POP3/SMTP服务」里开启后生成。
- 用非 QQ 邮箱时，改 `email.smtp_host` / `email.smtp_port` / `email.use_ssl` 即可。

检查是否配好：

```powershell
node bin/dsh-auto-email.mjs --status      # 列出所有缺失项
node bin/dsh-auto-email.mjs --send-test   # 只验证 SMTP 登录，不发信
```

### 可调项

改成 DSH 插件选项、或写进 `<userData>\dsh-auto-email\config.json`、或命令行 `--config`。未列出的键用默认值。

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `digest.top_n` | `3` | 每封邮件几条 |
| `digest.window_hours` | `26` | 主时间窗（小时）。比 24 多 2 小时，防调度抖动 |
| `digest.fallback_window_hours` | `[48, 72]` | 主窗不够时逐级回溯 |
| `digest.min_importance` | `6` | 重要性门槛。调高＝更挑剔，更容易触发回溯 |
| `schedule.time` | `"08:00"` | 每天推送时刻（`HH:MM`） |
| `schedule.catch_up_hours` | `12` | 错过多久之内还补发。避免补发一份过期新闻 |
| `schedule.enabled` | `true` | 关掉调度，只留手动 |
| `digest.send_when_empty` | `true` | 当天没有任何达标内容时，是否仍发一封「今日无重大动态」 |
| `llm.model` | `"deepseek-chat"` | 排序与解读用的模型 |

---

## 使用

### 对话里的四个工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `dsh_auto_email_status` | 今天发了没、下次什么时候发、配置缺什么 |
| `dsh_auto_email_preview` | 只跑一遍看会选哪三条，**不发信、不写状态** |
| `dsh_auto_email_send` | 立即真发一封 |
| `dsh_auto_email_configure` | 临时改条数 / 时间 / 门槛 / 暂停 N 天 |

### 侧边栏面板

设置区上方多一个「每日AI」入口，面板里能看今日状态、点立即发送、临时暂停、直接改配置和凭据、浏览历史归档。

---

## 它是怎么选的

**这一步决定了这东西有没有用**，所以写清楚。

### 信源（10 个，按层级加权）

| 层级 | 权重 | 信源 | 抓取方式 |
|---|---|---|---|
| T1 一手官方 | 1.0 | OpenAI News | RSS |
| T1 | 1.0 | Anthropic News | 页面解析（官方无 RSS） |
| T1 | 1.0 | Google DeepMind Blog | RSS |
| T1 | 1.0 | Hugging Face Blog | hf-mirror 镜像 RSS |
| T1 | 1.0 | arXiv cs.AI/CL/LG/CV | 官方 API |
| T2 权威媒体 | 0.7 | 量子位 | RSS |
| T2 | 0.7 | TechCrunch AI | RSS |
| T2 | 0.7 | MIT Tech Review AI | RSS |
| T2 | 0.7 | Simon Willison | Atom + AI 关键词过滤 |
| T3 社区信号 | 0.4 | Hacker News | Algolia API，≥50 分 |

**刻意不接**：机器之心（全站 WAF，客户端无法绕过）、TLDR AI / The Rundown / Import AI / The Batch 等 Newsletter、AITOP100 / alphaXiv 等聚合器。理由：Newsletter 和聚合器都是对上述 T1/T2 的二次加工，接进来等于把同一件事数两遍，会虚增「交叉验证」的可信度 —— 而交叉验证正是这套东西最硬的抓手。

### 三道闸门

**闸门 1 · 程序打分**（可复现、可审计）

```
0.35 × 信源层级 + 0.25 × min(独立信源数/3, 1) + 0.20 × 时效衰减
  + 0.20 × 影响信号词命中 − 0.15 ×（摘要为空）
```

**闸门 2 · LLM 逐条打分**：重要性 0–10 与技术新颖度 0–10 是两个独立轴。

- 重要性看影响面；新颖度看有没有技术增量 —— 所以融资稿能进（重要），但解读短（不新）。
- 四条硬性扣分：标题党/PR 软文/空洞评论；二手转述（`Quoting X`、`Weekly roundup`）新颖度一律 ≤3；与 AI 技术无关的纯基建/人事/会议预告；**摘要为空的条目重要性 ≤4、新颖度 ≤5，不得进精选**。
- 融合：`final = 0.70 × (0.55×重要性 + 0.45×新颖度)/10 + 0.30 × 程序分`。给程序分留 30% 是故意的 —— 即使 LLM 判偏，也不会选出纯噪音。

**闸门 3 · 精选约束**：主窗内重要性 ≥6 的不足 3 条，就回退 48h、再 72h（**宁缺毋滥**）；三条必须来自不同信源、不同主题、不同事件；**T3 社区信源永不单独成条**，必须有第二个信源印证。

### 一个诚实的定位

这套标准**不是「真理判定器」，是「证据强度排序器」**。它把「谁说的、几个来源说的、有没有技术增量、原文给没给细节」变成可审计的分数，并把依据印在邮件里。它做不到替你判断某篇论文的方法是否成立、某笔融资是否合理 —— 那个判断权留给你。

---

## 可靠性设计

| 风险 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| 电脑在推送时刻睡眠/关机 | 四个触发器：08:00 定时 + 每 30 分钟轮询 + 登录 + 解锁，配合 `--if-due` 幂等闸门 |
| 重复投递 | `--if-due` 读 `state.json` 的 `last_sent_date`，当天发过就退出 0 |
| 半夜开机被提前推送 | `--if-due` 还有第二道守卫：早于 `schedule.time` 一律不发 |
| 单个信源抓取失败 | 失败信源在其余信源跑完后统一重试一次；仍失败就如实写进邮件告警条 |
| arXiv / 站点限流 | 读 `Retry-After`，指数退避；403/404/410 直接放弃（重试没意义） |
| 模型把段标题写进正文 | `_strip_label` 循环剥离 |
| 模型把解读写太长 | 三层控制：字段子预算 → 外科手术式重写（只改超标字段）→ 仍超标则按句子边界程序化裁剪 |
| 模型幻觉来源 | 可信度徽章由程序算；无摘要条目降权且不得进精选 |
| 状态文件损坏 | 读失败就从空状态开始（最坏是多发一条，不是不发） |
| 服务器不接受中文发件人 | `From` 显示名做 RFC 2047 编码 |

---

## 故障排查

| 现象 | 原因与处理 |
|---|---|
| `--status` 列出「未配置…」 | 凭据文件路径或键名不对，对照上一节 |
| `SMTP 登录成功` 但收不到信 | 看垃圾箱；把发件人加白名单 |
| `Google DeepMind ... fetch failed` | 该域名在部分网络下间歇性不可达，不是代码问题。重试机制会自动再试一次 |
| 邮件里出现「⚠️ 部分信源本次不可达」 | 同上，属设计内的如实披露 |
| 选出来的三条看着不重要 | 调低 `digest.min_importance` 或放宽 `window_hours`；也可以跑 `--preview` 看完整候选池 |
| `--preview` 每次都换内容 | LLM 采样非确定，同一份代码多跑几次结果会变。以「是否落在设计容差内」验收 |
| 想重发同一批内容 | `--ignore-seen` |
| 面板里改了配置不生效 | 配置写在 `<userData>\dsh-auto-email\config.json`，DSH 里改完点保存会立刻重新解析 |

---

## 开发

```powershell
node test/all.mjs             # 全部离线套件，一条命令；142 项检查
node test/all.mjs --live      # 额外联网实测 10 个信源的条数与样例

# 也可以单独跑
node test/render.mjs      # 离线：两个渲染器、HTML 转义、空链接（19 项）
node test/plugin.mjs      # 离线：配置分层、时区算术、MIME 组装、幂等闸门、迁移合并、在跑时不重复触发（32 项）
node test/digest.mjs      # 离线：聚类、打分、精选、字数控制（39 项；本地 http stub，不花 API 额度）
node test/feeds.mjs       # 离线：RSS 2.0 / RSS 1.0-RDF / Atom 的边角（19 项）
node test/http.mjs        # 离线：429 Retry-After、确定性失败不重试（15 项）
node test/host-half.mjs   # 离线：用桩包加载 host 半边，验证 4 工具 / 8 路由的注册形状（18 项）
node test/sources-live.mjs # 联网：10 个信源逐个实测（会写 test/sources-live.out.txt）
```

这些套件全部离线，**不会花 API 额度、不会发信**：LLM 与 SMTP 都打到本地 stub。
`test/digest.mjs` 还会读 `test/difflib-parity.json`，把 JS 的 `sim()` 与 Python
`difflib.SequenceMatcher` 的 15 组比值比对到 6 位小数 —— 聚类阈值是从 Python 版调出来的，
两边算不出同一个数，阈值就失去意义。

**零依赖**是硬约束：只用 `node:` 内置模块和全局 `fetch`。不要为了省几十行引入包 —— 插件要在别人的机器上 clone 下来就能跑。

移植契约与两套实现的对齐关系见 [`docs/PORT-CONTRACT.md`](docs/PORT-CONTRACT.md)。

### 写 DSH 插件时踩过的坑（实测，非推测）

这些错误都只在**运行中

plugins.description: An eye-friendly green skin for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-leafy-skin

An eye-friendly green skin: a leafy palette layered over the official DSH web GUI theme, in a
light emerald and a dark mint variant.

> I wanted the effect of a Minecraft resource pack.

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

## Compatibility

| Plugin version | DSH version |
| --- | --- |
| v0.2.0 | dsh-v0.2.1-rc.2 |
| v0.1.2 | dsh-v0.2.1-rc.2 |
| v0.1.1 | dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2 |
| v0.1.0 | dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2 |

## Screenshot

![Screenshot](show.png)

## Features

- **Layered greens** — a mist-green canvas, raised panels, and a deeper sidebar, with emerald
  accents in light mode and mint in dark, instead of one flat wash of green.
- **Comfortable by construction** — no pure white or pure black, a single green hue family, and
  all body text at WCAG AA (≥ 4.5:1).
- **Texture** — softer corner radii, green-tinted diffuse shadows, low-contrast hairlines, and
  glassy menu surfaces.
- **Details** — mint text selection, Inter / Noto Sans SC / Cascadia Code font stacks, slim
  scrollbars, and restrained hover and menu motion.
- **Tunable** — the palette is one commented table, a self-check script guards contrast, and the
  style layer has a single on/off switch.

## Install

```
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-leafy-skin
```

Restart DSH once afterwards so the profile recomposes. After that, colour edits only need a page
refresh (client changes hot-reload within about a second).

## Usage

Install the plugin and load the app. The skin layers itself over the active theme, so light, dark,
and follow-system each pick up their own variant automatically.

## Customize

- **Colours** — the `TOKENS` table in `lib/client.js`, grouped and commented by area.
- **Radii, shadows, fonts, motion** — the same file, plus the small style layer below it.
- **Palette only** — set `ENABLE_CSS_LAYER` to `false` in `lib/client.js` to drop the style layer
  entirely.
- **Check your work** — `node tools/check-palette.mjs` validates token shape, the boot colour
  match, text and syntax contrast (including translucent surfaces and the focus ring), and the
  style layer's three constraints.
- **Coverage matrix** — `node tools/audit-tokens.mjs` reads the installed DSH and lists every
  `--dsw-*` token it declares: whether this skin covers it directly or through a `var()` chain,
  and how often official bundles consume it. `--strict` fails on tokens that are used but covered
  by neither the palette nor a written reason.
- **Stable hooks** — `node tools/check-hooks.mjs` confirms the `data-*` hooks the style layer
  relies on still exist upstream, so a DSH upgrade breaks the check instead of the look.

## Uninstall

Any one of these, then restart DSH:

1. Comment out the `insert` entry in `cordis.patch.yml`;
2. Drop `dsh-leafy-skin` from `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`;
3. Run `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-leafy-skin`.

## Known limitations

- The native window title bar belongs to the DSH desktop shell, not to this plugin, so it stays
  DSH grey for the instant before the page paints.
- Real see-through glass is impossible on Windows — the sidebar depth and translucent menus are
  colour layering, not blur through the window.
- Components hard-code font sizes and layout in hashed CSS modules, so this skin deliberately
  leaves them alone.

## Changelog

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)

## Contributing

Questions and suggestions are welcome as issues. Pull requests are not accepted.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered_by-dsh-4D6BFE?style=flat-square&logo=deepseek&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

plugins.description: Open-source, local-first envelope messaging for DeepSeek Harness: a TypeScript node, human-first inbox, explainable collaborator discovery, and bounded LAN recovery.
plugins.readme_text:
# Linko

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Linko is open-source, local-first envelope messaging for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It helps agents find the right collaborator, exchange scoped context, and continue a task under explicit human-controlled policies.

Linko is an early runnable MVP. The repository remains specification-driven: product boundaries, state transitions, delivery recovery, privacy rules, and architecture decisions are written beside the runtime.

## Why Linko

LAN messaging and approval panels are useful building blocks. Linko adds the part that becomes more useful with a person's own evidence and context:

- Each person and Agent can keep a subjective set of capability claims; later releases may attach signatures without creating a global reputation score.
- A task query can produce a local recommendation with evidence and an explanation.
- Context is shared by scope and purpose instead of being broadcast as a complete private history.
- A person can answer an inbound request, ask their Agent to draft a reply, or delegate a bounded response policy.
- Every delivery is a small envelope with a human-readable cover, machine-readable semantics, and an optional local body or safe surface.
- The experimental first group profile is capped at 500 member principals, with group delivery and message-layer E2EE as separate milestones.

## Project status

The MVP runs a SQLite-backed node and a human-first envelope inbox. It supports an explicit two-node HTTPS pairing profile with a durable outbox, pinned certificates, bearer authentication, retry-safe command IDs, and REST recovery. The local node also exposes an advisory loopback WebSocket for live UI hints; paired WSS delivery remains a later milestone. The replaceable TypeScript DSH companion bridge now provides `ask`, `inbox`, `inspect`, `draft`, `approve`, and `reply` adapters over the local API. Message signatures and E2EE remain later milestones; this is not a 20,000-node capacity claim.

- Product scope: [English](docs/specs/0001-product-scope.md) · [中文](docs/specs/0001-product-scope.zh.md)
- Architecture: [English](docs/architecture.md) · [中文](docs/architecture.zh.md)
- State and storage: [English](docs/specs/0005-state-and-storage.md) · [中文](docs/specs/0005-state-and-storage.zh.md)
- Review record: [English](docs/review.md) · [中文](docs/review.zh.md)
- Roadmap: [English](ROADMAP.md) · [中文](ROADMAP.zh.md)
- Decisions: [English](docs/decisions/README.md) · [中文](docs/decisions/README.zh.md)
- Local node MVP: [English](packages/node/README.md) · [中文](packages/node/README.zh.md)
- DSH companion bridge: [English](packages/bridge/README.md) · [中文](packages/bridge/README.zh.md)
- Envelope inbox UI: [English](packages/web/DESIGN.md) · [中文](packages/web/DESIGN.zh.md)

## Design direction

The first physical store is one SQLite database behind one TypeScript node. Immutable event content is durable; delivery attempts, read state, approvals, and notifications are local operational state. REST cursor synchronization and the SQLite outbox remain the canonical recovery path. The approved [2026 transport decision](docs/decisions/0010-wss-live-session-and-recovery.md) selects WSS as the online live session; its implementation remains pending. A graph can be materialized later as a view over claims; a graph database is not required.

The network uses ordinary IP and authenticated TCP/TLS connections, with explicit pairing. mDNS/DNS-SD is an optional discovery hint only; it does not grant trust or carry message bodies. Linko adds no application-layer router or payload flooding, and requires no Linko-specific router or switch feature. WebTransport/QUIC remain deferred experiments alongside DHT, Merkle synchronization, full-mesh sockets, blockchain consensus, and Rust/WASM; each needs a measured reason and a fallback test.

## DeepSeek Harness fit

Linko is intended to be a community plugin and companion protocol for the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem. It follows the Harness model that capabilities are composable plugins, while keeping the Linko protocol independently usable by other agents and clients.

## Contributing

Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and the repository guidance in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). Early contributions are most useful as design review, threat modeling, interoperability experiments, and small protocol fixtures.

## Topics

The repository is indexed with dsh, dsh-plugin, deepseek-harness, agent-collaboration, local-first, lan-messaging, envelope-messaging, human-in-the-loop, sqlite, typescript, and pnpm.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Deep Feishu / Lark integration for DeepSeek Harness: Bitable (multidimensional tables), docs, sheets, wiki, drive, messages, plus a visual settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-feishu

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Deep **Feishu / Lark** integration for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

It gives the agent eight tools that act on a real Feishu tenant (and a browser
panel that shows what it did and fixes authorization in one click):

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `feishu_bitable` | Create **Bitable (多维表格)** apps with their tables and fields in one call; list tables and fields; insert, search, update, and delete records in batches |
| `feishu_dashboard` | Create dashboards and **chart blocks** inside a Bitable (柱状图 / 折线图 / 饼图 / 排行榜 / 指标卡 / NPS … 15 types), position them, and read a chart's computed numbers |
| `feishu_query` | Run a **grouped, aggregated query** over a table (group by, sum / avg / min / max / count / distinct_count, filter, sort, top-N) with the aggregation done server-side |
| `feishu_doc` | Create documents; append Markdown (converted to native blocks), append raw blocks, read plain text, or import a local Markdown/Word/Excel/PowerPoint/PDF file as a new cloud document |
| `feishu_sheet` | Create spreadsheets; add sheets; read, write, and append ranges |
| `feishu_drive` | Browse folders, create folders, upload and download files, move, delete, read metadata |
| `feishu_wiki` | List wiki spaces and nodes, resolve a wiki token to its document, create and move nodes |
| `feishu_message` | Send text, interactive cards, rich posts, files, and images; reply in a thread; post through a custom-bot webhook |
| `feishu_auth` | Diagnose authorization, produce the authorization URL, complete a manual code exchange, refresh, and log out |
| `feishu_api` | Call any documented Feishu open-platform path, with the same auth, retry, and error mapping |

New content lands in **the user's own cloud drive** because the tools act as the
authorized user, not as the app. When no user grant is stored they fall back to
the app identity and say so in a warning rather than silently filing documents
into a space the user cannot see.

---

## Quick start

### 1. Create a Feishu app

1. Open the [Feishu Open Platform](https://open.feishu.cn/app) (or
   [Lark](https://open.larksuite.com/app)) and create a **custom app**.
2. Under **凭证与基础信息**, note the **App ID** and **App Secret**.
3. Under **安全设置 → 重定向 URL**, add the callback this plugin serves:

   ```
   http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/feishu/oauth/callback
   ```

   The port is whatever DeepSeek Harness serves on (the plugin reads it from the
   host and reports the exact URI in `feishu_auth` action `status`).
4. Under **权限管理**, add the scopes below, then **publish a version** — scopes
   only apply after the version is released:

   | Scope | Needed for |
   |---|---|
   | `offline_access` | **Required** — without it Feishu returns no refresh token and the user must re-authorize every couple of hours |
   | `bitable:app` | Bitable |
   | `docx:document` | Documents |
   | `drive:drive` | Drive, imports, uploads |
   | `sheets:spreadsheet` | Spreadsheets |
   | `wiki:wiki` | Wiki |
   | `im:message`, `im:resource` | Messages and file/image sending |
   | `contact:user.base:readonly` | Reading the authorized user's name |

### 2. Enable the plugin

See [Install](#install) below, then restart DeepSeek Harness.

### 3. Configure it in the GUI

Open **设置 → 飞书 / Feishu**. Everything is editable there — no YAML by hand:

- **应用凭据** — the App ID, the App Secret (write-only), the credential
  reference name, and the brand (飞书 / Lark).
- **默认落点与身份** — the folder new content lands in, and which identity the
  tools use by default.
- **功能开关** — whether the tools register, whether the HTTP routes mount,
  whether the floating panel shows, and the tool-name prefix.
- **授权** — the scopes to request and the redirect URL to register.
- **高级** — endpoint overrides and the page-size caps.

**Saving writes only this plugin's entry** in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`,
which the harness hot-reloads, so most changes apply without a restart. The App
Secret is *never* written to that file: it goes straight into the credential
store under the reference name, and the page only ever shows whether it is set.

### 4. Authorize

Press **授权飞书** on the settings page, or ask the agent to run `feishu_auth`
with action `authorize_url`. The browser lands on the callback, the grant is
stored, and every later call acts as that user. The same form shows the redirect
URL to register on the Feishu app and lists the scopes to grant.

> Host without a reachable browser callback (a remote or headless session)? Open
> the URL anywhere, then pass the `code` query parameter to `feishu_auth` with
> action `complete`.

---

## Install

Two ways, and they are alternatives — **do not do both.** Each creates a loader
entry with id `feishu`, and the loader rejects a composition that defines one id
twice with `duplicate loader entry id`.

### As a bundle (recommended)

The package declares a `dsh.bundle` patch, so a bundle-aware CLI installs and
mounts it in one step:

```sh
dsh plugin add github:2048lr/dsh-feishu
```

That appends `dsh-feishu` to `dsh.profile.bundles` and profile boot merges
[cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml), which inserts the plugin row. Nothing else
needs editing.

The settings page is aware of this: when the profile mounts the bundle, it writes
an **id-targeted config override** rather than a second `insert`, so saving from
the GUI never breaks the composition.

### By hand (no CLI)

The plugin must be resolvable from the profile's `node_modules`, so it is copied
there:

```powershell
# from the repository root
pwsh -File scripts/install.ps1
```

The script copies the package into the profile's `node_modules` and inserts the
entry into `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: feishu
      name: dsh-feishu
      config:
        appId: cli_xxxxxxxxxxxx
        # appSecretRef: FEISHU_APP_SECRET
        # brand: feishu          # or lark
        # defaultFolderToken: fldcnxxxxxxxx
```

**Restart DeepSeek Harness.** The host half is a Node module cached in-process,
so a reload alone does not pick it up. The browser half reloads with the page.

After that first restart, use **设置 → 飞书 / Feishu** instead of editing the YAML:
the page rewrites the block the installer added and the harness hot-reloads it.

### Why the package avoids `@deepseek-ai/*` imports

A third-party plugin is loaded from a junction or a copied directory inside the
profile, where a bare `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` specifier resolves to whichever
DSH installation is reachable — which may not be the running host. The host half
therefore imports **only Node builtins** and hand-writes its tool definitions
and its configuration validation. The test suite checks every generated schema
against the real SDK validator, so the hand-written form cannot drift from what
the registry accepts.

---

## Configuration

All fields are optional except `appId`.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `appId` | — | The Feishu app id. Required. |
| `appSecretRef` | `FEISHU_APP_SECRET` | Credential reference resolved through the harness credential store, then the environment. |
| `appSecret` | `''` | Literal fallback. Discouraged: it puts a secret in configuration. |
| `brand` | `feishu` | `feishu` (open.feishu.cn) or `lark` (open.larksuite.com). |
| `apiBaseUrl` / `accountsBaseUrl` | per brand | Override the endpoints (for a proxy or a private gateway). |
| `defaultFolderToken` | `''` | Where new documents, sheets, Bitable apps, and uploads go when a call omits a folder. |
| `defaultIdentity` | `auto` | `auto`, `user`, or `app`. `auto` uses the user when authorized and otherwise the app, reporting the fallback. |
| `toolPrefix` | `feishu_` | Rename the tools (for example `fs_`). |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-attempt timeout. |
| `maxRetries` | `2` | Total attempts for rate-limited or transient failures (capped at 6). |
| `enableTools` | `true` | Register the model-facing tools. |
| `enableOAuth` | `true` | Mount the `/api/feishu/*` routes (status, activity, config, OAuth). |
| `enableUi` | `true` | Show the floating panel. |
| `oauthRedirectUri` | auto | Override the callback. Empty means "use

# dsh-babel **让 DSH 直接使用其他 AI 编码工具生态里的 MCP 服务器、插件与斜杠命令。** > 读它们已有的配置，而不是要求插件作者为 DSH 重新移植一遍。 [![简体中文](https://img.shields.io/badge/lang-%E7%AE%80%E4%BD%93%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87-red.svg)](README.md) [![English](https://img.shields.io/badge/lang-English-blue.svg)](README.en.md) [![test](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel/actions/workflows/test.yml) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-2EA44F?style=flat)](LICENSE) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel?style=flat&label=%E2%98%85)](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-0f766e.svg)](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel) [![dsh-plugin topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-2563eb.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
> dsh-babel 是社区维护的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件，并非 DeepSeek AI 官方产品。 ## 它解决什么问题 插件作者要支持一个平台，就得为它单独写一份目录。一个典型的多平台插件会带六到八个这样的目录： ``` .claude-plugin .codex-plugin .cursor .gemini-extension.json ... ``` DSH 的那个格子通常是空的。dsh-babel 换个思路：**作者不用动，DSH 这边读他们已有的 `.mcp.json` / `commands/`**，把 N×M 的移植问题变成 N×1。 同时它做一件别家没做的事：**装之前就告诉你哪个能跑、哪个缺密钥、哪个根本跑不起来**——而不是装上去之后静默失败。 ## 功能 - **发现**：扫描 Claude Code 与 Codex 插件目录下的 `.mcp.json`，以及两种斜杠命令文件（`.md` / `.toml`）；根目录可配置。 - **归一化**：把多种 `.mcp.json` 方言（带 `mcpServers` 包装的 / 裸顶层的 / Codex 专有键的）降成**一套中间表示**。 - **预检**：四类检查把"静默失败"变成"明确原因"——依赖命令是否在 `PATH`、守护进程是否在跑（如 Docker socket）、密钥是否可用、版本是否未固定。 - **兼容性报告**：把每个服务器归入「可用 / 需密钥 / 不可用」，每条都附具体原因。 - **命令注册**：把发现到的斜杠命令注册进 DSH，支持 `{{args}}` / `$ARGUMENTS` / `$1` 参数替换。 - **MCP 注册**：连上 stdio 或 streamable-http 服务器，用 DSH 自己的 `createMcpToolDefinition` 注册工具。 - **密钥解析**：`process.env` 优先，其次 macOS 钥匙串的**白名单**（仅 GitHub token 家族）——绝不无差别翻钥匙串。 - **展示元数据**：`locale/` 文案与图标，配置项由 schemastery schema 声明，设置界面可渲染。 ## 安装 ```bash # 从 GitHub plugin_manager install_bundle github:Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel # 或本地目录 plugin_manager install_bundle /绝对/路径/dsh-babel ``` 也可以在 DSH Desktop 里走 **设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**，填入仓库地址或本地路径。 安装后默认 **dry-run**：只在日志里打印兼容性报告，**不注册任何东西**。 ## 配置 配置项由 schemastery schema 声明，因此会出现在 **设置 → 插件 → dsh-babel** 的配置界面里： | 配置项 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `roots` | `[]` | 扫描根目录；字符串路径或 `{ source, path }`。留空时使用默认的 Claude / Codex 插件目录 | | `dryRun` | `true` | 只报告，不注册。要真正注册必须先设为 `false` | | `logReport` | `true` | 把兼容性报告打印到日志 | | `registerCommands` | `false` | 注册发现到的斜杠命令（需 `dryRun: false`） | | `registerMcp` | `false` | 注册预检通过（`severity: ok`）的 MCP 服务器（需 `dryRun: false`） | 开启真注册： ```yaml config: dryRun: false registerCommands: true registerMcp: true ``` ## 兼容矩阵（诚实版） | 外部形态 | 覆盖 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | MCP `.mcp.json`（stdio） | ✅ 高 | 免密钥、依赖命令存在的，基本可用 | | MCP `.mcp.json`（http/sse） | ✅ 高 | 依赖 bearer token 的会标「需密钥」 | | MCP（依赖宿主运行时变量） | ⚠️ 有损 | `CODEX_*` / `CLAUDE_*` 等对方宿主注入的变量，DSH 没有，标为不可用 | | MCP（OAuth） | ❌ 无对应 | `oauth_resource` 等 DSH 无等价物，丢弃并告知 | | 技能 `skills/*/SKILL.md` | ✅ 高 | 格式统一（由 skills-manager 等已有实现覆盖） | | 斜杠命令 `commands/*` | ✅ 已实现 | 发现 + 归一化 + 报告 + 注册 | | Hooks | ⚠️ 有损 | DSH 仅 7 个点、仅 command handler | | 子代理 `agents/*` | ⚠️ 降级 | DSH 无注册接口，只能降级为技能 | | 插件 UI / mods | ❌ 不支持 | 必须用 DSH client 插件重写，无法移植 | ## 报告长什么样 在一台装了 Claude Code 与 Codex 插件的机器上，首次加载会打印： ``` === dsh-babel 兼容性报告 === 文件: 28 服务器: 28 方言: {"bare":14,"wrapped":14} 传输: {"stdio":17,"streamable-http":11} 结论: 可用 14 / 需密钥 5 / 不可用 9 ✗ 不可用 (9): laravel-boost [stdio] BLOCKED - [command] command not on PATH: php terraform [stdio] BLOCKED - [daemon] docker installed but not running (no socket / probe failed) - [secret] missing credential: TFE_TOKEN codex_app [stdio] BLOCKED - [env] depends on CODEX_MCP_NODE_PATH (other-harness runtime), not available in DSH ``` 这就是这个插件的第二个价值：**明确告诉你为什么跑不起来**，而不是让用户以为「DSH 很烂」。 ## 目录结构 ``` index.js 插件入口（apply + schemastery Config，Cordis 宿主插件形式） cordis.patch.yml bundle patch（插入 dsh-babel 一行） locale/zh.json 卡片展示文案（标题 + 简介） locale/en.json same, in English icon.svg 插件图标 lib/normalize.mjs 内核：方言 → IR lib/discover.mjs 发现：遍历文件系统找声明 lib/preflight.mjs 预检：命令 / daemon / 密钥 / 版本 lib/secrets.mjs 密钥解析：env 为主 + 钥匙串白名单兜底 lib/commands.mjs 命令归一化：.md / .toml → 命令 IR lib/register.mjs 命令注册：ctx.commands.register + 参数替换 lib/register-mcp.mjs MCP 注册：连接 + createMcpToolDefinition + 工具注册 lib/report.mjs 报告：聚合 + 文本渲染 bin/dsh-babel.mjs CLI runner（本地测试用） test/ 单测 + 冒烟 docs/ 详细文档 CHANGELOG.md 版本变更记录 ``` ## 开发与测试 ```bash npm test # 全部单测（75 断言） node test/mcp-smoke.mjs # MCP 注册冒烟（需本地 symlink 到 DSH 包 + 真实服务器） node bin/dsh-babel.mjs # 直接跑一次报告 ``` ## 文档 - [功能详解](docs/FEATURES.md) - [配置参考](docs/CONFIG.md) - [兼容性说明](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) - [架构与中间表示](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) - [版本变更](CHANGELOG.md) ## 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE)

# dsh-claude-code-theme **Claude Desktop's visual language for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.** Warm paper neutrals, terracotta accent, readable prose, quiet layered surfaces and a continuous composer — applied through DSH's own theme extension point, not by patching its stylesheets. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-claude-code-theme.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-claude-code-theme) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-claude-code-theme.svg)](./LICENSE)
## Before and after Stock DSH — right-aligned bubble on a blue-tinted canvas, soft 12–28px corners, a floating composer with a circular send button: With the theme — a deeper sidebar, a raised right-hand panel, prose set for reading, compact tool summaries, and a continuous composer: Light mode, on Claude's cream canvas with white raised sheets: --- ## Install ```sh dsh plugin install dsh-claude-code-theme ``` Or add the row to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and its package to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`: ```yaml - insert: - id: claude-code-theme name: dsh-claude-code-theme ``` Reload the Web GUI. There is nothing to switch on: the theme composes over whichever palette you already use, so `light`, `dark` and `system` all keep working. ## What changes **Colour.** DSH's design system has three token tiers, and the theme works on all three: | Tier | What it is | What the theme does | | --- | --- | --- | | `--dsw-static-*` | The raw colour ramps | Retints DSH's blue-tinted greys to Claude's warm paper greys, and DeepSeek blue to terracotta. The alias tier resolves through these, so this alone recolours most of the application. | | `--dsw-alias-*` | The semantic roles components consume | Pins the roles Claude treats differently: a cream canvas under raised sheets, a terracotta primary button and focus ring, warm hairlines, and text that stops short of pure white on dark. | | `--dsw-specific-*` | Named surfaces | Retunes the sidebar, composer, bubbles, menus and code surfaces. | **Surface hierarchy.** Claude Desktop stacks depth rather than flattening it, so the theme gives each column its own level instead of one shared grey: | Region | Dark | Light | | --- | --- | --- | | Sidebar | `#111110` (deepest) | `#f5f3ec` | | Canvas | `#171716` | `#faf9f5` | | Raised sheets — cards, composer, right panel | `#1d1d1b` | `#ffffff` | The right panel becomes a raised sheet separated by a hairline instead of floating as a detached card. **Geometry.** DSH routes **280 `border-radius` declarations through six `--dsw-radius-*` tokens** (measured across all 179 shipped UI bundles), so the theme re-points the scale itself: | Token | DSH | Theme | | --- | --- | --- | | `--dsw-radius-xs` | 4px | 4px | | `--dsw-radius-sm` | 8px | 6px | | `--dsw-radius-md` | 12px | 8px | | `--dsw-radius-lg` | 16px | 12px | | `--dsw-radius-xl` | 20px | 16px | | `--dsw-radius-panel` | 28px | 20px | The corners that bypass the scale are reached through the stable `data-slot` and `data-*` hooks rather than a build hash. **Typography.** This is the part that most decides whether the result reads as a product or as a costume. Claude Desktop is a reading surface, so the transcript is set in the UI sans at a comfortable line height, and monospace is kept for the things that are actually code: | | Treatment | | --- | --- | | Assistant prose | UI sans, 1.65 line height, normal heading letter-spacing | | Inline code, code blocks, tool output | Monospace | | Sidebar, header, composer | UI sans | | Code-block banner | Sentence case, not shouted uppercase | **Transcript.** Your turn is a right-aligned bubble on a quiet surface; the assistant's is prose on the canvas; tool calls collapse into single-line summaries (`Ran 2 commands ›`) that expand in place, which is how Claude Desktop keeps a long working session scannable. **Composer.** One continuous rounded surface: the editor and the controls share a single card with no divider between them, the submit control is a circle, and focus draws a soft terracotta ring rather than a hard outline. **Chrome.** Quiet navigation rows instead of an elevated primary button, hover states limited to enabled controls, `focus-visible` rings for keyboard use, and thin warm scrollbars. ## Customisation Everything the component layer decides reads a `--cct-*` property declared once on `body`, so you can retune it from your own CSS without patching the package: ```css body { /* A serif reading face, the way long-form prose is often set. */ --cct-prose: Georgia, "Songti SC", serif; /* Roomier or tighter surfaces. */ --cct-composer-radius: 24px; --cct-control-radius: 6px; --cct-editor-inset: 20px; } ``` | Knob | Default | Purpose | | --- | --- | --- | | `--cct-sans` | system UI stack | UI face, including the sidebar and composer | | `--cct-prose` | `var(--cct-sans)` | Face used for assistant prose only | | `--cct-mono` | DSH's code stack | Code, tool output and paths | | `--cct-control-radius` | `8px` | Buttons, rows, chips, code blocks | | `--cct-composer-radius` | `18px` | The composer surface | | `--cct-editor-inset` | `16px` | Composer text inset from its edge | | `--cct-focus` | brand primary | Focus ring colour | To retune colours instead, stack your own layer on top — later layers win per token: ```js ctx.theme.overrideTokens('my-tweaks', { '--dsw-alias-brand-primary': { light: '#c96442', dark: '#d97757' }, }) ``` ## How it works The plugin is a browser half plus an inert host row. The browser half (`lib/client.js`) does exactly two things, both inside one Cordis effect, so unloading or HMR removes the theme completely: 1. Calls `ctx.theme.overrideTokens('dsh-claude-code-theme', …)` with 174 tokens as `{ light, dark }` pairs. This is DSH's documented third-party theme extension point. The service stacks the layer over the active palette and `ui-layout` writes it as inline custom properties on `` — which is why the theme outranks the base palette sheets without `!important`, and why overriding the `--dsw-static-*` ramps propagates to every alias that resolves through them. 2. plugins.description: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - **`normify_module_move` 迁移渲染数据时重写内容**：`id` / `order` / `groups.children` / `edge_hints` 全部改写到新 id， 并同步维护**旧父级**（删掉已迁出子模块的引用）与**新父级**（把新 id 补进 `order`）。 修复前：move 完之后项目立刻被 L2 判为 `layout/id-mismatch` + `layout/order-child` 等（实测 8–9 个 error，0.5.2 后为 0）。 - **晋升为容器时不再把 API 留在容器上**：叶子被晋升（显式 `normify_module_promote`、写子模块自动晋升、move 到叶子底下） 时，容器上残留的 `apis` 会被摘除，并回报 `structure/api-dropped-on-promote` 警告（附丢失的 API 键清单）—— 修复前项目会直接卡在 `api/non-leaf`。 - **API 默认全展开**：渲染数据字段 `max_api_rows` 缺省 **0 = 全部展开**，叶子上的 API 一行不折叠；需要收窄时显式写 1..48。 - 三处缺陷各自配了回归断言：`tests/regression-0.5.2.mjs`（34 项，全绿）。 ### v0.5.1 · 渲染器防重叠（线压线 12 → 0） - **修复连线共线重叠**：28 层合计 **12 处 → 0 处**。四处根因： ① 首选路由只判"不穿别人的框"，从不检查是否压到已画的线 → 改为只接受 `violations === 0` 的候选； ② API 锚定端口没有端口分离（同一 API 行被多条边共用） → 行内 ±5.5px 扇形分离； ③ API 端口落在上下边时被放进框内部 → 上下边退回按边均匀分离； ④ `segClear` 整块跳过源/目标框 → 新增"进入自身框内部"检查（内缩 2px）。 - 节点/分组间距 170 → 220，给密集层更多自由通道。 ### v0.5.0 · 取消模块数量上限 - **删除 `MAX_DEPTH = 12`** 硬限制：树可以一直下钻到"单一功能单元"；需要限层时用 `policy.yml` 的 `max-depth` 规则显式声明（`maxDepth` 放宽到 1..64）。 - SKILL：目标深度改为"不设上限"，单批上限 40 → 200，新增"每叶 API 尽量 3–5 条"的粒度指引。
更早的版本（v0.4.x / v0.3 / v0.2 / v0.1） - **v0.4.1**：渲染器 v3 定稿（自由通道走线、viewBox 全几何自适应、API 直连、跨层聚合、缩放与悬停）； `normify_sync` 识别**未跟踪的新文件**（`git ls-files --others`）。 - **v0.4.0**：伴随开发（`state: pla

plugins.description: Session deletion for DeepSeek Harness: recoverable trash-based delete, a sidebar menu row, and session_delete / session_restore agent tools.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-delete

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

[![test](https://github.com/hakulat2023/dsh-session-delete/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/hakulat2023/dsh-session-delete/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0b7285)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

Session **deletion** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

DeepSeek Harness can archive a Session, but archiving only hides it — there is no way to get rid of
one. This plugin adds that missing verb: **Delete session** in the Session row's “…” menu, a
`remote.sessionDelete` host namespace, and the `session_delete` / `session_restore` agent tools.

Deletion is deliberately **recoverable**: the Session's durable log is moved into a local trash
directory, so a mistake costs a `mv`, not a conversation.

- [What it does](#what-it-does)
- [Requirements](#requirements)
- [Install](#install)
- [Use](#use)
- [Configuration](#configuration)
- [Semantics and limits](#semantics-and-limits)
- [Development](#development)
- [Verified behaviour](#verified-behaviour)
- [License](#license)

## What it does

One deletion performs four steps:

1. **Admission.** The Session is asked the same questions archiving asks, through the
   `workspace/session-activity` waterfall. Live work is refused unless the caller allows a stop;
   when it is, `workspace/session-stop` cancels the turn and the plugin waits (bounded) for the
   Session to go idle. A Session still resident in the host process is refused *before any side
   effect* and only deleted after a second, explicit confirmation.
2. **Trash the log.** The Session's own directory is handed to the **platform's own trash** — the
   Finder's Trash on macOS, the XDG trash on Linux, the Recycle Bin on Windows — as
   `<sessionId>-<timestamp>`, carrying a `trash.json` record with the title, `cwd`, original
   directory, byte/file counts, and deletion time. `purge: true` deletes it outright instead.
   A small record is also written under `$DSH_HOME/session-delete/entries/` (entry path plus original
   directory, **no Session content**), because macOS refuses to let a process *enumerate* `~/.Trash`
   (TCC): without it a trashed Session could not be found again. See
   [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md).
3. **Drop the registrations.** The Session is detached from every Workspace account
   (`sessionIds`), removed from the registry-global archive and pin sets, and its projection-cache
   record is deleted.
4. **Tell the UI.** `api-session/removed` is emitted, so every connected browser drops the row
   immediately.

The Session directory is located through the persistence backend's own `locate(header)` when it
offers one, so a backend that changes its on-disk layout does not need a plugin update; otherwise the
plugin falls back to the documented `sessions/<projectKey(cwd)>/<encodeSegment(id)>` layout.

## Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.x` (developed and verified against `0.2.0-rc.2`) |
| Node.js | `>= 20` |
| Surface | any profile that mounts the Session store, the JSONL persistence backend, the Workspace registry, and the Web client (`dsh-web-app` / desktop) |

The plugin has **no npm dependencies** and **no build step**: the browser half is a hand-written
module in the `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` shape the Web client already consumes,
and the host half imports nothing outside `node:*`. See
[docs/plugin-packaging.md](docs/plugin-packaging.md) for why that matters for third-party plugins.

## Install

The package is a DSH **bundle**: `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and `dsh.client`, and
`cordis.patch.yml` inserts the host row.

```bash
# from a local checkout (this repository)
plugin_manager install_bundle   target: /absolute/path/to/dsh-session-delete

# or from GitHub, by tag, with the bundled CLI
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:hakulat2023/dsh-session-delete#v0.1.0

# or from the registry, once published
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-session-delete
```

The bundle patch that gets mounted is one row:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: session-delete
      name: dsh-session-delete
```

After installing, **restart the application once**. The host half is a Node ESM module and the
running process keeps the module generation it already loaded (DSH's own limitation: a replaced
package needs a restart to load fresh JavaScript). The browser half is served from disk and only
needs a page reload.

## Use

### Web UI

Session row → **“…”** → **Delete session** → confirm.

- A **running** Session is stopped first: the first confirmation already carries that intent.
- A Session that is still **resident** in the host (typically the one you have open) is described as
  such and needs a second confirmation; the first click has no side effect at all.
- On success the row disappears everywhere and a toast reports the outcome **and the trash directory**
  (a Session whose log was already gone is reported as such, never as a move).

### Agent tools

| Tool | Arguments | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `session_delete` | `session_id` (required), `stop_activity` (default `true`), `force` (default `false`), `purge` (default `false`) | Moves the Session to the trash; `purge: true` deletes the bytes permanently instead. |
| `session_restore` | `session_id` (required) | Moves a trashed Session directory back to its original location. |

### Remote namespace

`remote.sessionDelete.delete({ sessionId, stopActivity?, force?, purge? })` and
`remote.sessionDelete.restore({ sessionId })` — the same operations the UI dialog uses.

### Restoring by hand

A trashed Session is an ordinary directory in the platform's trash:

| Platform | Where it went | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| macOS | `~/.Trash/<sessionId>-<timestamp>/` | Finder shows it; “Put Back” is not offered (Finder did not move it), but `session_restore` works |
| Linux | `$XDG_DATA_HOME/Trash/files/…` with its `.trashinfo` | the desktop's own “Restore” works as well |
| Windows | the Recycle Bin | the plugin cannot read the bin back, so restore it by hand |

```bash
cat ~/.Trash/<sessionId>-*/trash.json      # originalDirectory, title, cwd, sizes
```

`session_restore(session_id)` puts it back and withdraws both records; the Session reappears in the
list once the Workspace registry next indexes stored headers (a reload, or the next launch).

## Configuration

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `trash` | `"system"` | Destination: `"system"` uses the platform's own trash, `"directory"` uses `trashRoot`, and any other string is taken as an absolute directory. |
| `trashRoot` | `$DSH_HOME/session-trash` | The directory used by `trash: directory` (and by `trashRoot` alone, for 0.1 compatibility). |
| `restoreIndexRoot` | `$DSH_HOME/session-delete` | Where the restore records live (`entries/<entry name>.json`). Metadata only — never Session content. |

```yaml
# keep the platform trash (the default): nothing to configure
- id: session-delete
  name: dsh-session-delete

# or own the destination, e.g. on a machine whose ~/.Trash is undesirable
- id: session-delete
  name: dsh-session-delete
  config:
    trash: directory
    trashRoot: /Volumes/big/dsh-session-trash
```

## Semantics and limits

- **Your trash, your decision.** Deleted Sessions land in the platform's trash and stay there until
  *you* empty it; the plugin never empties it, and it leaves no trash directory of its own behind.
- **macOS will not let a process list `~/.Trash`.** Moving in, reading a known entry, and moving it
  back out all work; `readdir` is refused by TCC. That is the only reason a restore record exists —
  `session_restore` follows the record instead of searching the trash. Emptying the trash makes the
  record stale, and a stale record is pruned rather than reported as a failure.
- **Windows restore is manual.** The Recycle Bin has no consumer-facing API for finding an entry
  again, so `session_delete` reports `trashedTo: null` and `session_restore` explains that the folder
  has to be restored f

plugins.description: Output house rules for every DeepSeek Harness agent: no check-mark or cross glyphs in replies or written files, and a light kaomoji habit in conversation. One global prompt section, so every preset, workspace and subagent obeys without a single preset edit.
plugins.readme_text:
# Oishikunaare-Moe-Moe-Kyun

> Chinese documentation: [README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md)

Output house rules for an AI agent: one core, and four ways to reach it. The rules are about how an
agent writes - judgement glyphs, emoji, the kaomoji habit, the language it thinks in - and none of that
is specific to one harness, so the package is not either.

| entry | what it is | how it is wired |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **CLI** `mmk` | `rules`, `lib`, `check`, `notice`, `voice`, `review`, `wire` | a shell, a git hook, CI, or a person asking whether a line would be refused. Exit 3 means a breach |
| **MCP server** | `mmk_rules`, `mmk_check`, `mmk_notice` and the `mmk://rules` resource | any MCP client, no assumption about which agent is on the other side |
| **Claude Code hook** | corrects a breach while the turn is still open | `Stop` answers `{"decision":"block","reason":<notice>}`, `UserPromptSubmit` and `SessionStart` attach context |
| **DSH plugin** | one global system prompt section for a whole profile | mounted once by the roster, so it reaches every preset, workspace, conversation and subagent |
| **modules** | `oishikunaare-moe-moe-kyun/portable`, `/transcripts` | writing another adapter: all of the above are thin layers over those two files |

`mmk wire <target>` prints the wiring for a specific place - the hook block, the MCP client block, the
`AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` / `GEMINI.md` rules block, the DSH plugin row - with real paths filled in.

### What is verified where

An entry that has never met the thing it is written for is not the same as one that has, and the
difference is worth stating instead of implying. This table is the honest version.

| entry | how it is verified |
| --- | --- |
| DSH plugin | In production on the machine this was written on: mounted in a live profile, and its rules and self-check are visible in real sessions |
| CLI `mmk` | Used on that machine for real work - auditing a session, answering whether a line would be refused - and exercised by `test/portable.mjs` |
| MCP server | The protocol is checked locally: a handshake, `tools/list`, every tool called, `resources/read`. The client half depends on the client |
| Claude Code hook | **Documented contract plus recorded fixtures only** (`npm run test:adapters`); never run against a live Claude Code, because none is installed here. The contract has moved between releases, so treat this one as a candidate rather than a supported entry |
| rules files (`mmk wire ...-md`) | The block is generated from the same resolved rules the plugin serves, so the text is verified; whether a given program reads that file is its own documentation |

When a harness that is not on this machine does become available, the way to close the gap is one
recorded payload: save the stdin JSON a hook actually receives as `adapters/fixtures/<harness>/<case>.json`
and `npm run test:adapters` replays it. That is what the fixture directory is for, and it is why adding
an adapter is cheap once someone can run the client - and why writing five of them from memory would not
be.

The DSH plugin row is worth explaining, because it is the anti-drift argument: a profile-level plugin is
mounted once by the roster, so the section it registers reaches every agent that joins that standing
scope - every preset, every workspace, every new conversation, and subagents too. That is why it is done
there rather than in fifteen preset files: a preset is a copy, and a copy is a thing that drifts. The
other entries exist because the same rules are worth having where no such roster exists.

Four rules ship today.

1. **Symbol discipline** - no check-mark or cross judgement glyphs, in a reply or in a file the agent
   writes. Those glyphs pollute context and regression parameters, and a file written today is read
   back into context tomorrow, so the ban covers files and not just replies. Say it in words instead:
   pass / fail, works / broken, applied / not applied, yes / no.
   Write for a reader who reads every sentence: normal punctuation is welcome, and the judgement belongs
   in words. Marks must not carry the structure either - a paragraph that reads as prose beats a column
   of markers, an item in a list should be a short sentence rather than a label, and a kaomoji is tone
   rather than layout.
2. **No emoji** - zero, in replies, in the agent's own thinking and in every file it writes. The ban is
   by colour rather than by block: the picture blocks are banned whole (pictographs, faces, transport,
   the supplemental pictographs), while in the two mixed blocks - Miscellaneous Symbols and the arrows
   block - only the code points that default to colour presentation count, so a pointing hand or a plain
   arrow drawn in lines is fine and a coloured umbrella or circle is not. The variation selector U+FE0F,
   the zero width joiner and the skin tone modifiers are named too, and a mark followed by U+FE0E is the
   writer asking for lines, which is honoured. Decoration is carved out - a heart, a note, a star, a
   sparkle, a flower - so the ban admits exactly the code points the loaded palette uses.
3. **Kaomoji habit** - Japanese-style emoticons in conversation and in the agent's own thinking, at a
   floor rather than as garnish: at least one per three sentences, and any reply of two sentences or
   more carries one. Aim above the floor. Faces rotate rather than repeat, and places that take none
   take none - a stack trace, a table of numbers, a serious conclusion. The self-check counts the
   **reply text** only, and the notice says so in one clause: the rule asks for the habit in thinking
   as well, but a glyph in thinking pollutes the transcript while a missing face there does not, so the
   floor is counted where it is visible.
4. **Thinking language** - think and answer in the user's own language instead of defaulting to
   English, which is not a neutral metalanguage: a Chinese conversation reasoned about in English is
   exactly the habit the rule exists to replace. Chinese gets Chinese with Japanese particles and
   terminology mixed in where they fall naturally; Japanese gets Japanese. English is available in one
   case only, the moe-fandom register - romanized Japanese words (kawaii, sugoi, moe, senpai, yabai,
   baka), fandom English (nya~, ehehe, ufufu, desu wa, the honorifics -chan / -san / -sama), waves and
   long vowels, alongside the kaomoji palette. Dry technical English is not that register. The reason
   is in the rule: the grammar and the logic of English do not match the habits of moe-fandom culture.
   It covers thinking and replies, and it never buys a fandom register with correctness - technical
   content stays accurate. File contents, code, commands and commit messages still carry no tone.
   This rule has its own self-check, the last of the four to get one: it reads the newest thinking block
   against what the human in the session has been writing, and when the thinking comes back in Latin
   while the reader writes Chinese or Japanese it says so once per drift, within a per-session budget
   (`languageCheck` / `languageCheckMax`). The numbers that argued for building it: CJK was 21.6% of the
   reasoning channel in one window and 2.4% in a later one, with nothing in the loop naming the drift.

Rule 4 differs from 1-3 in one mechanical way: it is not a per-rule override. `bannedSymbols`,
`kaomoji` and the `rules` object replace the rules they name, while the thinking-language block is
appended after them (and before `append`), because "mount this plugin and the agent thinks in the
user's language" is the promise of mounting it. `enabled: false` is what takes it away.

## Where this package takes its material from

This is a standard for **MMK itself** - the source of the markers, the palette and the prose it
ships - not a rule the plugin hands to an agent. Nothing here is injected into a prompt.

- **Taken**: moe-fandom culture of 1990-2015 - 90s bishoujo games and OVAs, 2000s galge and light
  novels, VOCALOID and doujin music, 2000s-2010s anime, and the mid-2010s "yami-kawaii" look. The
  traditional moe attributes stay available: tsundere, natural airhead, frail, denpa,
