plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

plugins.description: Simple notepad plugin for DeepSeek Harness: record short notes in a global ($DSH_HOME) or project (<projectRoot>/.dsh) level
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-notepad

[![dsh-plugin topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/topics-dsh--plugin-blue)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-notepad)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-notepad)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)

一个简易的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：记录短笔记，并按「全局级 / 项目级」分开存放。

## 特性

- 三个模型可调用工具：`notepad_add`、`notepad_list`、`notepad_clear`
- 一个人类斜杠命令：`/note`（没有命令注册表的部署会自动跳过）
- 一个图形面板：侧边栏「速记」图标 → 中央主面板，增删改查 + 跟随当前会话
- 笔记以 JSON Lines 明文保存，可直接 `cat` / 搜索 / 纳入 git
- 零运行时依赖、零构建步骤：只用 Node 内置模块 + DSH 自带的 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`

## 安装

包声明了 `dsh.bundle`，所以它是一个**组合包**（bundle）：`dsh plugin add` 装进某个 profile 后，`cordis.patch.yml` 这一层会自动激活（按包名解析插件入口）。

```sh
# 从 npm
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-notepad

# 或直接从 GitHub 源码装（纯 JS、无构建步骤，不会触发 pnpm 的构建授权）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:qux-bbb/dsh-plugin-notepad

# 只验证这一层、不启动
dsh --profile desktop --dump-config     # 应能看到 "# == dsh-plugin-notepad" 这一层

# 卸载
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-plugin-notepad
```

> 用 git 装请锁定 commit（`github:qux-bbb/dsh-plugin-notepad#<sha>`），避免后续推送悄悄改变实际运行的内容。

### 手动安装器

仓库自带 `scripts/install-notepad.mjs`，把包装进 `<profile>/plugins/notepad/` 并往 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 写一个受标记包围的区块。它幂等、改动前备份、`--uninstall` 只删自己写入的区块，适合 `desktop` 这类 `dsh plugin` 不便处理的 profile：

```powershell
$node = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe"

& $node scripts\install-notepad.mjs --profile desktop             # 装到当前 desktop profile
& $node scripts\install-notepad.mjs --scope home                  # 或装到全局（$DSH_HOME），对所有 profile 生效
& $node scripts\install-notepad.mjs --profile desktop --dry-run   # 先看看会改什么
& $node scripts\install-notepad.mjs --profile desktop --uninstall # 卸载
```

生效方式：DSH 的分层顺序是 `bundle 补丁 → profile 的 cordis.patch.yml → $DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml → --patch`。补丁文件的改动会被热重载；但已变成 `inactive` 且配置未变的条目宿主不会重试，此时改一次配置值或重启应用。

## 使用

### 工具

| 工具 | 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `notepad_add` | `content`（必填）、`tags?`、`scope?` | 记一条，正文自动 trim，标签去重 |
| `notepad_list` | `scope?`、`query?`、`limit?` | 新的在前；省略 `scope` = 合并所有启用层级；`query` 对正文 / 标签 / id 做子串过滤 |
| `notepad_clear` | `scope`（必填）、`confirm: true`（必填） | 清空指定层级（破坏性） |

`notepad_add` 返回 `{ id, at, scope, tags, content, file, total }`：

```
Noted p-mv6ieauq-01fmiy at 2026-10-13T09:59:19.922Z in the project notepad (3 note(s) there).
File: D:\work\repo\.dsh\notepad\notes.jsonl
```

### `/note` 命令

- `/note 记一条内容` → 新增一条（走默认层级）
- `/note`（不带内容）→ 列出最近 5 条

### 图形面板

侧边栏底部的 **速记** 图标（`sidebar.panellist`，order 40）会在中央主面板（`main`）打开完整界面：

- **跟随当前会话**：点开就是当前会话所在项目的 notepad；下拉可临时切到别的项目，「跟随会话」按钮一键切回，切换会话后 1.5s 内自动跟随。
- **两个层级标签页**：`项目` / `全局`，各自独立列表。
- 每条笔记支持新增、编辑（保留 id 与创建时间）、删除、打标签；顶部有搜索、刷新、清空当前层级；底部显示实际文件路径。
- 面板与模型工具、`/note` 读写的是**同一批文件**，界面上改完 `notepad_list` 立刻可见。

配置 `level` 决定哪几个标签页可用（`global` / `project` / `both`），被禁用的那一页会置灰提示。

## 配置

写在补丁条目的 `config:` 下，或由设置界面编辑（`dsh --dump-config-schema` 能看到）：

| 字段 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `level` | `global` \| `project` \| `both` | `both` | 本部署暴露哪些层级 |
| `defaultScope` | `global` \| `project` | `project` | 调用省略 `scope` 时的落点 |
| `dshHome` | string | `''` | 全局层根目录；空 = `$DSH_HOME`，再退到 `~/.dsh` |
| `globalDir` | string | `''` | 覆盖全局笔记目录（支持 `~`），空 = `<dshHome>/notepad` |
| `projectDir` | string | `''` | 覆盖项目笔记目录（支持 `~`），空 = `<项目根>/.dsh/notepad` |
| `fileName` | string | `notes.jsonl` | 笔记文件名（只接受纯文件名） |
| `projectRootMarkers` | string[] | `['.git','.hg','.svn']` | 向上查找项目根的标记；`[]` 表示工作目录即项目根 |
| `maxNotes` | integer | `1000` | 单文件上限，超出丢弃最旧；`0` = 不裁剪 |
| `maxContentLength` | integer | `4000` | 单条正文字符上限 |
| `defaultLimit` | integer | `20` | 列表默认条数 |
| `toolPrefix` | string | `notepad` | 工具名前缀（合法值才会被采纳） |
| `enableCommand` | boolean | `true` | 是否注册 `/note` |

```yaml
# 只要全局笔记（只改设置项的写法；已用 dsh plugin add 装好时不要 insert，按 - id: notepad 覆盖该行）
- insert:
    - id: notepad
      name: dsh-plugin-notepad
      config:
        level: global
        defaultScope: global
```

注意 patch 会替换整行的 `config`（不是深合并），所以要重述你需要的每一个键。

## 存储

| 层级 | 默认路径 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `global` | `<DSH_HOME>/notepad/notes.jsonl` | 跨项目共享，比如「我的偏好」「常用命令」 |
| `project` | `<项目根>/.dsh/notepad/notes.jsonl` | 只属于当前项目 |

项目根 = 从会话工作目录向上查找最近的 `.git` / `.hg` / `.svn`；找不到就用会话工作目录本身。默认**不把 `.dsh` 当项目根标记**——DSH home 本身就是 `<home>/.dsh`，否则用户主目录下任何路径都会判定为「项目根 = 主目录」，项目笔记会静默混进全局文件。

每行一条 JSON，追加写；单条解析失败的行会被跳过而不是让列表整体失败：

```json
{"id":"p-mv6ieauq-01fmiy","at":"2026-10-13T09:59:19.922Z","scope":"project","tags":["errand"],"content":"remember the milk"}
```

写入按**笔记文件**串行（而不是按 store 实例），两个 store 落到同一文件时也不会互相覆盖或写出半行；改写与 `maxNotes` 裁剪都先写临时文件再 rename。

## 项目结构

```
dsh-plugin-notepad/            # 仓库根就是插件包根（dsh plugin add github: 要求如此）
├─ package.json                # name / exports / dsh.bundle + dsh.client
├─ cordis.patch.yml            # 组合包贡献的配置层
├─ lib/index.js                # 宿主半入口：name / inject / Config / apply + HTTP 路由
├─ lib/store.js                # 存储层：路径解析、JSONL 读写、编辑/删除、裁剪、并发串行化
├─ lib/api.js                  # 面板用的 JSON API（纯处理函数，可单测）
├─ lib/client.js               # 浏览器半：手写的经典脚本，无需编译
├─ test/                       # node:test 单元测试
└─ scripts/                    # install-notepad.mjs / smoke-runtime.mjs / dev-link.ps1
```

宿主半按 DSH 内置插件的形状写，只用**具名导出**（`name` / `inject` / `Config` / `apply`），不提供 `export default`；`peerDependencies` 统一写成 `"*"`，避免被具体宿主运行时版本判定不兼容而拒绝挂载。

## 开发

```powershell
# 让本仓库的 bare import（@deepseek-ai/schemastery、@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools）能解析
powershell -File scripts\dev-link.ps1

# 单元测试 + 端到端冒烟
node --test
node scripts\smoke-runtime.mjs
```

`dev-link.ps1` 只在 `node_modules/@deepseek-ai` 建一个指向 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai` 的 junction，不复制、不安装任何包。插件装进 profile 后不依赖它。

新增浏览器半需要重启一次应用（`clientModules` 缓存包元数据）；之后只改 `lib/client.js` 会被 client-hmr 热重载。宿主半的新代码会命中 Node 模块缓存，需重启才加载。

## 发布

1. **加话题**：仓库页 About → Topics 加 `dsh-plugin`（或 `gh repo edit --add-topic dsh-plugin`），仓库会出现在 [github.com/topics/dsh-plugin](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) 下。
2. **发 npm**：仓库根执行 `npm publish`。纯 JS、无构建步骤，`files` 已列出 `lib`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`README.md`、`LICENSE`。
3. **从 GitHub 装**：`dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:qux-bbb/dsh-plugin-notepad`。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: 以证据为准的代码审阅插件：审 diff、验证结论、记录噪音，让 agent 先读、人只读结论。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-review

[English](README.en.md)

提交代码前，让独立审阅者找出具体缺陷，再交给另一组审阅者复核。你看到的是经过验证的问题、明确的未完成项和仍需人工决定的事。

参考 [Claude Code 团队的审阅流程](https://claude.dev/blog/solving-code-review-at-anthropic/)，实现其中可在 DSH 内完成的审阅环节。它不授予人工批准，也不会自动发评论或合并代码。

## 使用

需要 Git、Node.js 22.19+ / 24+，以及提供子智能体、权限预设和作业管理服务的官方 DSH 运行环境。适配验收使用 DSH 0.2.1-rc.1。在 Git 仓库根目录创建会话后，让 DSH：

> 审阅当前改动，运行 dsh-review。只报告有具体触发条件、代码证据和独立复核的问题。审查没完成时不要说通过。

安装到 Web profile：

~~~bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @stardustlc/dsh-review
~~~

桌面版应安装到它实际使用的 profile，并在新的会话中加载插件。插件不会查找、复制或修改其他 profile 的密钥。

请使用带作用域的包名。npm 上未加作用域的 dsh-review 属于其他作者，不是本仓库。

常见调用：

~~~json
{"tool":"review_run","arguments":{"base":"main"}}
~~~

省略 base 审当前工作区；staged=true 审暂存区。需要中断后续工作时取消正在运行的工具；恢复未完成审查时使用返回的 runId。敏感改动始终使用 deep，不能通过参数降级。

## 审阅如何完成

| 模式 | 独立找问题 | 每个问题的复核 | 汇总 |
|---|---|---|---|
| quick | 正确性、安全，2 个任务 | 1 个独立审阅者 | 确定性把关 |
| standard | 正确性、状态、兼容性、安全，4 个任务 | 3 人投票，至少 2 票一致 | 确定性把关 |
| deep | 同 standard | 3 人投票，至少 2 票一致 | 另派汇总者，不能删掉已确认的问题 |

每轮还有两个独立风险判断任务，分别判断风险等级和是否需要额外人工审阅。所有任务使用新的上下文；继承作者对话的 fork 后端不会被接受。

- 每轮绑定 Git 基准、HEAD、完整文件快照和唯一运行编号。代码变化、结果缺失、格式损坏或超限都会阻止放行。
- 复核必须说明具体成因并引用快照中的真实代码行。一个非空 evidence 字符串不算验证。
- 风格、命名、格式和清理建议直接过滤。已发表问题按指纹去重；每条仍须修复或写明处置原因。
- 默认最多 3 轮。从第 3 轮起，新问题限定在相对上轮的实际新增改动；旧问题继续复核，新文件不会漏掉。
- 只有独立复核确认问题已消失，才能自动记为 fixed。人工说明 wrong、intentional 或 wontfix 会保留理由，但不计作人工批准。
- 只生成作业书的外部模式可用于协作，无法证明执行独立性，因此不会通过自动门禁。

二进制变更需要另行验收，文字审查不会认证其内容。跳过的路径会公开列出，并仍参与风险判断。

## 十个工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| review_diff | 生成快照与审阅计划，不作通过结论 |
| review_run | 执行或恢复分阶段独立审阅 |
| review_report | 提交外部任务的运行编号、目标编号与 JSON 结果 |
| review_check | 经宿主受控终端运行检查，保存本轮证据收据 |
| review_respond | 记录带理由的处置；fixed 必须重新复核 |
| review_status | 查看未完成项、轮次、调用量和处置噪音率 |
| review_gate | 检查当前快照的 AI 审阅层，不代替 CI 或人工批准 |
| review_learn | 从已验证修复中生成规则草稿，不自动改项目规范 |
| review_issue | 生成 issue 分诊和复现草稿，不执行正文指令或发表评论 |
| review_eval | 登记人工标注缺陷与干净样本、准备盲测、绑定运行结果并计分 |

## 检查、权限与证据

review_check 的命令经调用者实际使用的宿主终端工具运行，不直接创建绕过权限的进程。只读会话不运行证据命令；可使用静态源码复核。取消、超时和后台作业清理都受宿主管理。

Windows 官方预设只提供 pwsh 时，通过这个受控工具调用 Git Bash；需要 Git Bash 和 PowerShell 7.3+。原命令保留可见，引号不经 cmd 拼接。不能使用这条路径时会明确报错，不会静默换成直接执行。

证据收据绑定 runId 和 targetId；命令改变代码后收据失效。请正常批准必要权限，不要为了审阅扩大整个会话的权限。

## 接入仓库流程

仓库级 REVIEW.md 可以写失败判据、跳过路径、敏感目录和噪音上限：

~~~markdown
## 限制
max_nits: 0
severity_floor: important

## 跳过
- vendor/**

## 坏掉长什么样
- 文档给出的命令不能执行
- 配置将请求发送到错误账号

## 敏感路径
- src/billing/**
~~~

完整 PR 门禁还需独立的 CI、安全检查、人工批准和所有审阅线程的解决状态。新增命令 dsh-review-gate 只读取 GitHub 证据，策略固定从 PR 基准提交读取；机器人、旧提交和已撤回的批准不能填人工名额。

详见 [接入与回滚](docs/INTEGRATION.md)、[文章对应边界](docs/DESIGN.md) 和 [验证记录](docs/VALIDATION.md)。合并队列、功能开关、灰度和回滚由仓库/发布系统负责，安装插件不会自动启用这些制度。

## 状态与配置

默认状态保存在 DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-review/<仓库摘要>/，不写入被审项目。可指定仓库内子目录，例如 .dsh-review。账本版本为 2；旧账本会保留备份，旧版本的“通过”不会沿用。

| 配置 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| stateDir | @profile | profile 下按仓库隔离；也可指定仓库内子目录 |
| roundCap | 3 | 每个审阅系列的完成轮次上限 |
| diffOnlyAfterRound | 2 | 超过这轮后只对新增改动提出新问题 |
| maxFindings / maxNits | 20 / 2 | 问题数与 nit 上限 |
| severityFloor | important | 默认不发表 nit |
| maxCalls / maxParallel | 80 / 3 | 每轮实际派发预算、最大并发 |
| runTimeoutMs | 600000 | 每次执行的总超时 |
| commandTimeoutMs | 120000 | 单条证据命令超时 |
| maxDiffBytes | 4194304 | 补丁及源码快照总量上限；超出则未完成 |
| subagentProvider | spawn | 必须明确保证不继承作者上下文 |

evidenceRequired 为旧配置兼容项，设为 false 也不能关闭独立证据验证。v0.2 的手工 head/findings 提交接口已停用，迁移见接入文档。

欢迎提交 [Issues](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-review/issues) 和 PR，最好附具体触发输入、版本、预期结果与实际结果。请先去掉密钥和私有代码。

[更新记录](CHANGELOG.md) · MIT License

plugins.description: 在 dsh 里装上这个插件即可无需登录、注册或填 API Key，就能使用mimo-v2.6-flash-free 等模型——完全免费，不限量。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-xl-free-model

在 [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) 中自动运行本地 OpenAI 兼容代理的插件，经 OpenCode 免费通道使用 `mimo-v2.6-flash-free` 等 free 模型。支持流式、多轮会话复用、function calling 桥接与无头 CLI 后备（桌面版未打开时自动拉起）。

模型通过 Host 半身注册的 LlmAdapter **直接出现在会话的模型选择列表中**（provider: `xl-free-model`），无需在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 手工配置 provider。设置页含 **XL Free Model** 插页，展示代理状态与模型卡片列表。

## 功能特性

- **零配置模型接入**：安装插件后，免费模型自动出现在会话的模型选择列表
- **本地代理**：OpenAI 兼容 API（`http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1`），可被任意 OpenAI SDK 调用
- **自动管理**：dsh 启动时自动拉起代理，退出时自动清理
- **桌面/无头双后端**：优先复用已打开的 OpenCode 桌面版；未打开时自动启动无头 CLI 后备
- **CLI 二进制自动安装**：缺失时直接从 npm registry 下载 tarball 解压（无需 npm 在 PATH），npm install 兜底
- **流式支持**：完整支持 SSE 流式响应
- **Function Calling**：通过提示词桥接模拟工具调用
- **会话复用**：后端连接池自动复用，提升响应速度
- **PEB 密码发现**：无需手动配置密码，自动从 OpenCode 进程环境读取

## 安装

### 前置条件

- Windows 10/11 x64
- Node.js ≥ 22
- dsh 桌面版或 CLI

### 步骤

1. **克隆仓库**

   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/zhangmaorongXL/dsh-xl-free-model.git
   cd dsh-xl-free-model
   ```

2. **安装到 dsh**

   将本目录复制到 dsh 插件目录，或在 dsh 设置中指定插件路径。

5. **重启 dsh**

   重启后，会话模型选择列表中将出现 `XL Free Model` 分组，包含可用的免费模型。

## 使用

### 在 dsh 中使用

1. 新建会话
2. 在模型选择器中选择 `XL Free Model` 分组下的模型（如 `mimo-v2.6-flash-free`）
3. 正常对话即可

### 独立使用代理

代理兼容 OpenAI API，可被任意支持自定义 base URL 的工具调用：

```bash
# 启动代理（dsh 运行时会自动管理，通常无需手动）
node proxy.cjs
```

```python
# Python 示例
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1",
    api_key="changeme-dsh-key"  # proxy.config.json 中的 apiKey
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="mimo-v2.6-flash-free",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "你好"}],
    stream=True
)
```

```javascript
// Node.js 示例
import OpenAI from "openai";

const client = new OpenAI({
  baseURL: "http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1",
  apiKey: "changeme-dsh-key",
});

const stream = await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: "mimo-v2.6-flash-free",
  messages: [{ role: "user", content: "你好" }],
  stream: true,
});
```

## 配置

`proxy.config.json` 完整配置项：

```json
{
  "proxyHost": "127.0.0.1",        // 代理监听地址
  "proxyPort": 8787,               // 代理监听端口
  "apiKey": "changeme-dsh-key",    // API Key（必改）
  "backend": {
    "host": "",                    // OpenCode 后端地址（留空自动发现）
    "port": 0,                     // OpenCode 后端端口（留空自动发现）
    "username": "opencode",        // 后端用户名
    "password": "",                // 后端密码（留空自动 PEB 发现）
    "cli": {
      "enabled": true,             // 是否启用无头 CLI 后备
      "path": "cli\\node_modules\\opencode-windows-x64\\bin\\opencode.exe",
      "port": 4097                 // CLI 后备端口
    }
  }
}
```

## 架构

```
dsh-xl-free-model/
├── index.js              # Host 半身：挂载代理 + 注册 LlmAdapter + CLI 二进制自动安装
├── adapter.js            # LlmAdapter 实现（dsh 结构化契约）
├── client.js             # Browser 半身：设置页插页 UI
├── proxy.cjs             # 本地 OpenAI 兼容代理服务器
├── peb_env.ps1           # PEB 密码发现脚本（PowerShell）
├── proxy.config.json     # 代理配置
├── cordis.patch.yml      # dsh bundle patch（仅挂载 Host）
├── package.json          # 插件清单
├── cli/                  # OpenCode 无头 CLI 后备
│   ├── package.json      # npm 依赖清单（opencode-ai）
│   └── node_modules/     # 自动下载/npm install 后生成（.gitignore 排除）
├── .gitignore            # 排除大文件与运行时产物
├── LICENSE               # MIT
└── README.md
```

### 工作流程

1. dsh 加载插件 → `index.js` 的 `apply()` 执行
2. 读取 `proxy.config.json`，注入 API Key 环境变量
3. 检测代理是否已在运行；未运行则 spawn `proxy.cjs`
4. 通过 `ctx.llm.registerAdapter()` 注册 `xl-free-model` provider
5. `adapter.js` 的 `listModels()` 从代理拉取模型列表
6. 会话选择模型时，`adapter.js` 的 `stream()` 转发请求到代理
7. 代理转发到 OpenCode 后端（桌面版或无头 CLI），返回流式响应

## 故障排查

### 模型未出现在选择列表

- 检查 dsh 日志（`~/.dsh/logs/`）中 `registerAdapter failed` 错误
- 确认代理已启动：`curl http://127.0.0.1:8787/health`
- 重启 dsh

### 代理启动失败

- 检查端口占用：`netstat -ano | findstr 8787`
- 查看 `cli-serve.log`（CLI 后备日志）
- 确认 `cli/node_modules/opencode-windows-x64/bin/opencode.exe` 存在

### 密码获取失败

- 确认 OpenCode 桌面版已打开
- 手动测试：`powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File peb_env.ps1 OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD`
- 或在 `proxy.config.json` 的 `backend.password` 中手动填写

## 开发

### 本地测试

```bash
# 语法检查
node --check index.js
node --check adapter.js
node --check client.js
node --check proxy.cjs

# 启动代理（前台运行）
node proxy.cjs
```

### 修改适配器

`adapter.js` 实现了 dsh 的结构化 LlmAdapter 契约：

- `providerInfo(provider)` → `{ id, name }`
- `listModels(provider)` → `LlmModelInfo[]`
- `resolveModel(provider, model)` → `ResolvedModelInfo`
- `prepareCall(provider, model)` → `{ model, stream }`
- `stream(options)` → `AsyncIterable<StreamChunk>`

参考 dsh 源码中的 `LlmAdapter` 类型定义。

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a

# dsh-proxy-switch

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的出站代理开关。**Clash 开着就走 Clash，关掉就自动直连，界面上一键切换，不用重启 DSH。** Outbound proxy switch for DeepSeek Harness: a local router picks Clash or direct per mode, with an in-UI switch. No DSH restart. - 仓库：https://github.com/tonyAmadeus/dsh-proxy-switch - npm：https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-proxy-switch - 测试环境：DSH 桌面版 `0.2.1-rc.2`（Windows 11） - 许可证：MIT --- ## 为什么需要它 DSH 的代理策略是**启动器在插件加载之前**从 `.env` 一次性安装的： - 如果你把 `.env` 写成 `https_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:7897`（Clash），那 **Clash 一关，DSH 全线断网**； - 插件加载得比这晚，改不了已经装好的策略。 本插件让 `.env` 指向它自己的**本地路由器**，由路由器在每次连接时决定出口： ``` .env ──▶ 127.0.0.1:17897（本插件的路由器） ├─ auto : Clash 可达 → 走 Clash；不可达 → 直连 ├─ direct : 直连 └─ clash : 走 Clash（不自动回退） ``` 顺带的好处：DSH 看到 `HTTPS_PROXY` 就会走代理，并**跳过私有地址校验**（域名交给代理解析）， 所以 Clash TUN + fake-ip 环境下 `web_fetch` 报 `non-public IP` 的问题也一并解决了。 --- ## 安装 ### 1. 安装插件 从 npm 安装（推荐，最简单）： ```powershell dsh plugin add dsh-proxy-switch@0.3.1 ``` 也可以直接锁定 git tag（不依赖 npm）： ```powershell dsh plugin add "git+https://github.com/tonyAmadeus/dsh-proxy-switch.git#v0.3.1" ``` 想要更严格，可以把 `#` 后面换成仓库首页显示的 commit hash，commit 完全不可变。 ### 2. 让 DSH 走这个路由器 编辑 `~/.dsh/.env`（Windows：`C:\Users\\.dsh\.env`），加入： ```ini http_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:17897 https_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:17897 ``` 然后**重启一次 DSH**（`.env` 只在启动时读取）。 > 这两行是**必须的**：不配的话插件不会参与选路，Clash 关掉时 DSH 照样断网。 > 端口 `17897` 若在插件配置里改过，这里要同步改。 --- ## 使用 插件提供两个入口： 1. **设置 → 代理**（英文界面 **Proxy**）——完整设置页：出口模式、运行状态、聊天框按钮开关 2. **聊天输入框右下方的 🌐 按钮**（默认开启）——随手点开即可切换模式 | 模式 | 行为 | 何时用 | |---|---|---| | **自动**（默认） | 探测 Clash（1 秒缓存）：在线 → 走 Clash；离线 → 直连 | 日常 | | **直连** | 一律直连 | 明确不开 Clash | | **走 Clash** | 一律走 Clash，不自动回退 | 必须确保走节点 | 切换即时生效——路由器在每条连接上重读模式文件，不需要重启 DSH。 状态行会显示 `Clash 在线/未运行`、`路由器在线/离线`。 ### 显示 / 隐藏聊天框按钮 设置页底部有 **「在聊天框下方显示插件按钮」** 开关（默认开启）： - **开启**：聊天输入框下方显示 🌐 按钮（和以前一样） - **关闭**：聊天区不再显示按钮，只保留设置页这一处入口 开关状态保存在 `$DSH_HOME/proxy-ui.json`，重启 DSH 后保持；两处入口的模式状态是共享的。 --- ## 配置 默认配置在插件的 `cordis.patch.yml`。要覆盖，在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里加一条**同 id** 的 patch 条目（profile 是 `~/.dsh/profiles/<名字>/`）： ```yaml - id: dsh-proxy-switch config: routerPort: 17897 clashPort: 7897 ``` | 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `routerPort` | `17897` | 本地路由器监听端口（`.env` 要指向它） | | `clashPort` | `7897` | Clash / Mihomo 的混合端口（Clash Verge Rev 默认 7897，原版 Clash 常见 7890） | | `modeFile` | `$DSH_HOME/proxy-mode.txt` | 模式文件（`auto` / `direct` / `clash`） | | `logFile` | `$DSH_HOME/dsh-proxy-switch.log` | 运行日志（超 512KB 自动截断） | | `uiFile` | `$DSH_HOME/proxy-ui.json` | 界面状态（聊天框按钮是否显示） | `$DSH_HOME` 默认是 `~/.dsh`，可用环境变量覆盖。 --- ## 排障 ```powershell # 路由器是否在监听 Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 17897 -State Listen # 日志（Windows 默认路径） Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dsh-proxy-switch.log" -Tail 20 # 手动经路由器抓网页（应返回 200） curl.exe -sS -x http://127.0.0.1:17897 -o NUL -w "%{http_code}`n" https://example.com # 强制切直连（等价于在 设置 → 代理 里选「直连」） Set-Content -NoNewline "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\proxy-mode.txt" direct ``` - **DSH 启动头一两秒有报错**：正常。插件拉起路由器需要约 1–2 秒，之后自愈。 - **日志出现 `owner process ... gone, exiting`**：上一轮 DSH 退出后路由器按约定自我清理，属正常。 - **一直连不上**：先确认 `.env` 里那两行在；再确认模式不是「走 Clash」而 Clash 没开。 - **设置里看不到「代理」这一节**：说明插件没加载成功，看 DSH 插件页的错误信息与上面的日志。 ### 卸载 ```powershell dsh plugin remove dsh-proxy-switch ``` 然后删掉 `.env` 里那两行并重启 DSH。 --- ## 已知限制 - **只支持 HTTP/HTTPS 代理**：DSH 不支持 SOCKS；本路由器只处理 HTTP 与 CONNECT。 - **启动窗口**：DSH 启动后约 1–2 秒内端口可能尚未监听，期间请求会失败一次，随后自动恢复。 - **Clash 端口因客户端而异**：Clash Verge Rev 用 7897，原版 Clash 常见 7890 —— 按自己的客户端改 `clashPort`。 - **DSH 升级**：插件经 profile 依赖加载，升级后一般仍在；DSH 行为若变化可能需要更新插件。 - **路由器进程**：由插件用 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE` 拉起，DSH 退出约 2 秒后自行退出，不留孤儿进程。 --- ## 参考 - DSH 代理策略：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-http-proxy`（启动器一次性安装，插件不可改） - 市场索引格式：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index` ## License MIT © 2026 tonyAmadeus

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-butler

English | [中文](<docs/zh.md>)

`dsh-butler` is the Butler plugin for the DSH App, shipping its browser UI and local host in one package. The host registers routes, scans extensions, and manages processes through DSH's `webServer` and `subprocess` services. It does not start a standalone Guardian, install a LaunchAgent, or depend on Nowledge Mem.

## DSH compatibility

The compatibility declaration is limited to DSH **0.2.0-rc.2 or 0.2.1-rc.2**. Both `engines.dsh` and the optional peer `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot` use exactly `0.2.0-rc.2 || 0.2.1-rc.2`; the optional peer describes the host without installing another DSH runtime. It does not claim compatibility with later prereleases. Recheck Host services, session events, and Client Slots after a DSH upgrade; metadata and local tests do not replace live App acceptance.

## Working directory

Plugin configuration accepts `workdir`, defaulting to `~/.dsh/butler/`. On first load, the plugin copies its built-in generic skeleton; a directory that already contains `butler.json` is not overwritten. Personal data, interpreter configuration, and extensions belong to the instance working directory and can be migrated together. The plugin does not assume a personal workspace.

Example root configuration for the working directory:

```json
{
  "scanRoots": ["tools", "services", "faculties"],
  "selfRoot": "self",
  "validityRoot": ".",
  "python": "/path/to/python",
  "bun": "/opt/homebrew/bin/bun",
  "notification": {
    "enabled": true,
    "command": ["bun", "notification-bridge/scripts/cli.js", "send", "--stdin"]
  },
  "endpoints": {},
  "collector": { "enabled": true, "workspaces": [], "excludePresets": ["butler"], "debounceMs": 2000 },
  "automations": {}
}
```

Relative paths are resolved against the directory containing `butler.json`. Extensions under `tools/` and `services/` with `hosted.autoStart` resume when the DSH App starts; DSH's subprocess managed range terminates them when the App exits or the plugin unloads. Services do not restart automatically; tools restart inside the host according to their manifest policy. Bounded commands and reports from `faculties/` also run through the same subprocess integration.

## Host API

Public Host APIs share DSH's same-origin prefix `/myspace-butler/api`; the original client paths `/myspace-butler/*` remain compatibility aliases. Routes include `/health`, `/catalog`, `/services`, `/faculties`, `/runs`, and `/quick-actions`; tool lists come from `/overview`. Both tools and services support `/:kind/:id/{start,stop,restart}` and `/:kind/:id/log` SSE. Requests accept only local same-origin browser traffic or local SDK calls. The public extension catalog excludes commands and environment variables; configuration-editing endpoints are for trusted local calls only. See [HOST.md](<HOST.md>) for the complete routes.

Extensions use a `butler.json` in each directory; see [the schema](<spec/butler.schema.json>) for all fields. The SDK runner sends events using `BUTLER_HOST_URL`; `BUTLER_GUARDIAN_URL` is only a compatibility alias for old extensions, not a new configuration entry point.

**Delegations:** tools/services may declare steps requiring judgment in their manifests. The Host delegates them to a new Butler Session (`POST /delegations`, blocking until submission, timeout, or failure). Only the Host drives sessions: it creates a butler-preset session with `sessionController.create`, delivers a `prompt` using the delegation ID as requestId, and calls `cancel` on timeout. The session may use only the declared tools and `butler_delegation_submit`; results are validated against the declared schema. Results with `risk: confirm` remain pending in the observation area. `POST /runs/:runId/steps/:i/confirm` uses the same owner-only gate as card review (`X-Butler-Review` plus same-origin Origin or authenticated desktop forwarding). If DSH does not provide `sessionController.prompt`, `/delegations` returns 503 and callers use their own fallback. See [the SDK README](<sdk/README.md>) for usage.

## Unified MCP service (Butler Framework MCP standard)

Three layers communicate only through manifests and the MCP protocol:

| Layer | Responsibility | Exclusions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Framework (`spec/butler.schema.json`) | Defines the `mcp` registration block: `transport: "stdio"`, `command`, optional `cwd/env/namespace/timeoutSec`; tools/services only | No independently exposed `http`/`url` forms |
| Host (`src/host/mcp-hub.ts`) | Derives providers from scan results without a second registry; starts stdio subprocesses through `Spawner` on demand; aggregates as `<namespace>__<tool>`; serves stateless Streamable HTTP at `/myspace-butler/api/mcp`; adds/removes providers on rescan and restarts them when idle; terminates with the managed range on App exit | Does not import extension code or interpret business parameters |
| Extension | Implements a stdio MCP server | Does not listen on an MCP port or call Host internals; may reject direct client connections using `BUTLER_MCP_CHANNEL=butler-hub` |

Clients configure just one address: `http://127.0.0.1:19387/myspace-butler/api/mcp` (the desktop profile's App port). `GET /api/mcp/status` reports provider status, exposed tool names, namespace conflicts, and rejected tool names. The default namespace replaces `-` in the ID with `_`; exposed names must match `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$`. Nonmatching tools are not exposed and appear in status. A provider crash affects only that provider: calls return an `isError` result and startup is retried after 5 seconds, without affecting other providers. The security boundary matches other Host APIs: loopback only, rejecting cross-site Origins (the DNS rebinding protection required by MCP).

**Unified MCP service:** tools/services in Butler that provide MCP declare only an `mcp` block (`transport:"stdio"` plus `command`). The Host lazily starts and aggregates them, exposing `POST /myspace-butler/api/mcp` (Streamable HTTP) with tool names `<namespace>__<tool>`. **Tools must not expose their own MCP listener or register directly with any client.** The Host does not import tool code; tools depend only on stdio MCP and the `BUTLER_MCP_CHANNEL` environment marker. The manifest contract is the sole connection between them. Clients register only `http://127.0.0.1:19387/myspace-butler/api/mcp`; status is at `/api/mcp/status`. See [HOST.md](<HOST.md#mcp-统一服务>).

## Dashboard display preferences

Services and tools each retain a “Show all / Show resident” mode. The heading arrow switches the display scope rather than collapsing the whole section. “Display management · N stored” is a single entry opening a drawer with all items. There you can mark items resident, operate them directly, and save or cancel display changes; card menus can also store individual items or mark them resident.

Storing an item is exclusively a manual choice, not inferred from autoStart, running state, or usage frequency; it does not change manifests or start/stop processes. Newly registered items are resident by default. Search always covers names, IDs, and descriptions of all items, marking matching stored items. Clearing search restores the previous mode. Sorting is disabled when some items are hidden or a search is active; showing all enables sorting.

Preferences use the Host's existing `layout.json` (version 1, adding optional `display.services/tools: { mode: 'all' | 'resident', stored: string[] }`), remaining compatible with old files. The page and sidebar share them, and they survive refreshes. “Reset order” clears only `order`, not display preferences. A failed save rolls back the display while retaining the drawer draft; older polling results do not overwrite newly saved settings.

## Development and verification

The full test suite includes maintainer-workspace fixtures, historical Git objects, and desktop integration checks; it is not a standalone-install smoke test. The portable CI slice after building is `bun test ./tests/build-launcher.test.ts ./tests/record-ref.test.ts ./tests/pipeline-agent-tools.test.ts`. Passing this slice does not establish full-suite or live-desktop acceptance.

plugins.description: 把 cc-switch 配置的模型供应商接入 DSH（转成 llm-pi-ai 路由，附连通性体检）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-cc-switch

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-cc-switch)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cc-switch)
[![test](https://github.com/LightingHa/dsh-cc-switch/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/LightingHa/dsh-cc-switch/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-cc-switch)](./LICENSE)

把 [cc-switch](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch) 里配置好的模型供应商**直接接进 DeepSeek Harness**：
读取 cc-switch 的数据库（`~/.cc-switch/cc-switch.db`），把每家供应商转换成 DSH 内置
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的 provider 路由，写进「模型」页面用的同一份配置，并把 API Key
存进 harness 的凭据存储。**cc-switch 里有什么模型，DSH 的模型选择器里就能选到什么。**

本插件针对当前 DSH 版本（`0.2.0-rc.2`）的插件契约与 settings/credentials 服务编写，
不使用任何已废弃的配置字段。

---

## 它到底做了什么

```
cc-switch                                            DeepSeek Harness
──────────                                           ─────────────────
providers 表 ──┐
  claude       │   convert.js         plan.js              settings.mutate('llm-pi-ai')
  codex        ├──────────────► 路由 ──────────►  providers: { ccswitch-*: {...} }
  openclaw     │   (协议/端点/模型)  (只增删自己写过的)         │
  mcode / pi … │                                          └─► 持久化到 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml
               │                                              并热加载 —— 不用重启
proxy 日志 ────┘   credentials.set('CCSWITCH_…_API_KEY', <key>) ─► 凭据存储
```

关键点：**本插件不实现任何 HTTP/协议代码，也不注册第二个 LLM 适配器**
（那样会撞上 `DUPLICATE_ADAPTER`）。它只做「翻译 + 写入」，
真正的协议实现仍然由 DSH 自带的 pi-ai 适配器完成，所以升级 DSH 后不会失效。

---

## 安装

### 从插件市场一键安装（推荐）

装过 [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market)（DSH「设置 → 插件」里的可视化插件市场）的话，
直接在市场里搜 `cc-switch` 点安装即可。市场里的条目来自精选列表
[awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)，
本插件已按该列表的规则提交（条目文件见仓库里的 `marketplace/LightingHa__dsh-cc-switch.yml`）。

### 用 CLI 安装

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-cc-switch                       # 默认 profile
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-cc-switch     # 指定 profile
```

安装动作会改 profile 的两处文件：

- `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` → `dependencies` 加 `"dsh-cc-switch"`，
  `dsh.profile.bundles` 加 `"dsh-cc-switch"`
- 在 profile 目录执行一次安装（把包装进 `node_modules`）

**重启 DSH 后生效**（bundle 列表在启动时读取）。也可以在「设置 → 插件」里直接启用，
插件管理器会热挂载条目，不必重启。

### 从源码安装（开发 / 改代码时）

```powershell
$plugin  = "D:/path/to/dsh-cc-switch"         # 换成你 clone 的位置
$profile = "$env:DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop"   # 换成目标 profile

# 1) 在 $profile/package.json 里：
#    dependencies 加 "dsh-cc-switch": "file:$plugin"
#    dsh.profile.bundles 加 "dsh-cc-switch"
# 2) 安装
cd $profile
pnpm install
```

> `file:` 依赖在 pnpm 里是**快照**：改完插件源码必须重装才生效 ——
> 删掉 `node_modules/dsh-cc-switch`，再 `pnpm add "dsh-cc-switch@file:<路径>"`；
> 只跑 `pnpm install` 会提示 “Already up to date” 而不会刷新内容。

### 环境要求

- DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.1`（在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 上验证）
- Node.js `>= 22.13`（读 cc-switch 的 SQLite 库用到内置的 `node:sqlite`；它在 Node 22.13 才不再需要 `--experimental-sqlite`。DSH 自带的 Node 24 满足）
- 本机装过 [cc-switch](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch)，并至少配置了一家第三方供应商

### 装完之后

插件加载后会**自动同步一次**（`syncOnLoad`），之后每 30 秒看一眼 cc-switch 数据库有没有变
（`watchSeconds`），改了自动跟上。首次同步会：

1. 把 cc-switch 里的 API Key 写进凭据存储（名字形如 `CCSWITCH_CODEX_…_API_KEY`）；
2. 把路由写进 `llm-pi-ai` 的 `providers`，持久化到 profile 并热加载。

然后打开「设置 → 模型」，就能看到 `ccswitch-*` 开头的供应商；把它设为默认模型即可开始用。

> 不想让它自动写入？把配置改成 `mode: plan`（见下方配置表），它只会计算并打日志。

---

## 用工具手动控制

插件注册了工具 `cc_switch`：

| action | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `status`（默认） | 看当前状态、本次会做什么 |
| `sync` | 立即同步（`dry_run: true` 可只预演） |
| `plan` | 只预演，绝不写入 |
| `probe` | **体检**：按 pi-ai 会打的那个 URL 真发一次最小流式请求，实测每条路由通不通、首字节多久、流有没有正常收尾 |
| `list` | 列出 cc-switch 里识别到的全部供应商与模型 |
| `skip-list` | 只看**没**导入的供应商及原因 |

常用参数：`app_types`（本次只处理这些 app 类型）、`include` / `exclude`（按名称/ID 关键字收窄）。
这些参数只影响本次调用，不改插件配置。

例：`cc_switch` + `action=sync, dry_run=true` → 打印「将新增几条、更新几条、删几条、写几个凭据」。

### 体检输出怎么读

```
🩺 cc-switch 路由体检：共 2 条（可用 2，慢 0，异常 0），单条上限 200s
· ccswitch-openclaw-ark-code-latest（Ark Code Latest / openai-completions / 模型 ark-code-latest）
    ✅ 可用：HTTP 200，首字节 4.8s，共 7.9s，32365 字节
· ccswitch-codex-…（小胡王国 / openai-responses / 模型 gpt-6-astra）
    🐢 可用，但很慢：HTTP 200，首字节 96.3s，共 96.4s，50534 字节
    提示：首字节太久，对话时很容易被上游或网关掐断（表现为流读取失败）…
```

| 结论 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| ✅ 可用 | 2xx + 流里出现完成标记（`response.completed` / `[DONE]` / `message_stop`） |
| 🐢 可用，但很慢 | 通了，但首字节超过 `probeSlowFirstByteMs`；长对话容易中途断流 |
| ⚠️ 流没正常结束 | 连接断了却没看到完成标记 —— 上游把流掐了 |
| ⏱️ 超时 | 超过 `probeTimeoutMs` 仍没跑完 |
| ❌ 不可用 | 非 2xx、连不上、DNS/证书失败，或上游在流里返回了错误（错误原文会摘出来，密钥自动打码） |

体检**只读**：不写配置、不写凭据，Key 只出现在请求头里。

---

## 支持的 cc-switch app 类型与映射规则

| app 类型 | cc-switch 里的配置形状 | 映射结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `claude`、`claude-desktop` | `{env:{ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN\|ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_MODEL, ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL}}` | `anthropic-messages`，模型取 `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` + 各 `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL` |
| `codex` | `{auth:{OPENAI_API_KEY}, config:"<TOML>"}` | 解析 TOML 的 `model` / `model_provider` / `[model_providers.*]`；`wire_api=responses` → `openai-responses`，否则按 Codex 自身默认的 chat → `openai-completions` |
| `openclaw` | `{baseUrl, apiKey, api, models[]}`（也认整份 `models.providers`） | 与 pi-ai 字段几乎 1:1；一个 `providers` 条目展开成多条路由 |
| `mcode` | `{custom_provider:{<key>:{api, options:{baseURL,apiKey}, models}}}` | 按条目 `api`，`enabled:false` 的跳过 |
| `pi` | `[models] default` + `[model.<id>] base_url / api_key / api_backend` | 按 `api_backend` |
| `gemini` | `{env:{GEMINI_*/GOOGLE_*}, config}` | **原生 `generateContent` 不在 pi-ai 支持范围内**，默认跳过并说明原因；若在 cc-switch 里开了 OpenAI 兼容（或配置了 `meta.apiFormat`）就按兼容协议导入 |
| `opencode`、`hermes`、`grokbuild`、未知类型 | 结构不定 | 深度扫描 `baseURL` / `apiKey` / `models`，能认出来就导入，认不出就进 `skip-list` 并说明原因 |

识别到的元信息（`meta`）也会用上：

- `apiFormat` / `codexCopilotApiFormat` → 决定协议（`openai_chat` → `openai-completions`）
- `apiKeyField` → 指定用哪个字段当密钥
- `isFullUrl` → 端点是完整接口地址时自动去掉 `/chat/completions`、`/responses`、`/messages` 尾巴
- `customUserAgent` / `requestHeaders` → 转成路由请求头（非法表头会被丢弃，避免整次写入失败）
- `model_catalog_json` → 补充模型清单

**模型清单从哪来**：优先用配置里声明的模型；再合并 cc-switch 代理日志
（`proxy_request_logs`）里这家供应商真实用过的模型名 —— 这能救回那些只声明一个
`model` 的 Codex 供应商；最后用 `model_catalog_json`。三者都没有的供应商会被跳过，
不会生成「选不了的模型」条目。

---

## 配置项

配置写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里（也可以让「设置 → 插件」写入）：

```yaml
- id: cc-switch
  name: dsh-cc-switch
  config:
    mode: apply
    watchSeconds: 30
```

| 配置 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关；关掉后不自动同步，工具仍可用 |
| `dbPath` | `''` | cc-switch 数据库路径；留空自动探测（也认 `CC_SWITCH_DB` / `CC_SWITCH_HOME`） |
| `appTypes` | `claude,claude-desktop,codex,openclaw,mcode,pi,opencode,hermes,grokbuild,gemini` | 要导入的 app 类型 |
| `include` / `exclude` | `''` | 按名称/ID 关键字包含/排除（逗号分隔） |
| `routePrefix` | `ccswitch` | 路由名前缀；**也是「本插件拥有的路由」的判定依据和凭据名前缀** |
| `targetEntry` | `llm-pi-ai` | 写进哪个条目的 `providers` |
| `mode` | `apply` | `apply`=写入；`plan`=只计算不写 |
| `onConflict` | `skip` | 路由名与已有配置撞车时：`skip` 跳过并警告 / `overwrite` 覆盖 |
| `importUnsupported` | `false` | 连端点/协议不全的也写进去（会出现选了就报错的模型，不建议） |
| `pruneOwnedRoutes` | `true` | 清理自己上次写过、这次不再生成的路由与凭据 |
| `writeCredentials` | `true` | 把 API Key 写进凭据存储 |
| `usageModelHints` | `true` | 用代理日志补充模型清单 |
| `syncOnLoad` | `true` | 加载后自动同步一次 |
| `loadDelayMs` | `2500` | 首次同步延迟（避开启动高峰） |
| `watchSeconds` | `30` | 轮询 cc-switch 数据库变化的间隔；`0`=关闭 |
| `statePath` | `''` | 清单文件路径；留空用 `$DSH_HOME/cc-switch-state.json` |
| `overrides` | `{}` | 人工修正：`{ 路由名: 要合并进该路由的字段 }`，例如 `{"ccswitch-codex-xxx":{"api":"openai-completions"}}` |
| `probeTimeoutMs` | `120000` | 体检时单条路由的等待上限；慢中转常常几十秒才吐首字节 |
| `probeSlowFirstByteMs` | `30000` | 体检时首字节超过这个毫秒数就标成「慢」 |
| `toolName` | `cc_switch` | 工具公开名 |
| `debug` | `false` | 打详细日志 |

---

## 安全边界（重要）

- **只写 `routePrefix` 前缀的路由**（默认 `ccswitch-`）。你手写的、别的插件写的路由
  （比如 `ali-bailian`、`huoshan`）永远不会被改动。
- **只删自己写过的**。插件在 `$DSH_HOME/cc-switch-state.json` 里记着自己上次写了哪些
  路由和凭据；只有清单里有的、这次不再生成的，才会被撤销。
- **撞名默认跳过**。万一前缀撞上了别人的配置，默认跳过并在报告里警告，不会静默覆盖。
- **没有变化就不写**。内容一致时完全不动配置（幂等），不会反复触发 reload。
- **凭据只写不覆盖环境变量**。如果某个引用名已经由启动环境提供，插件不会去覆盖它，
  只在报告里提示。
- **密钥不回显**。所有输出里的 Key 都做了掩码。
- 想完全停手：`mode: plan`，或直接禁用插件条目。

### 撤销

在 cc-switch 里删掉供应商 → 下次同步自动撤销对应的路由与凭据。
想一次性全部撤销：删掉 `$DSH_HOME/cc-switch-state.json` 之后**它就不会再删任何东西**了，
所以正确做法是先在 cc-switch 里清空供应商，或手工把 `providers` 里 `ccswitch-` 开头的键删掉。

---

## 常见问题

**选了 cc-switch 的模型，对话却报流读取错误（例如 `stre

# dsh-agent-notify

**一句话**：**出外告警的唯一通道**——任何插件都能通过它，在「我不在场」时把话喊出机器。 **为什么值得用**：多个插件各自实现推送 ⇒ 凭据散落、去重各写、失败各吞。本插件把它收成**一个 service**：Telegram 双通道 + 去重/冷却 + 落盘留痕。⚠ 它**只送不判**：`title` / `lines` 由调用方撰写——机制送信号，**决策归主体**（AGENTS.md §2.1）。 ## 服务（本插件的对外契约） 本插件**不注册工具**——它是 Service 型。对外提供 cordis 服务 `notify`： ```ts interface NotifyService { alert(input: { title: string; lines: string[]; dedupKey: string }): Promise ready(): { ok: boolean; detail: string } readonly name: string } ``` 消费者在自己的 `inject` 里声明 `'notify'`（cordis 严格代理：未声明即访问会抛错；**声明后提供者未挂载时才是 `undefined`**，故消费者须处理降级）。 **它只送不判**：`title` / `lines` 由调用方撰写——本插件不判断「何时该告警」，也不生成内容（AGENTS.md §2.1：机制送信号，决策归主体）。它也不重试、不触发任何恢复动作（尤其不自动 rearm goal）。 完整契约（配置字段 / 不变量 / 调用点 / 验收清单 / 未决问题）见 [`docs/semantic.md`](docs/semantic.md)。 ## 生态契约 > 依据《DSH 插件生态倡议书》三条原则：**组合优先 / 声明清晰 / 兼容优先**。 - **依赖 service**（`inject`）：**无**——本插件是通道，不是消费者；不读任何宿主服务 - **贡献面**：工具 **无**；slot 无；service **`notify`** - 组合行 id：`agent-notify` - **Fabric manifest**：`dsh-plugin.json`（RFC 0001 v0.1 **Draft** 形状）——`id` = `com.jonah791.agent-notify`，required = （无），optional = （无） - **Fabric 入口**：`src/fabric.ts` → `lib/fabric.js`（骨架，**不依赖 DSH/Cordis**；Fabric SDK 发布后填充实现） > ⚠ **不是认证**：Fabric 目前只有文档草案（无正式 schema、无 SDK、无 conformance 套件），因此**不得**声称本插件 > 「通过 Fabric 认证」或「已符合 Fabric 标准」。对齐的是 RFC 0001 的 manifest 形状 + 可机械校验的明文规则； > `dsh-plugin.json` 的 `$schema` 是**自证 draft 的占位**，Phase 0 发布 canonical identifier 后替换。 组合片段（`cordis.patch.yml`）： ```yaml - insert: - id: agent-notify name: dsh-agent-notify config: {} ``` ## 能力边界（诚实声明） 本插件与宿主**同进程、全权限**运行。「能力声明」用于兼容判断、用户确认与审计，**不构成安全沙箱**——不要把它当权限边界。 本插件不导入其他插件或宿主的内部路径（组合优先），也不覆盖别人的内部实现。 ### 两个面，别混淆 - **Fabric 契约面**：`dsh-plugin.json` + `src/fabric.ts`（host entrypoint）。这是**前瞻声明**——Fabric 目前只有 RFC Draft， 没有正式 schema / SDK / conformance 套件，官方 `docs/plugin-development.md` 明示其**尚不能作为依赖或发布目标**； `$schema` 是自证 draft 的 `.invalid` 占位（RFC §14-1 未定 canonical identifier），**不是** schema 校验通过，也**不是**认证。 - **DSH/Cordis 面（非标准扩展路径）**：`src/index.ts` + `cordis.patch.yml`——本插件**现在真正可运行**的形态。 `tools` 不在 Fabric v0.1 的 capability 表内（v0.1 只有 host.info / log / 生命周期取消 + `storage.local` / `commands` / `messages.observe`）， 故这属标准之外的扩展路径：**不得**当作可移植 API，也**不得**成为 Fabric entrypoint 的依赖。 ## 构建与挂载 ```sh pnpm build # 挂载到 web profile（dsh plugin-manager 或 plugin_mount） ``` ## 快速开始 **1) 装依赖**： ```jsonc "dsh-agent-notify": "link:E:/alice/self-plugins/dsh-agent-notify" ``` **2) 挂组合**（⚠ 凭据只写在 patch 里，**不进源码**）： ```yaml - id: agent-notify name: dsh-agent-notify config: botToken: "<你的 bot token>" chatId: "<目标 chat id>" ``` **3) 30 秒验证**：`notify.ready()` → 应返回 `{ok: true, detail: "…"}`；再让某个消费者 `alert({title, lines, dedupKey})` → 主人应收到一条 Telegram 消息，且**同 `dedupKey` 的重复告警被冷却挡住**。 ## 配置 | 项 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `botToken` | — | Telegram bot token（**只写组合 patch**，不进源码、不进仓库） | | `chatId` | — | 目标 chat id | | （去重/冷却窗口等见源码 `Config`） | — | 同 `dedupKey` 在窗口内只发一次 | ## 落盘与自证 | 文件 | 何时写 | 内容 | |---|---|---| | `${DSH_HOME}/notify-trace.jsonl` | 每次 `alert` | 标题 / 去重键 / 是否真发（被冷却挡住的不算发送） | **一条命令答五问**： ```bash tail -3 "$DSH_HOME/notify-trace.jsonl" # ① 跑的是哪个构建 → 见 package.json version 与 lib mtime # ② 谁发起 → 该行的 title 与调用方 # ③ 断在哪一段 → 有行未发 = 被冷却；无行 = 没人调用过 # ④ 结果质量 → 是否真发（sent true/false） # ⑤ 耗时与预算 → 发送延迟 ``` ## 生效判据与回退 **判据**：① 行为级——`notify.ready()` 返回 `{ok:true}`；② **端到端**——真发一条告警并收到。 **回退**：① `git revert` + 重建 + 预检重启；② patch 行 `disabled: true`（消费者会拿到 `undefined`，须处理降级）；③ 无持久状态，停用即完全静默。 ## 测试 ```bash cd self-plugins/dsh-agent-notify && npm test ``` **37 条用例**（跑一次得到）：覆盖**双通道**发送与降级 · **去重/冷却**（同键窗口内只发一次）· 凭据缺失时的响亮失败 · 发送失败入 outbox（**防丢**）· 侧车格式。无需真实网络（走注入的假 transport）。 ## 设计要点 - **只送不判**：`title` / `lines` 由调用方撰写——本插件不判断「何时该告警」，也不生成内容（§2.1：机制送信号，决策归主体）。 - **它是唯一通道**：多个插件各自实现推送 ⇒ 凭据散落、去重各写、失败各吞。收成一个 service 才能统一去重与留痕。 - **不重试、不触发恢复**：尤其**不自动 rearm goal**——「把话喊出去」与「替人做决定」是两件事。 - **消费者须处理降级**：cordis 严格代理下未声明即访问会抛错；**声明后提供者未挂载时才是 `undefined`**。 - **凭据只住 patch**：源码与仓库里没有 token（这是隐私纪律的硬要求）。 ## License MIT © jonah791 --- 本插件属于**爱丽丝 DSH 自研插件生态**（[alice-digital-life](https://github.com/jonah791/alice-digital-life) · 73 个插件 · 8 个模块）：单一职责、独立仓库、独立可用。

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: Open delivered-file cards with the system default app
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-open-native

点交付卡片 → 直接用**系统默认程序**打开文件（`.xlsx` 就是 WPS），不再跳进 DSH 右侧的
内置预览。

## 为什么需要它

DSH 的交付卡片（`present` 出来的文件那个卡片）把两件事刻意分开了：

- **点卡片本体** = 在右侧 Sidebar 内嵌预览。这是写死的，没有设置项能改。
- **用系统默认程序打开** = 卡片上另一个独立的分体按钮「打开（默认）」。

这个插件把第一件事改成第二件事。

> 注意：这个插件只负责「走哪条打开通道」。文件最终由哪个程序接管，仍然取决于
> Windows 对那个扩展名的默认程序关联。如果点开发现是微软 Office 而不是 WPS，
> 那是系统关联的问题（`FileExts\.xlsx\UserChoice` 的哈希失效），不是插件的问题。

## 怎么做的

改动全在浏览器端，不碰 DSH 本体（不改 `app.asar`，升级不会丢）。

- DSH 的卡片里那个铺满整块的预览按钮，`title` 属性上挂的就是解析后的绝对路径
  （`resolveWorkspacePath(cwd, file.path)`）。
- 原生打开的通道是宿主的 `session.openWorkspacePath({ path })`。
- 本插件在 `document` 的**捕获阶段**监听 `click`：命中 `[data-presented-file]` 卡片、
  且不是点在卡片右下角的动作按钮上时 → `preventDefault()` 掉原来的预览 →
  改调 `session.openWorkspacePath`。

## 保留原来的行为

**按住 Shift（或 Ctrl / Alt / Cmd）点卡片**，仍然走 DSH 内置的侧边栏预览。

## 安装

这是一个标准的 DSH 插件包（`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-open-native
# 或者用本地打包好的文件：
dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:/绝对路径/dsh-open-native-1.1.0.tgz
```

装完在 DSH 可视化页面的「插件」面板里就能看到它（标题「原生打开」，带图标），
可随时启用/停用。

## 包装内容

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | 宿主半区：不注册任何服务，只为让 bundle 能被加载 |
| `lib/client.js` | 客户端半区：捕获阶段的点击拦截，真正干活的部分 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 补丁，把本插件挂进 profile |
| `icon.svg` | 插件面板里的图标（`package.json` 的 `icon` 字段） |
| `locale/en.json`、`locale/zh.json`、`locale/zh-CN.json` | 面板里显示的名称与描述 |

`package.json` 里的 `dsh.engines.dsh` 声明了适用的 DSH 版本（`>=0.2.0-rc.2`），
是给插件市场做兼容判断用的元数据。

## 排错

按 F12 打开开发者工具，看 Console 里有没有 `[dsh-open-native]` 开头的警告：

- `宿主没有受理原生打开` → 宿主拒绝了这次调用（路径不在会话工作区内，或宿主没装
  原生打开能力）。
- 什么都没打出来 → 说明点击没被识别成卡片，多半是 DSH 改了卡片的 DOM 结构
  （见下）。

## 它可能在什么时候坏

插件靠两个 DOM 特征认卡片，DSH 大版本更新后可能要跟着调：

- 卡片容器：`[data-presented-file]`
- 预览按钮：`button` 的 class 里含 `cardPreview`

两处都在 `lib/client.js` 顶部的常量里。改完记得重新打包并向 profile 重装一次。

第二条有退路：类名对不上时，插件会退回「卡片里第一个 `title` 是绝对路径的按钮」，
所以 DSH 单纯重命名 CSS module 不会让它整个失效——**真正会一击致命的是卡片容器标记**。
另外路径必须长得像绝对路径（`C:\`、`\\`、`/` 开头）才会被打开，避免把 `title`
上的普通文案当成路径去调宿主。

## 版本

- **1.1.0** — 预览按钮识别加了退路；路径改为从「这一下真正点到的按钮」上取，
  卡片里出现多个文件时不会认错。
- **1.0.0** — 首个版本。

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

Its egress report goe
